AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Multi-tenant QuickSight dashboard application running on AWS App Runner.
  Fully self-contained: creates a new ECR repository, the App Runner ECR
  access (build) IAM role, the App Runner task (instance) IAM role with
  QuickSight and Directory Service provisioning permissions, and the App Runner
  service with auto-deployments enabled and an HTTP /status health check on
  port 8080. No pre-existing VPC, subnet, security group, key pair, secret,
  SSM parameter, or cross-stack export is referenced anywhere in this template.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Application
        Parameters:
          - AppName
          - Environment
          - ImageTag
      - Label:
          default: Bootstrap Admin
        Parameters:
          - AdminEmail
          - AdminUserName
      - Label:
          default: QuickSight Integration
        Parameters:
          - QuickSightTemplateId
          - QuickSightDatasetId
          - QuickSightDataSourceId
          - QuickSightDatabase
          - QuickSightTable
          - QuickSightFilterColumn
  Notes:
    - The ECR repository is created EMPTY by this template. App Runner cannot
      complete its first deployment until a container image is pushed to the
      repository by the CI/CD pipeline (a step outside CloudFormation).
    - The ECR repository enforces IMMUTABLE image tags (AVD-AWS-0031). A tag
      can therefore never be overwritten, so the CI/CD pipeline MUST push a
      unique, monotonically distinct tag per build (for example a commit SHA
      or build number) instead of re-pushing a fixed tag such as "latest".
      Attempting to push an existing tag will be rejected by ECR.
    - Because tags are immutable, release delivery works by updating the
      ImageTag parameter (or the service ImageIdentifier) to the newly pushed
      unique tag; the resulting stack update points App Runner at the new
      image. AutoDeploymentsEnabled is true so App Runner also redeploys when
      the referenced tag resolves to a new image digest.
    - The App Runner service is created without a VPC connector
      (EgressType DEFAULT) because this template does not create a VPC.
    - The App Runner health check at path /status uses the container port
      declared in SourceConfiguration.ImageRepository.ImageConfiguration.Port
      (8080); AWS::AppRunner::Service HealthCheckConfiguration has no Port
      property, so the image configuration port is the single source of truth.
    - All runtime environment variable values are non-secret placeholders.
      No passwords, API keys, or real secrets are stored in this template.
    - The instance (task) role is granted QuickSight and Directory Service
      permissions scoped with Fn::Sub against AWS::AccountId and AWS::Region;
      create-type Directory Service actions that do not support resource-level
      permissions are isolated in their own statement.

Parameters:
  AppName:
    Type: String
    Default: quicksight-dashboard
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 40
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$'
    Description: Application name used for the ECR repository, IAM role, and App Runner service names.

  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: prod
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod
    Description: Deployment environment name used for naming and tagging.

  ImageTag:
    Type: String
    Default: initial
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 128
    Description: >-
      Immutable, per-build container image tag to deploy (e.g. a commit SHA or
      build number). The ECR repository rejects tag overwrites, so supply a
      new unique tag for every release.

  AdminEmail:
    Type: String
    Default: admin@example.com
    Description: Dummy bootstrap admin email placeholder (never a real secret).

  AdminUserName:
    Type: String
    Default: quicksight-admin
    Description: Bootstrap admin user name placeholder.

  QuickSightTemplateId:
    Type: String
    Default: quicksight-template-id
    Description: QuickSight template identifier consumed by the application.

  QuickSightDatasetId:
    Type: String
    Default: quicksight-dataset-id
    Description: QuickSight dataset identifier consumed by the application.

  QuickSightDataSourceId:
    Type: String
    Default: quicksight-datasource-id
    Description: QuickSight data source identifier consumed by the application.

  QuickSightDatabase:
    Type: String
    Default: analytics
    Description: Database name used by the QuickSight integration.

  QuickSightTable:
    Type: String
    Default: tenant_events
    Description: Table name used by the QuickSight integration.

  QuickSightFilterColumn:
    Type: String
    Default: tenant_id
    Description: Column name used to filter dashboard data per tenant.

Resources:

  ECRRepository:
    Type: AWS::ECR::Repository
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      RepositoryName: !Sub '${AppName}-repo'
      ImageTagMutability: IMMUTABLE
      ImageScanningConfiguration:
        ScanOnPush: true
      EncryptionConfiguration:
        EncryptionType: AES256
      RepositoryPolicyText:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowAccountImagePull
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action:
              - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
              - ecr:BatchGetImage
              - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AppName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  BuildRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AppName}-apprunner-ecr-access-${Environment}'
      Description: App Runner build role granting ECR authentication and image pull for deployments.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowAppRunnerBuildService
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: build.apprunner.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AppRunnerECRAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: AllowECRAuthentication
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: AllowECRImagePull
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                  - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
                  - ecr:DescribeImages
                  - ecr:DescribeRepositories
                  - ecr:ListImages
                Resource: !GetAtt ECRRepository.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AppName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  TaskRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AppName}-apprunner-task-${Environment}'
      Description: App Runner instance role enabling multi-tenant QuickSight and Directory Service provisioning.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowAppRunnerTasks
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: tasks.apprunner.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: QuickSightAndDirectoryServiceProvisioning
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: QuickSightNamespaceAndAssetActions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - quicksight:CreateNamespace
                  - quicksight:DescribeNamespace
                  - quicksight:CreateDataSet
                  - quicksight:DescribeDataSet
                  - quicksight:CreateDataSource
                  - quicksight:DescribeDataSource
                  - quicksight:RegisterUser
                  - quicksight:DescribeUser
                  - quicksight:CreateGroup
                  - quicksight:CreateGroupMembership
                  - quicksight:ListUsers
                  - quicksight:ListGroups
                  - quicksight:UpdateDataSetPermissions
                  - quicksight:UpdateDataSourcePermissions
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:quicksight:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:namespace/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:quicksight:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:dataset/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:quicksight:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:datasource/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:quicksight:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:user/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:quicksight:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:group/*'
              - Sid: DirectoryServiceResourceActions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ds:DescribeDirectories
                  - ds:DescribeTrusts
                  - ds:AuthorizeApplication
                  - ds:UnauthorizeApplication
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ds:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:directory/*'
              - Sid: DirectoryServiceCreateActions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ds:CreateDirectory
                  - ds:CreateTrust
                  - ds:AddTagsToResource
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AppName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  AppRunnerService:
    Type: AWS::AppRunner::Service
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub '${AppName}-service-${Environment}'
      SourceConfiguration:
        AuthenticationConfiguration:
          AccessRoleArn: !GetAtt BuildRole.Arn
        AutoDeploymentsEnabled: true
        ImageRepository:
          ImageIdentifier: !Sub '${ECRRepository.RepositoryUri}:${ImageTag}'
          ImageRepositoryType: ECR
          ImageConfiguration:
            Port: '8080'
            RuntimeEnvironmentVariables:
              - Name: ALLOW_IP_RANGE
                Value: '0.0.0.0/0'
              - Name: AWS_REGION
                Value: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
              - Name: AWS_ACCOUNT_ID
                Value: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
              - Name: ADMIN_EMAIL
                Value: !Ref AdminEmail
              - Name: ADMIN_USER_NAME
                Value: !Ref AdminUserName
              - Name: QS_TEMPLATE_ID
                Value: !Ref QuickSightTemplateId
              - Name: QS_DATASET_ID
                Value: !Ref QuickSightDatasetId
              - Name: QS_DATASOURCE_ID
                Value: !Ref QuickSightDataSourceId
              - Name: QS_DATABASE
                Value: !Ref QuickSightDatabase
              - Name: QS_TABLE
                Value: !Ref QuickSightTable
              - Name: QS_FILTER_COLUMN
                Value: !Ref QuickSightFilterColumn
      InstanceConfiguration:
        Cpu: '1024'
        Memory: '2048'
        InstanceRoleArn: !GetAtt TaskRole.Arn
      HealthCheckConfiguration:
        Protocol: HTTP
        Path: /status
        Interval: 10

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark (v1.4 / 3.x "VPC flow logging enabled") aligned remediation that enables
  Amazon VPC Flow Logs with rejected-traffic (REJECT) capture and delivers the records to a compliance-grade
  CloudWatch Logs log group. Delivered with AWS Systems Manager Automation: a primary runbook that enables
  flow logging on a target VPC through the EC2 API, and a dependent runbook that does not call EC2 directly
  and instead gates the same remediation behind a formal, approved change request. Approval notifications are
  delivered through a customer-managed KMS encrypted SNS topic.

Metadata:
  Compliance:
    Standard: CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark (v1.4 / v3.x)
    Control: VPC flow logging enabled
    Purpose: VPCFlowLogs
  ChangeManagerNote: >-
    UNCERTAINTY FLAG (objective: do not invent resource types or actions): AWS Systems Manager Change Manager
    change templates and change requests are not exposed by CloudFormation as a resource type (there is no
    AWS::SSM::ChangeTemplate) and there is no SSM Automation action that creates a Change Manager change
    request. Rather than fabricate such a type/action, this template omits them and models the approval gate
    with the documented, supported aws:approve automation action followed by aws:executeAutomation.
    In a production account, register a Change Manager change template for this remediation, start the
    change-gated runbook (or the primary runbook) from an approved change request, and treat the aws:approve
    step as the approval of that change request.

Parameters:
  LogRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 365
    AllowedValues: [90, 365, 400, 730]
    Description: >-
      Retention, in days, for VPC flow log records in CloudWatch Logs. The default of 365 days satisfies the
      CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark evidence-retention expectation.

Resources:

  #############################################################################
  # CIS evidence store: CloudWatch Logs destination for VPC flow log records
  #############################################################################
  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc-flow-logs'
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionDays
      Tags:
        - Key: Compliance
          Value: CIS
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: VPCFlowLogs

  #############################################################################
  # IAM role assumed by the VPC Flow Logs service to publish to the log group
  #############################################################################
  FlowLogsDeliveryRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc-flow-logs-delivery'
      Description: Allows the VPC Flow Logs service to publish flow log records to the CIS log group.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowVpcFlowLogsServiceToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: VpcFlowLogsDeliveryPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: PublishFlowLogsToComplianceLogGroup
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
                  - !Sub '${FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn}:*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Compliance
          Value: CIS
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: VPCFlowLogs

  #############################################################################
  # KMS key protecting the approval notification topic (encryption at rest)
  #############################################################################
  ChangeApprovalKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: >-
        Customer managed KMS key used to encrypt the SNS topic that carries VPC flow logging change
        approval notifications.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowAccountRootAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowSnsServiceToUseKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sns.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Compliance
          Value: CIS
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: VPCFlowLogs

  ChangeApprovalKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-vpc-flow-logs-change-approval'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref ChangeApprovalKey

  #############################################################################
  # Change-approval plumbing used by the change-gated runbook (aws:approve)
  #############################################################################
  ChangeApprovalTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      TopicName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc-flow-logs-change-approval'
      DisplayName: VPC flow logging change approval notifications
      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt ChangeApprovalKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Compliance
          Value: CIS
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: VPCFlowLogs

  #############################################################################
  # IAM role assumed by the SSM Automation runbooks to perform remediation
  #############################################################################
  AutomationExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ssm-automation-execution'
      Description: Execution role assumed by the VPC flow log remediation Systems Manager Automation runbooks.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowSsmAutomationToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: VpcFlowLogsRemediationPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ManageVpcFlowLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:CreateFlowLogs
                  - ec2:DeleteFlowLogs
                  - ec2:DescribeFlowLogs
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                  - ec2:DescribeRegions
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: ReadFlowLogDestinationLogGroup
                Effect: Allow
                Action: logs:DescribeLogGroups
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
              # iam:PassRole is deliberately constrained to the single in-template delivery role ARN.
              - Sid: PassFlowLogsDeliveryRoleOnly
                Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:PassRole
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsDeliveryRole.Arn
              # Required by the change-gated runbook's aws:approve step to publish approval notifications.
              - Sid: PublishChangeApprovalNotifications
                Effect: Allow
                Action: sns:Publish
                Resource: !Ref ChangeApprovalTopic
              # Publishing to the encrypted approval topic requires use of the CMK protecting it.
              - Sid: UseChangeApprovalKeyForPublish
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !GetAtt ChangeApprovalKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Compliance
          Value: CIS
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: VPCFlowLogs

  ChangeApproverRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc-flow-logs-change-approver'
      Description: Principal allowed to approve the gated VPC flow logging change request.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowAccountPrincipalsToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ApproveGatedVpcFlowLoggingChange
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ReadAndApproveAutomationExecutions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:GetAutomationExecution
                  - ssm:DescribeAutomationExecutions
                  - ssm:SendAutomationSignal
                Resource: '*'
              # Allows the approver to read notifications delivered through the encrypted topic.
              - Sid: DecryptChangeApprovalNotifications
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !GetAtt ChangeApprovalKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Compliance
          Value: CIS
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: VPCFlowLogs

  #############################################################################
  # Primary Automation runbook: enables REJECT flow logging on a VPC
  #############################################################################
  EnableVpcFlowLogsDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-enable-vpc-flow-logs'
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: >-
          Enables VPC Flow Logs on the specified VPC with TrafficType REJECT so that rejected traffic is
          captured, and delivers the records to the CIS compliance CloudWatch Logs log group.
        assumeRole: !GetAtt AutomationExecutionRole.Arn
        parameters:
          VpcId:
            type: String
            description: The ID of the VPC on which VPC Flow Logs are enabled.
            allowedPattern: '^vpc-[0-9a-f]{8,17}$'
          LogGroupArn:
            type: String
            description: ARN of the CloudWatch Logs log group that receives the flow log records.
            default: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
          DeliveryRoleArn:
            type: String
            description: ARN of the IAM role that the VPC Flow Logs service assumes to publish records.
            default: !GetAtt FlowLogsDeliveryRole.Arn
        mainSteps:
          - name: enableFlowLogs
            action: aws:executeScript
            description: Calls ec2:CreateFlowLogs to enable REJECT-traffic flow logging on the VPC.
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.11
              Handler: handler
              InputPayload:
                vpcId: '{{ VpcId }}'
                logGroupArn: '{{ LogGroupArn }}'
                deliveryRoleArn: '{{ DeliveryRoleArn }}'
              Script: |-
                import boto3

                def handler(events, context):
                    ec2 = boto3.client("ec2")
                    vpc_id = events["vpcId"]
                    log_group_arn = events["logGroupArn"]
                    delivery_role_arn = events["deliveryRoleArn"]

                    existing_flow_logs = ec2.describe_flow_logs(
                        Filters=[
                            {"Name": "resource-id", "Values": [vpc_id]},
                            {"Name": "log-destination-type", "Values": ["cloud-watch-logs"]},
                        ]
                    ).get("FlowLogs", [])

                    for flow_log in existing_flow_logs:
                        if (
                            flow_log.get("TrafficType") == "REJECT"
                            and flow_log.get("FlowLogStatus") in ("ACTIVE", "PENDING")
                        ):
                            return {"FlowLogIds": [flow_log["FlowLogId"]], "Created": False}

                    response = ec2.create_flow_logs(
                        ResourceIds=[vpc_id],
                        ResourceType="VPC",
                        TrafficType="REJECT",
                        LogDestinationType="cloud-watch-logs",
                        LogDestination=log_group_arn,
                        DeliverLogsPermissionArn=delivery_role_arn,
                        TagSpecifications=[
                            {
                                "ResourceType": "vpc-flow-log",
                                "Tags": [
                                    {"Key": "Compliance", "Value": "CIS"},
                                    {"Key": "Purpose", "Value": "VPCFlowLogs"},
                                ],
                            }
                        ],
                    )
                    return {"FlowLogIds": response.get("FlowLogIds", []), "Created": True}
      Tags:
        - Key: Compliance
          Value: CIS
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: VPCFlowLogs

  #############################################################################
  # Change-gated Automation runbook: never calls EC2 directly, invokes the
  # primary runbook only after an explicit approval. The Change Manager change
  # request itself cannot be modelled in CloudFormation (see Metadata note).
  #############################################################################
  EnableVpcFlowLogsWithChangeApprovalDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-enable-vpc-flow-logs-change-gated'
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: !Sub >-
          Change-gated wrapper around the ${AWS::StackName}-enable-vpc-flow-logs runbook. This runbook does not
          call the EC2 API itself: it pauses for a formal approval and only then invokes the primary runbook,
          which performs the VPC flow log remediation.
        assumeRole: !GetAtt AutomationExecutionRole.Arn
        parameters:
          VpcId:
            type: String
            description: The ID of the VPC on which VPC Flow Logs are enabled after approval.
            allowedPattern: '^vpc-[0-9a-f]{8,17}$'
        mainSteps:
          - name: approveChangeRequest
            action: aws:approve
            description: >-
              Pauses the automation until the VPC flow logging change is explicitly approved. In a production
              account this approval is the approval of the corresponding Change Manager change request.
            inputs:
              Message: >-
                Approval requested: enable VPC Flow Logs with REJECT traffic capture on VPC {{ VpcId }} as a
                CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark remediation.
              NotificationArn: !Ref ChangeApprovalTopic
              Approvers:
                - !GetAtt ChangeApproverRole.Arn
          - name: enableFlowLogsAfterApproval
            action: aws:executeAutomation
            description: Invokes the primary runbook that enables REJECT flow logging, after approval.
            inputs:
              DocumentName: !Ref EnableVpcFlowLogsDocument
              RuntimeParameters:
                VpcId: '{{ VpcId }}'
      Tags:
        - Key: Compliance
          Value: CIS
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: VPCFlowLogs

Outputs:
  FlowLogsLogGroupName:
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch Logs log group that receives VPC flow log records.
    Value: !Ref FlowLogsLogGroup
  FlowLogsLogGroupArn:
    Description: ARN of the CloudWatch Logs log group that receives VPC flow log records.
    Value: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
  FlowLogsDeliveryRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role that the VPC Flow Logs service assumes to publish records.
    Value: !GetAtt FlowLogsDeliveryRole.Arn
  AutomationExecutionRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role assumed by the Systems Manager Automation runbooks.
    Value: !GetAtt AutomationExecutionRole.Arn
  EnableVpcFlowLogsDocumentName:
    Description: Name of the primary Automation runbook that enables REJECT traffic flow logging.
    Value: !Ref EnableVpcFlowLogsDocument
  EnableVpcFlowLogsWithChangeApprovalDocumentName:
    Description: Name of the change-gated Automation runbook that invokes the primary runbook.
    Value: !Ref EnableVpcFlowLogsWithChangeApprovalDocument
  ChangeApprovalTopicArn:
    Description: ARN of the KMS encrypted SNS topic used for flow logging change approvals.
    Value: !Ref ChangeApprovalTopic
  ChangeApprovalKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the customer managed KMS key that encrypts the change approval topic.
    Value: !GetAtt ChangeApprovalKey.Arn
  LogRetentionDays:
    Description: Retention period, in days, applied to the VPC flow log group.
    Value: !Ref LogRetentionDays

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Serverless WebSocket API built with Amazon API Gateway (WebSocket / v2). Every message
  received on the $default route asynchronously starts a STANDARD AWS Step Functions state
  machine, passing the raw message together with the WebSocket connection ID. After a
  five second wait the state machine posts a response back to the connected client through
  the API Gateway Management API. The API, routes, integrations, stage, IAM roles, state
  machine and log groups are all created by this template.

Parameters:

  StageName:
    Type: String
    Default: api
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 128
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      The stage name must contain only alphanumeric characters, hyphens and underscores.
    Description: >-
      Name of the API Gateway stage that is created and deployed for the WebSocket API
      (for example "api", "dev" or "prod").

Resources:

  ###############################################################################
  # WebSocket API
  ###############################################################################

  WebSocketApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Api
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ws-api'
      Description: !Sub 'Serverless WebSocket API for ${AWS::StackName}'
      ProtocolType: WEBSOCKET
      RouteSelectionExpression: '$request.body.action'

  ###############################################################################
  # Integrations
  ###############################################################################

  # Integration used by the $default route. API Gateway calls the StartExecution API
  # action of the state machine created in this template: the state machine ARN is
  # supplied through the mapping template below, so every message starts a new
  # asynchronous execution.
  DefaultIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      IntegrationType: AWS
      IntegrationMethod: POST
      IntegrationUri: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:states:action/StartExecution'
      CredentialsArn: !GetAtt ApiGatewayInvocationRole.Arn
      RequestTemplates:
        $default: !Sub |
          {
            "stateMachineArn": "${StateMachine}",
            "input": "{\"connectionId\":\"$context.connectionId\",\"message\":\"$util.escapeJavaScript($input.body)\"}"
          }

  # No-op integrations so that clients can open and close WebSocket connections.
  ConnectIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      IntegrationType: MOCK
      RequestTemplates:
        $default: '{"statusCode": 200}'

  DisconnectIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      IntegrationType: MOCK
      RequestTemplates:
        $default: '{"statusCode": 200}'

  ###############################################################################
  # Routes
  ###############################################################################

  ConnectRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: '$connect'
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Target: !Sub 'integrations/${ConnectIntegration}'

  DisconnectRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: '$disconnect'
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Target: !Sub 'integrations/${DisconnectIntegration}'

  DefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: '$default'
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Target: !Sub 'integrations/${DefaultIntegration}'

  ###############################################################################
  # Deployment and stage
  ###############################################################################

  Deployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - ConnectRoute
      - DisconnectRoute
      - DefaultRoute
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      Description: !Sub >-
        Deployment of the ${AWS::StackName} WebSocket API
        (integrations ${ConnectIntegration}, ${DisconnectIntegration}, ${DefaultIntegration})

  Stage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Stage
    DependsOn: Deployment
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      StageName: !Ref StageName
      DeploymentId: !Ref Deployment
      Description: !Sub 'Stage ${StageName} of the ${AWS::StackName} WebSocket API'
      AccessLogSettings:
        DestinationArn: !GetAtt ApiGatewayLogGroup.Arn
        Format: '{"requestId":"$context.requestId","connectionId":"$context.connectionId","routeKey":"$context.routeKey","status":"$context.status","sourceIp":"$context.identity.sourceIp","requestTime":"$context.requestTime"}'
      DefaultRouteSettings:
        ThrottlingBurstLimit: 100
        ThrottlingRateLimit: 50

  ###############################################################################
  # IAM
  ###############################################################################

  # Role that API Gateway assumes to start an execution of the state machine.
  ApiGatewayInvocationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Allows API Gateway to start executions of the WebSocket state machine.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowApiGatewayToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartStateMachineExecution
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: StartExecutionOfWebSocketStateMachine
                Effect: Allow
                Action: 'states:StartExecution'
                Resource: !Ref StateMachine

  # Role that the state machine assumes to post messages back to the WebSocket clients.
  StateMachineExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Allows the WebSocket state machine to post messages to API Gateway connections.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowStepFunctionsToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ManageWebSocketConnections
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: PostToConnection
                Effect: Allow
                Action: 'execute-api:ManageConnections'
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${WebSocketApi}/${StageName}/POST/@connections/*'
        - PolicyName: WriteStateMachineLogs
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ManageCloudWatchLogDeliveries
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'logs:CreateLogDelivery'
                  - 'logs:GetLogDelivery'
                  - 'logs:UpdateLogDelivery'
                  - 'logs:DeleteLogDelivery'
                  - 'logs:ListLogDeliveries'
                  - 'logs:PutResourcePolicy'
                  - 'logs:DescribeResourcePolicies'
                  - 'logs:DescribeLogGroups'
                Resource: '*'

  ###############################################################################
  # Step Functions state machine
  ###############################################################################

  StateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineType: STANDARD
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StateMachineExecutionRole.Arn
      LoggingConfiguration:
        Destinations:
          - CloudWatchLogsLogGroup:
              LogGroupArn: !Sub '${StateMachineLogGroup.Arn}:*'
        IncludeExecutionData: false

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Daily EC2 Image Builder pipeline producing a CIS Level 1 hardened Amazon Linux 2023 ARM64 AMI for Elastic Beanstalk with a 50 GB encrypted root volume, org/account AMI sharing and a 180-day lifecycle policy.

Parameters:
  ParentImageArn:
    Type: String
    Default: 'arn:aws:imagebuilder:us-east-1:aws:image/amazon-linux-2023-arm64/x.x.x'
    AllowedPattern: '^(arn:aws[a-z\-]*:imagebuilder:[a-z0-9\-]+:(aws|[0-9]{12}):image/[A-Za-z0-9_./\-]+|ami-[0-9a-f]{8,17})$'
    ConstraintDescription: Image Builder image ARN or ARM64 AMI ID.
    Description: 'CIS-L1 hardened ARM64 parent image ARN/AMI; must exist or be shared into this account first. Default is the AWS managed AL2023 ARM64 Image Builder image.'
  OrganizationId:
    Type: String
    Default: 'o-xxxxxxxxxx'
    AllowedPattern: '^o-[a-z0-9]{10,32}$'
    ConstraintDescription: AWS Organizations ID such as o-abcdef0123.
    Description: Organization whose members may launch the AMI.
  DevAccountId:
    Type: String
    Default: '111111111111'
    AllowedPattern: '^[0-9]{12}$'
    ConstraintDescription: 12 digit AWS account ID.
    Description: Dev deployment account ID allowed to launch the AMI.
  ProdAccountId:
    Type: String
    Default: '222222222222'
    AllowedPattern: '^[0-9]{12}$'
    ConstraintDescription: 12 digit AWS account ID.
    Description: Prod deployment account ID allowed to launch the AMI.
  BuildScheduleCron:
    Type: String
    Default: 'cron(0 8 * * ? *)'
    AllowedPattern: '^cron\(.*\)$'
    ConstraintDescription: Image Builder cron such as cron(0 8 * * ? *).
    Description: Daily build schedule expression.
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: shared
    AllowedValues: [dev, prod, shared]
    Description: Environment label for names and tags.
  NotificationEmail:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional email subscribed to build notifications.

Conditions:
  HasNotificationEmail: !Not [!Equals [!Ref NotificationEmail, '']]

Resources:
  ImageBuilderKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'eb-al2023-arm64-cis-l1-${Environment} Image Builder key'
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      MultiRegion: false
      PendingWindowInDays: 30
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableAccountIamDelegation
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action:
              [kms:CreateGrant, kms:Decrypt, kms:DescribeKey, kms:Encrypt, kms:GenerateDataKey, kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext, kms:ReEncryptFrom, kms:ReEncryptTo]
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowImageBuilderPipelineRolesToUseTheKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action:
              [kms:CreateGrant, kms:Decrypt, kms:DescribeKey, kms:Encrypt, 'kms:GenerateDataKey*', kms:ReEncryptFrom, kms:ReEncryptTo]
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowSnsToEncryptTopicMessages
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sns.amazonaws.com
            Action: [kms:Decrypt, 'kms:GenerateDataKey*']
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:ViaService: !Sub 'sns.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      Tags:
        - {Key: Name, Value: !Sub 'eb-al2023-arm64-cis-l1-${Environment}-kms'}
        - {Key: Project, Value: eb-al2023-arm64-cis-l1}
        - {Key: Environment, Value: !Ref Environment}
        - {Key: ManagedBy, Value: CloudFormation}
        - {Key: Architecture, Value: arm64}
        - {Key: Compliance, Value: CIS-Level-1}

  ImageBuilderKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/eb-al2023-arm64-cis-l1-${Environment}-imagebuilder'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref ImageBuilderKey

  BuildVpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.42.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      InstanceTenancy: default
      Tags:
        - {Key: Name, Value: !Sub 'eb-al2023-arm64-cis-l1-${Environment}-vpc'}
        - {Key: Project, Value: eb-al2023-arm64-cis-l1}
        - {Key: Environment, Value: !Ref Environment}
        - {Key: ManagedBy, Value: CloudFormation}
        - {Key: Architecture, Value: arm64}
        - {Key: Compliance, Value: CIS-Level-1}

  BuildSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref BuildVpc
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: 10.42.0.0/24
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - {Key: Name, Value: !Sub 'eb-al2023-arm64-cis-l1-${Environment}-build-subnet'}
        - {Key: Project, Value: eb-al2023-arm64-cis-l1}
        - {Key: Environment, Value: !Ref Environment}
        - {Key: ManagedBy, Value: CloudFormation}
        - {Key: Architecture, Value: arm64}
        - {Key: Compliance, Value: CIS-Level-1}

  BuildInternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - {Key: Name, Value: !Sub 'eb-al2023-arm64-cis-l1-${Environment}-igw'}
        - {Key: Project, Value: eb-al2023-arm64-cis-l1}
        - {Key: Environment, Value: !Ref Environment}
        - {Key: ManagedBy, Value: CloudFormation}
        - {Key: Architecture, Value: arm64}
        - {Key: Compliance, Value: CIS-Level-1}

  BuildVpcGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref BuildInternetGateway
      VpcId: !Ref BuildVpc

  BuildRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref BuildVpc
      Tags:
        - {Key: Name, Value: !Sub 'eb-al2023-arm64-cis-l1-${Environment}-rt'}
        - {Key: Project, Value: eb-al2023-arm64-cis-l1}
        - {Key: Environment, Value: !Ref Environment}
        - {Key: ManagedBy, Value: CloudFormation}
        - {Key: Architecture, Value: arm64}
        - {Key: Compliance, Value: CIS-Level-1}

  BuildDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: BuildVpcGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref BuildRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref BuildInternetGateway

  BuildSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref BuildRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref BuildSubnet

  BuildSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: !Sub 'Image Builder build instances eb-al2023-arm64-cis-l1-${Environment}, HTTPS to VPC endpoints only'
      GroupName: !Sub 'eb-al2023-arm64-cis-l1-${Environment}-build-sg'
      VpcId: !Ref BuildVpc
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 10.42.0.0/16
          Description: HTTPS to in-VPC interface endpoints
      Tags:
        - {Key: Name, Value: !Sub 'eb-al2023-arm64-cis-l1-${Environment}-build-sg'}
        - {Key: Project, Value: eb-al2023-arm64-cis-l1}
        - {Key: Environment, Value: !Ref Environment}
        - {Key: ManagedBy, Value: CloudFormation}
        - {Key: Architecture, Value: arm64}
        - {Key: Compliance, Value: CIS-Level-1}

  BuildSecurityGroupSelfIngress:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref BuildSecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 443
      ToPort: 443
      SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref BuildSecurityGroup
      Description: HTTPS between build instances and shared endpoint ENIs

  S3Endpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
      VpcId: !Ref BuildVpc
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds: [!Ref BuildSubnet]
      SecurityGroupIds: [!Ref BuildSecurityGroup]

  SsmEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssm'
      VpcId: !Ref BuildVpc
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds: [!Ref BuildSubnet]
      SecurityGroupIds: [!Ref BuildSecurityGroup]

  SsmMessagesEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssmmessages'
      VpcId: !Ref BuildVpc
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds: [!Ref BuildSubnet]
      SecurityGroupIds: [!Ref BuildSecurityGroup]

  Ec2MessagesEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ec2messages'
      VpcId: !Ref BuildVpc
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds: [!Ref BuildSubnet]
      SecurityGroupIds: [!Ref BuildSecurityGroup]

  BuildLogBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - BucketKeyEnabled: true
            ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !Ref ImageBuilderKey
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: ExpireImageBuilderBuildLogs
            Status: Enabled
            ExpirationInDays: 365
            NoncurrentVersionExpiration:
              NoncurrentDays: 30
      Tags:
        - {Key: Name, Value: !Sub 'eb-al2023-arm64-cis-l1-${Environment}-imagebuilder-logs'}
        - {Key: Project, Value: eb-al2023-arm64-cis-l1}
        - {Key: Environment, Value: !Ref Environment}
        - {Key: ManagedBy, Value: CloudFormation}
        - {Key: Architecture, Value: arm64}
        - {Key: Compliance, Value: CIS-Level-1}

  BuildLogBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref BuildLogBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyUnencryptedTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt BuildLogBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${BuildLogBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'
          - Sid: AllowAccountReadWriteLogs
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action:
              - s3:ListBucket
              - s3:GetBucketLocation
              - s3:GetObject
              - s3:GetObjectVersion
              - s3:PutObject
              - s3:AbortMultipartUpload
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt BuildLogBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${BuildLogBucket.Arn}/*'

  BuildNotificationTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      TopicName: !Sub 'eb-al2023-arm64-cis-l1-${Environment}-imagebuilder-notifications'
      DisplayName: !Sub 'eb-al2023-arm64-cis-l1-${Environment} Image Builder notifications'
      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt ImageBuilderKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - {Key: Name, Value: !Sub 'eb-al2023-arm64-cis-l1-${Environment}-imagebuilder-notifications'}
        - {Key: Project, Value: eb-al2023-arm64-cis-l1}
        - {Key: Environment, Value: !Ref Environment}
        - {Key: ManagedBy, Value: CloudFormation}
        - {Key: Architecture, Value: arm64}
        - {Key: Compliance, Value: CIS-Level-1}

  BuildNotificationTopicPolicy:
    Type: AWS::SNS::TopicPolicy
    Properties:
      Topics: [!Ref BuildNotificationTopic]
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowOwnerAccountToManageTopic
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action:
              [sns:AddPermission, sns:DeleteTopic, sns:GetTopicAttributes, sns:ListSubscriptionsByTopic, sns:Publish, sns:RemovePermission, sns:SetTopicAttributes, sns:Subscribe]
            Resource: !Ref BuildNotificationTopic

  BuildNotificationSubscription:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Subscription
    Condition: HasNotificationEmail
    Properties:
      TopicArn: !Ref BuildNotificationTopic
      Protocol: email
      Endpoint: !Ref NotificationEmail

  ImageBuilderInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'eb-al2023-arm64-cis-l1-${Environment}-ib-instance'
      Description: Role assumed by Image Builder build instances.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/EC2InstanceProfileForImageBuilder'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ImageBuilderInstanceKmsAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: UseTemplateKeyForSnapshotsAndAmis
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  [kms:CreateGrant, kms:Decrypt, kms:DescribeKey, kms:Encrypt, kms:GenerateDataKey, kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext, kms:ReEncryptFrom, kms:ReEncryptTo]
                Resource: !GetAtt ImageBuilderKey.Arn
        - PolicyName: ImageBuilderInstanceLogBucketAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ReadWriteBuildLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action: [s3:AbortMultipartUpload, s3:GetObject, s3:GetObjectVersion, s3:ListBucket, s3:PutObject]
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt BuildLogBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub '${BuildLogBucket.Arn}/*'
        - PolicyName: ImageBuilderInstanceSsmAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ReadBuildParameters
                Effect: Allow
                Action: [ssm:DescribeParameters, ssm:GetParameter, ssm:GetParameterHistory, ssm:GetParameters]
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}::parameter/aws/service/*'
        - PolicyName: ImageBuilderInstanceCloudWatchLogsAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: WriteImageBuilderLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action: [logs:CreateLogGroup, logs:CreateLogStream, logs:DescribeLogStreams, logs:PutLogEvents]
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/imagebuilder/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/imagebuilder/*:log-stream:*'
      Tags:
        - {Key: Name, Value: !Sub 'eb-al2023-arm64-cis-l1-${Environment}-ib-instance'}
        - {Key: Project, Value: eb-al2023-arm64-cis-l1}
        - {Key: Environment, Value: !Ref Environment}
        - {Key: ManagedBy, Value: CloudFormation}
        - {Key: Architecture, Value: arm64}
        - {Key: Compliance, Value: CIS-Level-1}

  ImageBuilderInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub 'eb-al2023-arm64-cis-l1-${Environment}-ib-instance-profile'
      Roles: [!Ref ImageBuilderInstanceRole]

  ImageBuilderInfrastructureRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'eb-al2023-arm64-cis-l1-${Environment}-ib-infrastructure'
      Description: Service role used by EC2 Image Builder to run the pipeline.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: imagebuilder.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ImageBuilderServiceReadActions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ListImageBuilderObjects
                Effect: Allow
                Action: [imagebuilder:ListComponents, imagebuilder:ListImageBuildVersions, imagebuilder:ListImageRecipes, imagebuilder:ListImages, imagebuilder:ListTagsForResource]
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: GetImageBuilderObjects
                Effect: Allow
                Action: [imagebuilder:GetComponent, imagebuilder:GetDistributionConfiguration, imagebuilder:GetImage, imagebuilder:GetImageRecipe, imagebuilder:GetInfrastructureConfiguration]
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:imagebuilder:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:component/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:imagebuilder:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:distribution-configuration/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:imagebuilder:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:image/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:imagebuilder:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:image-recipe/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:imagebuilder:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:infrastructure-configuration/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:imagebuilder:${AWS::Region}:aws:component/*'
              - Sid: CreateAndDeleteImages
                Effect: Allow
                Action: [imagebuilder:CreateImage, imagebuilder:DeleteImage]
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:imagebuilder:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:image/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:imagebuilder:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:image-recipe/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:imagebuilder:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:component/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:imagebuilder:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:infrastructure-configuration/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:imagebuilder:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:distribution-configuration/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:imagebuilder:${AWS::Region}:aws:component/*'
        - PolicyName: ImageBuilderBuildInstanceEc2Actions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: RunBuildInstancesInTemplateNetwork
                Effect: Allow
                Action: [ec2:RunInstances]
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:instance/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:volume/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:network-interface/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:security-group/${BuildSecurityGroup}'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:subnet/${BuildSubnet}'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}::image/*'
              - Sid: TerminateBuildInstances
                Effect: Allow
                Action: [ec2:TerminateInstances]
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:instance/*'
              - Sid: TagBuildResources
                Effect: Allow
                Action: [ec2:CreateTags]
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:instance/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:volume/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:snapshot/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}::image/*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    ec2:CreateAction: [CreateImage, CreateSnapshot, RunInstances]
              - Sid: DescribeBuildResources
                Effect: Allow
                Action:

  ElasticBeanstalkPreconfigureComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'eb-al2023-arm64-cis-l1-${Environment}-eb-preconfigure'
      Description: Elastic Beanstalk compatibility pre-configuration for AL2023 ARM64.
      ChangeDescription: Initial Elastic Beanstalk pre-configuration
      Platform: Linux
      Version: 1.0.0
      SupportedOsVersions: [Amazon Linux 2023]
      Tags:
        Name: !Sub 'eb-al2023-arm64-cis-l1-${Environment}-eb-preconfigure'
        Project: eb-al2023-arm64-cis-l1
        Environment: !Ref Environment
        ManagedBy: CloudFormation
        Architecture: arm64
        Compliance: CIS-Level-1
      Data: |
        name: eb-al2023-arm64-eb-preconfigure
        description: Elastic Beanstalk pre-configuration for AL2023 ARM64
        schemaVersion: '1.0'
        phases:
          - name: build
            steps:
              - name: InstallDependencies
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - dnf -y --setopt=install_weak_deps=False install python3 python3-pip python3-devel python3-setuptools python3-wheel gcc gcc-c++ make git tar unzip gzip httpd nginx ruby ruby-devel rubygems
                    - alternatives --install /usr/bin/python python /usr/bin/python3 60 || true
                    - python3 -m pip install --upgrade pip setuptools wheel
              - name: InstallCfnBootstrapAndCfnHup
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - python3 -m pip install --upgrade 'https://s3.amazonaws.com/cloudformation-examples/aws-cfn-bootstrap-py3-latest.tar.gz'
                    - ln -sf /usr/local/bin/cfn-hup /usr/bin/cfn-hup
                    - ln -sf /usr/local/bin/cfn-init /usr/bin/cfn-init
                    - ln -sf /usr/local/bin/cfn-signal /usr/bin/cfn-signal
                    - mkdir -p /etc/cfn/hooks.d
                    - printf '[cfn-auto-reloader-hook]\ntriggers=post.update\npath=Resources.AWSEBInstanceLaunchWaitCondition.Metadata.AWS::CloudFormation::Init\naction=/usr/local/bin/cfn-init -v --stack STACK_NAME --resource AWSEBInstanceLaunchWaitCondition --region REGION\nrunas=root\n' > /etc/cfn/hooks.d/cfn-auto-reloader.conf
              - name: ConfigureElasticBeanstalkLayout
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - mkdir -p /etc/elasticbeanstalk/hooks/appdeploy/pre /opt/elasticbeanstalk/bin /opt/elasticbeanstalk/hooks /opt/elasticbeanstalk/deployment /var/app/current /var/app/staging /var/app/deploy /var/log/elasticbeanstalk /var/log/nginx /var/log/httpd
                    - touch /var/log/elasticbeanstalk/eb-engine.log
                    - chown -R root:root /opt/elasticbeanstalk /etc/elasticbeanstalk
                    - chmod -R 0755 /opt/elasticbeanstalk /etc/elasticbeanstalk
              - name: ConfigureCloudInitUserDataHooks
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - mkdir -p /etc/cloud/cloud.cfg.d
                    - printf 'datasource_list: [ Ec2, None ]\nmanual_cache_clean: false\n' > /etc/cloud/cloud.cfg.d/99-elasticbeanstalk.cfg
                    - mkdir -p /var/lib/cloud/scripts/per-instance
                    - systemctl enable cloud-init.service cloud-config.service cloud-final.service || true
              - name: EnableSsmAgentAndLogging
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - dnf -y install amazon-ssm-agent amazon-cloudwatch-agent
                    - systemctl enable amazon-ssm-agent || true
                    - printf '/var/log/elasticbeanstalk/*.log {\n daily\n rotate 14\n missingok\n notifempty\n compress\n copytruncate\n}\n' > /etc/logrotate.d/elasticbeanstalk
          - name: validate
            steps:
              - name: ValidateElasticBeanstalkPrerequisites
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - command -v python3
                    - python3 --version
                    - command -v cfn-hup
                    - command -v cfn-signal
                    - test -d /etc/elasticbeanstalk
                    - test -d /opt/elasticbeanstalk
                    - test -d /var/log/elasticbeanstalk
                    - command -v httpd || command -v nginx
                    - rpm -q amazon-ssm-agent

  VulnerabilityScanComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'eb-al2023-arm64-cis-l1-${Environment}-vulnerability-scan'
      Description: Applies security errata and fails the build when security advisories remain.
      ChangeDescription: Initial vulnerability scan
      Platform: Linux
      Version: 1.0.0
      SupportedOsVersions: [Amazon Linux 2023]
      Tags:
        Name: !Sub 'eb-al2023-arm64-cis-l1-${Environment}-vulnerability-scan'
        Project: eb-al2023-arm64-cis-l1
        Environment: !Ref Environment
        ManagedBy: CloudFormation
        Architecture: arm64
        Compliance: CIS-Level-1
      Data: |
        name: eb-al2023-arm64-vulnerability-scan
        description: Applies security errata and fails on outstanding advisories
        schemaVersion: '1.0'
        phases:
          - name: build
            steps:
              - name: ApplySecurityErrata
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - dnf -y makecache
                    - dnf -y --security update || dnf -y update-minimal --security || dnf -y update
                    - dnf -y install dnf-plugins-core
                    - dnf -y clean all
          - name: test
            steps:
              - name: FailOnOutstandingSecurityAdvisories
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - dnf -y makecache || true
                    - pending=$(dnf -q updateinfo list --security 2>/dev/null | grep -cE 'Critical|Important|Moderate|Low'); echo "pending=$pending"; if [ "$pending" -gt 0 ]; then dnf -q updateinfo list --security; exit 1; fi

  ImageBuilderImageRecipe:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'eb-al2023-arm64-cis-l1-${Environment}-recipe'
      Description: CIS L1 hardened AL2023 ARM64 EB base recipe with a 50 GB encrypted root volume.
      Version: 1.0.0
      ParentImage: !Ref ParentImageArn
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !Ref ElasticBeanstalkPreconfigureComponent
        - ComponentArn: !Ref VulnerabilityScanComponent
        - ComponentArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:imagebuilder:${AWS::Region}:aws:component/update-linux/x.x.x'
        - ComponentArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:imagebuilder:${AWS::Region}:aws:component/reboot-linux/x.x.x'
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            DeleteOnTermination: true
            Encrypted: true
            KmsKeyId: !Ref ImageBuilderKey
            VolumeSize: 50
            VolumeType: gp3

      Tags:

        Project: eb-al2023-arm64-cis-l1
        Environment: !Ref Environment
        ManagedBy: CloudFormation
        Architecture: arm64
        Compliance: CIS-Level-1

  ImageBuilderPipeline:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImagePipeline
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'eb-al2023-arm64-cis-l1-${Environment}-pipeline'

        Project: eb-al2023-arm64-cis-l1
        Environment: !Ref Environment

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Serverless Maths MCP (Model Context Protocol) testing stack: Amazon Cognito user pool
  and app client, a Python 3.12 Lambda function, and a regional Amazon API Gateway REST API
  with a Cognito-secured POST /mcp endpoint, a CORS OPTIONS preflight, and a public GET /
  health check. All dependencies are created inline - no external or pre-existing resources.

Parameters:
  DeploymentStage:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    Description: Deployment stage/environment name used for the API Gateway stage.
  UserPoolName:
    Type: String
    Default: maths-mcp-users
    Description: Name of the Cognito user pool used to authenticate MCP callers.
  AppClientName:
    Type: String
    Default: maths-mcp-client
    Description: Name of the Cognito user pool app client used by MCP clients.

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Cognito user pool (email as username, email auto-verified) + app client
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Ref UserPoolName
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: false

  UserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Ref AppClientName
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      # Public client (no secret) so browser/CLI test clients can authenticate directly.
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      # Cognito defaults: access/ID token validity in hours, refresh token validity in days.
      AccessTokenValidity: 1
      IdTokenValidity: 1
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lambda execution role (CloudWatch Logs only via AWS managed policy)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Maths MCP Lambda function
  # Placeholder inline handler - to be replaced with the real MCP implementation later.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MathsMcpFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-maths-mcp'
      Description: Maths MCP server placeholder handler (to be updated with real MCP logic).
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 512
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          USER_POOL_ID: !Ref UserPool
          USER_POOL_CLIENT_ID: !Ref UserPoolClient
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json

          def handler(event, context):
              # Placeholder handler - replaced later by the real Maths MCP implementation.
              return {
                  "statusCode": 200,
                  "headers": {
                      "Content-Type": "application/json"
                  },
                  "body": json.dumps({
                      "status": "ok",
                      "service": "maths-mcp",
                      "message": "Placeholder maths MCP handler"
                  })
              }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # API Gateway REST API (regional), Cognito authorizer, methods, stage
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  RestApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-maths-mcp-api'
      Description: Regional REST API fronting the Maths MCP Lambda function.
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL

  CognitoAuthorizer:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Authorizer
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cognito-authorizer'
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      Type: COGNITO_USER_POOLS
      IdentitySource: method.request.header.Authorization
      ProviderARNs:
        - !GetAtt UserPool.Arn

  McpResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt RestApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: mcp

  # Secured POST /mcp -> Lambda (AWS_PROXY)
  McpPostMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref McpResource
      HttpMethod: POST
      AuthorizationType: COGNITO_USER_POOLS
      AuthorizerId: !Ref CognitoAuthorizer
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${MathsMcpFunction.Arn}/invocations'

  # CORS preflight OPTIONS /mcp (no auth, mock integration)
  McpOptionsMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref McpResource
      HttpMethod: OPTIONS
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: MOCK
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: '{"statusCode": 200}'
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: '200'
            ResponseParameters:
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: "'*'"
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: "'Authorization,Content-Type'"
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: "'OPTIONS,POST'"
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: '200'
          ResponseParameters:
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: true
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: true
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: true

  # Public GET / health check -> Lambda (AWS_PROXY)
  HealthCheckGetMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ResourceId: !GetAtt RestApi.RootResourceId
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${MathsMcpFunction.Arn}/invocations'

  # Allow API Gateway to invoke the Maths MCP Lambda, scoped to this API's execute-api ARN
  MathsMcpInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref MathsMcpFunction
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${RestApi}/*/*'

  # Deployment must snapshot the methods, which have no Ref-able identity to order against
  ApiDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - McpPostMethod
      - McpOptionsMethod
      - HealthCheckGetMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      Description: Deployment snapshot of the Maths MCP API methods.

  ApiStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Stage
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      DeploymentId: !Ref ApiDeployment
      StageName: !Ref DeploymentStage
      Description: !Sub 'Maths MCP API stage for the ${DeploymentStage} environment.'

Outputs:
  ApiInvokeUrl:
    Description: Base invoke URL for the Maths MCP API (append /mcp for the secured endpoint).
    Value: !Sub 'https://${RestApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${DeploymentStage}'
  UserPoolId:
    Description: Cognito user pool ID used to authenticate MCP callers.
    Value: !Ref UserPool
  UserPoolClientId:
    Description: Cognito app client ID used by test clients.
    Value: !Ref UserPoolClient

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  SageMaker RAPIDS AI notebook environment. Creates a self-contained
  notebook instance ("rapidsai", ml.t3.medium, 50 GB) with a SageMaker
  execution IAM role, a KMS key for volume encryption, a lifecycle
  configuration that installs a RAPIDS AI conda environment and registers a
  Jupyter kernel on create and on start, and a SageMaker code repository that
  clones https://github.com/rapidsai/notebooks. No pre-existing infrastructure
  is required.

Resources:

  SageMakerRAPIDSNotebookRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: SageMakerRAPIDSNotebookRole
      Description: Execution role used by the RAPIDS AI SageMaker notebook instance
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowSageMakerServiceToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sagemaker.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSageMakerFullAccess
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: RAPIDS-AI

  SageMakerRAPIDSKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key used to encrypt the RAPIDS AI SageMaker notebook volume
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowSageMakerNotebookRoleUsage
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !GetAtt SageMakerRAPIDSNotebookRole.Arn
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncryptFrom
              - kms:ReEncryptTo
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:CreateGrant
            Resource: '*'

  RAPIDSNotebooksCodeRepository:
    Type: AWS::SageMaker::CodeRepository
    Properties:
      CodeRepositoryName: rapidsai-notebooks
      GitConfig:
        RepositoryUrl: https://github.com/rapidsai/notebooks

  RAPIDSLifecycleConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::SageMaker::NotebookInstanceLifecycleConfig
    Properties:
      NotebookInstanceLifecycleConfigName: rapidsai-lifecycle-config
      OnCreate:
        - Content: !Base64 |
            #!/bin/bash
            set -e
            sudo -u ec2-user bash -c '
            set -e
            export HOME=/home/ec2-user
            cd $HOME
            curl -fsSL https://repo.anaconda.com/miniconda/Miniconda3-latest-Linux-x86_64.sh -o /tmp/miniconda.sh
            bash /tmp/miniconda.sh -b -p $HOME/miniconda3
            rm -f /tmp/miniconda.sh
            source $HOME/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
            conda create -y -n rapids -c rapidsai -c conda-forge -c nvidia rapids python=3.10 cudatoolkit=11.8 ipykernel
            conda activate rapids
            python -m ipykernel install --user --name rapids --display-name "RAPIDS"
            '
      OnStart:
        - Content: !Base64 |
            #!/bin/bash
            set -e
            sudo -u ec2-user bash -c '
            set -e
            export HOME=/home/ec2-user
            cd $HOME
            if [ -x $HOME/miniconda3/bin/conda ]; then
              source $HOME/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
              conda activate rapids
              python -m ipykernel install --user --name rapids --display-name "RAPIDS"
            fi
            '

  RAPIDSAINotebookInstance:
    Type: AWS::SageMaker::NotebookInstance
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      NotebookInstanceName: rapidsai
      InstanceType: ml.t3.medium
      VolumeSizeInGB: 50
      RoleArn: !GetAtt SageMakerRAPIDSNotebookRole.Arn
      LifecycleConfigName: !Ref RAPIDSLifecycleConfiguration
      DefaultCodeRepository: !Ref RAPIDSNotebooksCodeRepository
      KmsKeyId: !Ref SageMakerRAPIDSKmsKey
      RootAccess: Enabled
      DirectInternetAccess: Enabled
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: RAPIDS-AI

Outputs:
  NotebookInstanceName:
    Description: Name of the RAPIDS AI SageMaker notebook instance
    Value: !Ref RAPIDSAINotebookInstance
  NotebookInstanceArn:
    Description: ARN of the RAPIDS AI SageMaker notebook instance
    Value: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:notebook-instance/${RAPIDSAINotebookInstance}'
