final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Self-contained ECS Fargate microservice with private Cloud Map service discovery.
  Provisions its own VPC (public + two private subnets across two AZs), internet and
  NAT gateways, ECS cluster, task execution/task IAM roles, CloudWatch logs, Cloud Map
  private DNS namespace and SRV service, plus application auto scaling between 2 and 10
  tasks driven by dedicated scale-out and scale-in CloudWatch alarms. AWS service access
  for image pull and logging is provided through VPC endpoints so container security
  group egress can remain restricted to the VPC CIDR.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 20
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be 1-20 characters of letters, numbers, or hyphens.
    Description: Environment name used to prefix and namespace stack resources.

  ServiceName:
    Type: String
    Default: webapp
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 40
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be 1-40 characters of letters, numbers, or hyphens.
    Description: Name of the microservice (used for the ECS service, Cloud Map service and log group).

  ContainerImage:
    Type: String
    Default: nginx
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 255
    Description: Container image (repository name, repository:tag, or full registry URI) to run.

  ContainerPort:
    Type: Number
    Default: 80
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 65535
    Description: TCP port the container listens on.

  TaskCpu:
    Type: String
    Default: '512'
    AllowedValues:
      - '256'
      - '512'
      - '1024'
      - '2048'
      - '4096'
    Description: Fargate task CPU units (0.25 vCPU = 256).

  TaskMemory:
    Type: String
    Default: '1024'
    AllowedValues:
      - '512'
      - '1024'
      - '2048'
      - '3072'
      - '4096'
      - '8192'
      - '16384'
    Description: Fargate task memory in MiB (must be valid for the selected CPU).

  DesiredCount:
    Type: Number
    Default: 2
    MinValue: 2
    MaxValue: 10
    Description: Desired number of running tasks for the ECS service.

  CustomTaskRoleArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^(|arn:aws[a-zA-Z-]*:iam::\d{12}:role/.+)$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a valid IAM role ARN.
    Description: >-
      Optional. ARN of an existing IAM role that is external to this stack. When supplied,
      the task role created here is granted sts:AssumeRole on it so containers can access
      other AWS resources. Never used as infrastructure reference.

Conditions:
  HasCustomRole: !Not
    - !Equals [!Ref CustomTaskRoleArn, '']

Resources:

  ###############################################################################
  # Networking - VPC
  ###############################################################################
  Vpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      InstanceTenancy: default
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-vpc'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-igw'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  InternetGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  ###############################################################################
  # Public tier
  ###############################################################################
  PublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/24
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-public-subnet'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: public
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-public-rt'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: public

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet

  ###############################################################################
  # Private tier (two AZs) + NAT egress
  ###############################################################################
  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-private-subnet-1'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: private
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-private-subnet-2'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: private
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NatElasticIp:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-nat-eip'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatElasticIp.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-nat-gw'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-private-rt'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: private

  PrivateRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  ###############################################################################
  # Security groups - containers and VPC endpoints
  # Egress is restricted to the VPC CIDR; AWS service traffic is handled by the
  # VPC endpoints below so no all-IPs egress rule is required.
  ###############################################################################
  ContainerSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-tasks-sg'
      GroupDescription: !Sub 'Container traffic for ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName} tasks'
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: !Ref ContainerPort
          ToPort: !Ref ContainerPort
          CidrIp: !GetAtt Vpc.CidrBlock
          Description: Allow container port traffic from within the VPC CIDR
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: '-1'
          CidrIp: !GetAtt Vpc.CidrBlock
          Description: Allow egress only within the VPC CIDR (endpoints, NAT, peers)
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-tasks-sg'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  VpcEndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-endpoints-sg'
      GroupDescription: !Sub 'HTTPS access to VPC endpoints for ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}'
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref ContainerSecurityGroup
          Description: Allow HTTPS from the container tasks
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !GetAtt Vpc.CidrBlock
          Description: Allow HTTPS responses within the VPC CIDR
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-endpoints-sg'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  ###############################################################################
  # VPC endpoints - keep ECR image pull and CloudWatch Logs reachable without
  # any unrestricted egress rule.
  ###############################################################################
  EcrApiVpcEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ecr.api'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup

  EcrDkrVpcEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ecr.dkr'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup

  LogsVpcEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.logs'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup

  S3GatewayVpcEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  ###############################################################################
  # Logging
  ###############################################################################
  ServiceLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/ecs/${EnvironmentName}/${ServiceName}'
      RetentionInDays: 30
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  ###############################################################################
  # IAM
  ###############################################################################
  TaskExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-task-execution-role'
      Description: !Sub 'ECS task execution role for ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowEcsTasksToAssume
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonECSTaskExecutionRolePolicy'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  TaskRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-task-role'
      Description: !Sub 'Application task role for ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowEcsTasksToAssume
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  # Grants the created task role permission to assume the externally-managed custom
  # role. The custom role itself lives outside this stack and is never referenced
  # as infrastructure (no IDs, ARNs, or SSM/Secrets lookups are embedded).
  CustomRoleAssumePolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Condition: HasCustomRole
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-assume-custom-role'
      Roles:
        - !Ref TaskRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowAssumeOfExternalCustomRole
            Effect: Allow
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Resource: !Ref CustomTaskRoleArn

  ###############################################################################
  # ECS cluster, task definition and service
  ###############################################################################
  EcsCluster:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Cluster
    Properties:
      ClusterName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-cluster'
      ClusterSettings:
        - Name: containerInsights
          Value: enabled
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  TaskDefinition:
    Type: AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition
    Properties:
      Family: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}'
      NetworkMode: awsvpc
      RequiresCompatibilities:
        - FARGATE
      Cpu: !Ref TaskCpu
      Memory: !Ref TaskMemory
      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt TaskExecutionRole.Arn
      TaskRoleArn: !GetAtt TaskRole.Arn
      ContainerDefinitions:
        - Name: !Ref ServiceName
          Image: !Ref ContainerImage
          Essential: true
          PortMappings:
            - ContainerPort: !Ref ContainerPort
              Protocol: tcp
          LogConfiguration:
            LogDriver: awslogs
            Options:
              awslogs-group: !Ref ServiceLogGroup
              awslogs-region: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
              awslogs-stream-prefix: !Ref ServiceName
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  ###############################################################################
  # Cloud Map - private DNS namespace and SRV service
  ###############################################################################
  ServiceDiscoveryNamespace:
    Type: AWS::ServiceDiscovery::PrivateDnsNamespace
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}.local'
      Description: !Sub 'Private DNS namespace for the ${EnvironmentName} environment'
      Vpc: !GetAtt Vpc.VpcId
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  ServiceDiscoveryService:
    Type: AWS::ServiceDiscovery::Service
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref ServiceName
      Description: !Sub 'Service discovery entry for ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}'
      NamespaceId: !Ref ServiceDiscoveryNamespace
      DnsConfig:
        RoutingPolicy: MULTIVALUE
        DnsRecords:
          - Type: SRV
            TTL: 10
      HealthCheckCustomConfig:
        FailureThreshold: 1
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  EcsService:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Service
    DependsOn:
      - ServiceDiscoveryService
      - PrivateRoute
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Ref ServiceName
      Cluster: !Ref EcsCluster
      LaunchType: FARGATE
      DesiredCount: !Ref DesiredCount
      DeploymentConfiguration:
        MaximumPercent: 200
        MinimumHealthyPercent: 100
      NetworkConfiguration:
        AwsvpcConfiguration:
          AssignPublicIp: DISABLED
          Subnets:
            - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
            - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
          SecurityGroups:
            - !Ref ContainerSecurityGroup
      ServiceRegistries:
        - RegistryArn: !GetAtt ServiceDiscoveryService.Arn
      TaskDefinition: !Ref TaskDefinition
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  ###############################################################################
  # Application Auto Scaling - target, policies and alarms
  ###############################################################################
  ServiceScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Properties:
      MinCapacity: 2
      MaxCapacity: 10
      ResourceId: !Sub 'service/${EcsCluster}/${EcsService.Name}'
      ScalableDimension: ecs:service:DesiredCount
      ServiceNamespace: ecs
      RoleARN: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aws-service-role/ecs.application-autoscaling.amazonaws.com/AWSServiceRoleForApplicationAutoScaling_ECSService'

  ScaleOutPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-scale-out'
      PolicyType: StepScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref ServiceScalableTarget
      StepScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        AdjustmentType: ChangeInCapacity
        MetricAggregationType: Average
        Cooldown: 60
        StepAdjustments:
          - MetricIntervalLowerBound: 0
            MetricIntervalUpperBound: 20
            ScalingAdjustment: 1
          - MetricIntervalLowerBound: 20
            MetricIntervalUpperBound: 40
            ScalingAdjustment: 2
          - MetricIntervalLowerBound: 40
            ScalingAdjustment: 3

  ScaleInPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-scale-in'
      PolicyType: StepScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref ServiceScalableTarget
      StepScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        AdjustmentType: ChangeInCapacity
        MetricAggregationType: Average
        Cooldown: 300
        StepAdjustments:
          - MetricIntervalUpperBound: 0
            ScalingAdjustment: -1

  ScaleOutAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-cpu-high'
      AlarmDescription: !Sub 'Scale out ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName} when average ECS CPUUtilization is at or above 70 percent'
      Namespace: AWS/ECS
      MetricName: CPUUtilization
      Statistic: Average
      Unit: Percent
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 2
      Threshold: 70
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ClusterName
          Value: !Ref EcsCluster
        - Name: ServiceName
          Value: !GetAtt EcsService.Name
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref ScaleOutPolicy

  ScaleInAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-cpu-low'
      AlarmDescription: !Sub 'Scale in ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName} when average ECS CPUUtilization is at or below 20 percent'
      Namespace: AWS/ECS
      MetricName: CPUUtilization
      Statistic: Average
      Unit: Percent
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 3
      DatapointsToAlarm: 3
      Threshold: 20
      ComparisonOperator: LessThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ClusterName
          Value: !Ref EcsCluster
        - Name: ServiceName
          Value: !GetAtt EcsService.Name
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref ScaleInPolicy

Outputs:
  EcsClusterName:
    Description: Name of the ECS cluster hosting the microservice.
    Value: !Ref EcsCluster

  EcsServiceName:
    Description: Name of the ECS service.
    Value: !GetAtt EcsService.Name

  ServiceDiscoveryDnsName:
    Description: Private DNS name (SRV record) used to discover the service inside the VPC.
    Value: !Sub '${ServiceName}.${EnvironmentName}.local'

  ServiceDiscoveryServiceArn:
    Description: ARN of the Cloud Map service used for discovery.
    Value: !GetAtt ServiceDiscoveryService.Arn

  VpcId:
    Description: ID of the VPC created for the microservice.
    Value: !Ref Vpc

  PublicSubnetId:
    Description: ID of the public subnet (NAT gateway / internet egress).
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet

  PrivateSubnetIds:
    Description: Comma-separated IDs of the two private subnets that host the Fargate tasks.
    Value: !Join [',', [!Ref PrivateSubnet1, !Ref PrivateSubnet2]]

  ContainerSecurityGroupId:
    Description: ID of the security group attached to the Fargate tasks.
    Value: !Ref ContainerSecurityGroup

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Self-contained AWS network backbone for hybrid interconnect demonstrations with
  an OCI primary region. Provisions a VPC with DNS support/hostnames, an internet
  gateway and gateway attachment, a private subnet in the first available AZ, a
  route table with a default route to the IGW, a transit gateway with a VPC
  attachment (explicit route table association/propagation), a security group that
  allows HTTPS only from an internal CIDR and HTTPS only to the OCI backbone CIDR,
  an optional OCI customer gateway and static-route VPN connection, a transit
  gateway route for OCI traffic, and KMS-encrypted VPC flow logs delivered to a
  CloudWatch log group with 30-day retention.

Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.94.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block assigned to the VPC.
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2]))$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block.

  PrivateSubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.94.10.0/24
    Description: CIDR block assigned to the private subnet.
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2]))$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block.

  InternalClientCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/8
    Description: Internal client CIDR range permitted to reach workloads over HTTPS (TCP 443).
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2]))$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block.

  OciBackboneCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.200.0.0/16
    Description: OCI primary region backbone CIDR range used for egress and the transit gateway route.
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2]))$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block.

  OciVpnEndpointIp:
    Type: String
    Default: 203.0.113.10
    Description: Public IP address of the OCI VPN headend used by the customer gateway.
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 address.

  Tunnel1InsideCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 169.254.10.0/30
    Description: Inside CIDR for the first IPSec tunnel endpoints.
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2]))$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block.

  Tunnel2InsideCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 169.254.11.0/30
    Description: Inside CIDR for the second IPSec tunnel endpoints.
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2]))$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block.

  CreateVpnConnection:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Whether to create the customer gateway and static-route VPN connection to OCI.

Conditions:
  CreateVpn: !Equals
    - !Ref CreateVpnConnection
    - 'true'

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      InstanceTenancy: default
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-oci-hybrid-vpc'
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: oci-hybrid-interconnect

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-igw'

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PrivateSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnetCidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet'

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-rt'

  PrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  DefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  TransitGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGateway
    Properties:
      Description: Transit gateway for OCI hybrid interconnect demonstrations
      AmazonSideAsn: 64512
      AutoAcceptSharedAttachments: disable
      DefaultRouteTableAssociation: disable
      DefaultRouteTablePropagation: disable
      DnsSupport: enable
      VpnEcmpSupport: enable
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-tgw'

  TransitGatewayRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTable
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-tgw-rt'

  TransitGatewayVpcAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayVpcAttachment
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-tgw-vpc-attachment'

  TransitGatewayRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref TransitGatewayVpcAttachment
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable

  TransitGatewayRouteTablePropagation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTablePropagation
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref TransitGatewayVpcAttachment
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable

  TransitGatewayRouteToOci:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRoute
    Properties:
      Blackhole: false
      DestinationCidrBlock: !Ref OciBackboneCidr
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref TransitGatewayVpcAttachment
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable

  AppSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Allow HTTPS ingress from the internal client CIDR and HTTPS egress to the OCI backbone CIDR only.
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref InternalClientCidr
          Description: HTTPS from internal client CIDR
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref OciBackboneCidr
          Description: HTTPS to OCI backbone CIDR
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-app-sg'

  OciCustomerGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::CustomerGateway
    Condition: CreateVpn
    Properties:
      Type: ipsec.1
      BgpAsn: 65000
      IpAddress: !Ref OciVpnEndpointIp
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-oci-cgw'

  OciVpnConnection:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPNConnection
    Condition: CreateVpn
    Properties:
      Type: ipsec.1
      StaticRoutesOnly: true
      CustomerGatewayId: !Ref OciCustomerGateway
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      VpnTunnelOptionsSpecifications:
        - TunnelInsideCidr: !Ref Tunnel1InsideCidr
        - TunnelInsideCidr: !Ref Tunnel2InsideCidr
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-oci-vpn'

  FlowLogKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:

      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:

            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogs
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:

              - kms:Decrypt*
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Describe*

            Condition:

  FlowLogKeyAlias:

  FlowLogGroup:

  FlowLogRole:

      Description: Allows VPC Flow Logs to publish to CloudWatch Logs using the customer managed KMS key.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com

      Policies:

            Statement:

                Effect: Allow
                Action:

                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt FlowLogGroup.Arn
                  - !Sub '${FlowLogGroup.Arn}:*'
              - Sid: KmsForFlowLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogKey.Arn

  VpcFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceType: VPC
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogRole.Arn
      MaxAggregationInterval: 60
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc-flow-log'

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Provisions a self-contained test DynamoDB table (on-demand billing, point-in-time
  recovery enabled) along with a comprehensive set of CloudWatch alarms that monitor
  its health and performance, plus an SNS topic used as the notification target for
  every alarm. The alarm topic is encrypted with a customer managed KMS key that is
  also created in-stack (with an account-administration statement and a CloudWatch
  publishing statement), so notifications keep working end to end. All resources -
  KMS key, KMS alias, table, topic, subscription and alarms - are defined in
  this template; no pre-existing infrastructure, external ARNs, SSM/Secrets lookups,
  cross-stack imports or account-specific IDs are referenced (greenfield account).

Parameters:
  TableNameSuffix:
    Type: String
    Default: test-table
    Description: >-
      Suffix appended to the stack name to build the DynamoDB table name.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]{3,40}$'
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      Must be 3-40 characters and contain only letters, numbers, underscore,
      dot or hyphen.

  AlarmNamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: dynamodb
    Description: >-
      Prefix inserted between the stack name and the metric name in every
      CloudWatch alarm name, so the alarm set is identifiable per stack.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,30}$'
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      Must be 1-30 characters and contain only letters, numbers, underscore
      or hyphen.

  NotificationEmail:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: >-
      Optional. Email address subscribed to the alarm SNS topic. Leave empty
      to deploy without any subscription.

Conditions:
  HasNotificationEmail: !Not [!Equals [!Ref NotificationEmail, '']]

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Customer managed KMS key used to encrypt the alarm notification topic.
  # Created in-stack (greenfield account) - never a pre-existing key or alias.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AlarmTopicKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Customer managed key encrypting the ${AWS::StackName} DynamoDB alarm notification topic.'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIAMPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchAlarmsToPublishToEncryptedTopic
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:ViaService: !Sub 'sns.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
                kms:CallerAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'

  AlarmTopicKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-dynamodb-alarms'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref AlarmTopicKey

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Alarm notification target (created in-stack - no external topic ARN exists)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AlarmTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      TopicName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-dynamodb-alarms'
      DisplayName: DynamoDB table alarms
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref AlarmTopicKey

  AlarmEmailSubscription:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Subscription
    Condition: HasNotificationEmail
    Properties:
      TopicArn: !Ref AlarmTopic
      Protocol: email
      Endpoint: !Ref NotificationEmail

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Test DynamoDB table: single HASH key "USER_ID", on-demand billing, PITR on
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DynamoDbTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-${TableNameSuffix}'
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: USER_ID
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: USER_ID
          KeyType: HASH
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Count-based alarms (Sum statistic, threshold 1)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  WriteThrottleEventsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-${AlarmNamePrefix}-WriteThrottleEvents'
      AlarmDescription: !Sub 'Write throttle events on DynamoDB table ${DynamoDbTable}.'
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: WriteThrottleEvents
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref DynamoDbTable
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic

  ThrottledRequestsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-${AlarmNamePrefix}-ThrottledRequests'
      AlarmDescription: !Sub 'Throttled requests on DynamoDB table ${DynamoDbTable}.'
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: ThrottledRequests
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref DynamoDbTable
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic

  ConditionalCheckFailedRequestsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-${AlarmNamePrefix}-ConditionalCheckFailedRequests'
      AlarmDescription: !Sub 'Conditional check failures on DynamoDB table ${DynamoDbTable}.'
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: ConditionalCheckFailedRequests
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref DynamoDbTable
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic

  UserErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-${AlarmNamePrefix}-UserErrors'
      AlarmDescription: !Sub 'User errors returned by DynamoDB table ${DynamoDbTable}.'
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: UserErrors
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref DynamoDbTable
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic

  SystemErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-${AlarmNamePrefix}-SystemErrors'
      AlarmDescription: !Sub 'System errors returned by DynamoDB table ${DynamoDbTable}.'
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: SystemErrors
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref DynamoDbTable
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic

  TransactionConflictAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-${AlarmNamePrefix}-TransactionConflict'
      AlarmDescription: !Sub 'Transaction conflicts on DynamoDB table ${DynamoDbTable}.'
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: TransactionConflict
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref DynamoDbTable
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic

  # Threshold is 10 (not 1) because brief online index backfill throttling is
  # expected behaviour and only sustained throttling should page.
  OnlineIndexThrottleEventsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-${AlarmNamePrefix}-OnlineIndexThrottleEvents'
      AlarmDescription: !Sub 'Online index throttle events on DynamoDB table ${DynamoDbTable}.'
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: OnlineIndexThrottleEvents
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 10
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref DynamoDbTable
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Latency alarm (Average, threshold 100 ms)
  #
  # NOTE: SuccessfulRequestLatency is published per Operation. A representative
  # operation (GetItem) is used here via the Operation dimension. If other
  # operations must be watched, duplicate this alarm once per operation name
  # (Query, PutItem, UpdateItem, ...) instead of removing the dimension.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SuccessfulRequestLatencyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-${AlarmNamePrefix}-SuccessfulRequestLatency'
      AlarmDescription: !Sub 'Average successful request latency >= 100 ms on DynamoDB table ${DynamoDbTable} (GetItem).'
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: SuccessfulRequestLatency
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 100
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref DynamoDbTable
        - Name: Operation
          Value: GetItem
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Account-level capacity utilization alarms (Average, threshold 85 %)
  #
  # NOTE: AccountProvisionedReadCapacityUtilization and
  # AccountProvisionedWriteCapacityUtilization are account-scoped metrics and
  # take no dimensions. An alarm with no Dimensions is valid, but these metrics
  # only carry meaningful data for provisioned-capacity tables, so on the
  # on-demand table created here they will report INSUFFICIENT_DATA.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AccountProvisionedReadCapacityUtilizationAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-${AlarmNamePrefix}-AccountProvisionedReadCapacityUtilization'
      AlarmDescription: >-
        Account-level provisioned read capacity utilization >= 85%. Account-scoped
        metric (no TableName dimension); meaningful only for provisioned capacity.
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: AccountProvisionedReadCapacityUtilization
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 85
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic

  AccountProvisionedWriteCapacityUtilizationAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-${AlarmNamePrefix}-AccountProvisionedWriteCapacityUtilization'
      AlarmDescription: >-
        Account-level provisioned write capacity utilization >= 85%. Account-scoped
        metric (no TableName dimension); meaningful only for provisioned capacity.
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: AccountProvisionedWriteCapacityUtilization
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 85
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Table-level consumed capacity utilization alarms (Average, threshold 85 %)
  #
  # NOTE: ConsumedReadCapacityUtilization / ConsumedWriteCapacityUtilization are
  # only emitted for provisioned-capacity tables. Because this table uses
  # on-demand (PAY_PER_REQUEST) billing these alarms will sit in
  # INSUFFICIENT_DATA unless the table is switched to provisioned capacity.
  # They are created as requested and are not faked with extra resources.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ConsumedReadCapacityUtilizationAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-${AlarmNamePrefix}-ConsumedReadCapacityUtilization'
      AlarmDescription: !Sub 'Consumed read capacity utilization >= 85% on DynamoDB table ${DynamoDbTable}.'
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: ConsumedReadCapacityUtilization
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 85
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref DynamoDbTable
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic

  ConsumedWriteCapacityUtilizationAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-${AlarmNamePrefix}-ConsumedWriteCapacityUtilization'
      AlarmDescription: !Sub 'Consumed write capacity utilization >= 85% on DynamoDB table ${DynamoDbTable}.'
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: ConsumedWriteCapacityUtilization
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 85
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref DynamoDbTable
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Replication alarms (Average, 5 evaluation periods, 3 datapoints to alarm)
  #
  # NOTE: PendingReplicationCount and ReplicationLatency are only emitted for
  # DynamoDB global tables (i.e. when a replica exists in a second region). This
  # stack creates a single-region table, so these alarms will report
  # INSUFFICIENT_DATA until a global-table replica is added; no extra replica
  # resources are invented here.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PendingReplicationCountAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-${AlarmNamePrefix}-PendingReplicationCount'
      AlarmDescription: !Sub 'Pending replication count >= 100 on DynamoDB global table ${DynamoDbTable}.'
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: PendingReplicationCount
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 5
      DatapointsToAlarm: 3
      Threshold: 100
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref DynamoDbTable
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic

  ReplicationLatencyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-${AlarmNamePrefix}-ReplicationLatency'
      AlarmDescription: !Sub 'Replication latency >= 10 ms on DynamoDB global table ${DynamoDbTable}.'
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: ReplicationLatency
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 5
      DatapointsToAlarm: 3
      Threshold: 10
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref DynamoDbTable
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic

Outputs:
  DynamoDbTableName:
    Description: Name of the test DynamoDB table created by this stack.
    Value: !Ref DynamoDbTable

  DynamoDbTableArn:
    Description: ARN of the test DynamoDB table created by this stack.
    Value: !GetAtt DynamoDbTable.Arn

  AlarmTopicArn:
    Description: ARN of the SNS topic that receives every DynamoDB alarm notification.
    Value: !Ref AlarmTopic

  AlarmTopicKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the customer managed KMS key encrypting the alarm SNS topic.
    Value: !GetAtt AlarmTopicKey.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  PiBot authentication stack. Provisions two independent Amazon Cognito setups:
  WebApp (main web application) and Provisioning (AWS IoT trusted user
  provisioning), each with its own user pool, user pool client, identity pool,
  IAM roles and identity-pool role attachments.

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: pibot
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 32
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9-]*$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must start with an alphanumeric character and contain only alphanumerics and hyphens.
    Description: Prefix used to name the Cognito resources created by this template.

Resources:

  ##########################################################################
  # WebApp - User Pool
  ##########################################################################
  WebAppUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-webapp-userpool'
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: false
        UnusedAccountValidityDays: 7
      MfaConfiguration: 'OFF'
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 12
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1

  WebAppUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-webapp-client'
      UserPoolId: !Ref WebAppUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      EnableTokenRevocation: true
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: false

  WebAppIdentityPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-webapp-identitypool'
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: true
      CognitoIdentityProviders:
        - ClientId: !Ref WebAppUserPoolClient
          ProviderName: !GetAtt WebAppUserPool.ProviderName
          ServerSideTokenCheck: true

  ##########################################################################
  # WebApp - IAM Roles
  ##########################################################################
  WebAppAuthRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-webapp-auth-role'
      Description: Authenticated role assumed by WebApp identity pool users.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud: !Ref WebAppIdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr: authenticated
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: WebAppIoTDataAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iot:Connect
                  - iot:Publish
                  - iot:Subscribe
                  - iot:Receive
                  - iot:GetThingShadow
                  - iot:UpdateThingShadow
                  - iot:DeleteThingShadow
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iot:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'
        - PolicyName: WebAppKinesisVideoAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kinesisvideo:DescribeStream
                  - kinesisvideo:GetDataEndpoint
                  - kinesisvideo:PutMedia
                  - kinesisvideo:GetMedia
                  - kinesisvideo:GetMediaForFragmentList
                  - kinesisvideo:ListFragments
                  - kinesisvideo:ListStreams
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:kinesisvideo:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'
        - PolicyName: WebAppRekognitionAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - rekognition:DetectLabels
                  - rekognition:DetectModerationLabels
                  - rekognition:DetectFaces
                Resource: '*'
        - PolicyName: WebAppCognitoMobileAnalyticsAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-sync:*
                  - cognito-identity:GetId
                  - cognito-identity:GetCredentialsForIdentity
                  - cognito-identity:GetOpenIdToken
                  - cognito-identity:GetOpenIdTokenForDeveloperIdentity
                  - cognito-identity:DescribeIdentity
                  - cognito-identity:ListIdentities
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - mobileanalytics:PutEvents
                Resource: '*'

  WebAppUnauthRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-webapp-unauth-role'
      Description: Unauthenticated (guest) role assumed by WebApp identity pool users.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud: !Ref WebAppIdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr: unauthenticated
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: WebAppGuestCognitoMobileAnalyticsAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-sync:*
                  - cognito-identity:GetId
                  - cognito-identity:GetCredentialsForIdentity
                  - cognito-identity:GetOpenIdToken
                  - cognito-identity:DescribeIdentity
                  - cognito-identity:ListIdentities
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - mobileanalytics:PutEvents
                Resource: '*'

  WebAppIdentityPoolRoleAttachment:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolRoleAttachment
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolId: !Ref WebAppIdentityPool
      Roles:
        authenticated: !GetAtt WebAppAuthRole.Arn
        unauthenticated: !GetAtt WebAppUnauthRole.Arn

  ##########################################################################
  # Provisioning - User Pool
  ##########################################################################
  ProvisioningUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-provisioning-userpool'
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: true
        UnusedAccountValidityDays: 7
      MfaConfiguration: 'OFF'
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 12
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1

  ProvisioningUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-provisioning-client'
      UserPoolId: !Ref ProvisioningUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      EnableTokenRevocation: true
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: false

  ProvisioningIdentityPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-provisioning-identitypool'
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: false
      CognitoIdentityProviders:
        - ClientId: !Ref ProvisioningUserPoolClient
          ProviderName: !GetAtt ProvisioningUserPool.ProviderName
          ServerSideTokenCheck: true

  ##########################################################################
  # Provisioning - IAM Role
  ##########################################################################
  ProvisioningAuthRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-provisioning-auth-role'
      Description: Authenticated role for AWS IoT trusted user provisioning.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud: !Ref ProvisioningIdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr: authenticated
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ProvisioningIoTTrustedUserProvisioningAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iot:GetUser
                  - iot:CreateUser
                  - iot:UpdateUser
                  - iot:DeleteUser
                  - iot:DescribeUser
                  - iot:AssociateUser
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iot:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:user/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iot:ListUsers
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iot:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iot:AttachPolicy
                  - iot:DetachPolicy
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iot:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'

  ProvisioningIdentityPoolRoleAttachment:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolRoleAttachment
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolId: !Ref ProvisioningIdentityPool
      Roles:
        authenticated: !GetAtt ProvisioningAuthRole.Arn

##########################################################################
# Outputs
##########################################################################
Outputs:
  WebAppIdentityPoolId:
    Description: Identity pool ID for the PiBot main web application.
    Value: !Ref WebAppIdentityPool
  WebAppUserPoolId:
    Description: User pool ID for the PiBot main web application.
    Value: !Ref WebAppUserPool
  WebAppUserPoolClientId:
    Description: User pool client ID for the PiBot main web application.
    Value: !Ref WebAppUserPoolClient
  ProvisioningIdentityPoolId:
    Description: Identity pool ID for PiBot IoT trusted user provisioning.
    Value: !Ref ProvisioningIdentityPool
  ProvisioningUserPoolId:
    Description: User pool ID for PiBot IoT trusted user provisioning.
    Value: !Ref ProvisioningUserPool
  ProvisioningUserPoolClientId:
    Description: User pool client ID for PiBot IoT trusted user provisioning.
    Value: !Ref ProvisioningUserPoolClient
