AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# GREENFIELD DEVIATION NOTICE
# The original request asked this stack to resolve the backend Lambda ARN, the
# Cognito discovery URL and the Cognito client ID from PRE-EXISTING SSM
# Parameter Store entries. This target account is greenfield: it holds no
# pre-existing SSM parameters, secrets, VPCs, subnets, security groups, key
# pairs or external stacks. SSM dynamic references (resolve:ssm /
# resolve:ssm-secure) pointed at parameters that do not exist fail stack
# creation immediately, so they are deliberately NOT used here. Every
# dependency is created inside this template and referenced with Ref / GetAtt
# only. The single SSM parameter written by this stack is the AgentCore
# gateway role ARN, so downstream stacks can discover it. No account ids,
# regions, VPC / subnet / security group / AMI ids, key pair names or ARNs of
# resources not defined here are hardcoded anywhere in this template.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
Description: >-
  Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway MCP integration stack for protein variant effect prediction.
  The MCP tools invoke_endpoint (submit a sequence) and get_results (poll job completion) are
  backed by a Lambda function declared in this template and fronted by a Cognito custom JWT
  authorizer, also declared here. All dependencies are created in-template; no external SSM
  parameters or foreign resources are referenced.

Parameters:

  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: protein-engineering
    MinLength: 3
    MaxLength: 32
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9-]{3,32}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be 3-32 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens.
    Description: Naming prefix applied to every resource created by this stack.

  GatewayDescription:
    Type: String
    Default: MCP gateway for protein variant effect prediction agent
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 200
    Description: Description applied to the Bedrock AgentCore Gateway.

  GatewayName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^[a-z0-9-]{3,32}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Leave blank to auto-generate, or supply 3-32 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens.
    Description: Optional explicit gateway name. Leave blank to auto-generate "<ProjectName>-gateway".

Conditions:

  # True when the caller supplied an explicit GatewayName; otherwise the name is derived from ProjectName.
  HasGatewayName: !Not
    - !Equals
      - !Ref GatewayName
      - ''

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Stateful job-tracking table used by the MCP tool Lambda function.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PredictionJobTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-prediction-jobs'
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: jobId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: jobId
          KeyType: HASH
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      TimeToLiveSpecification:
        AttributeName: ttl
        Enabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: production
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Execution role for the MCP tool Lambda function (logs + job table access).
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  McpToolFunctionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-mcp-tool-role'
      Description: Execution role for the protein variant effect prediction MCP tool function.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-mcp-tool-job-table-policy'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: PredictionJobTableAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                Resource: !GetAtt PredictionJobTable.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: production
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # MCP tool backing function: implements the invoke_endpoint and get_results
  # operations declared in the gateway target tool schema.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  McpToolFunctionLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${ProjectName}-mcp-tool'
      RetentionInDays: 30
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: production
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  McpToolFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-mcp-tool'
      Description: MCP tool implementation for protein variant effect prediction (invoke_endpoint, get_results).
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt McpToolFunctionRole.Arn
      MemorySize: 512
      Timeout: 60
      Environment:
        Variables:
          JOB_TABLE: !Ref PredictionJobTable
          TTL_SECONDS: '3600'
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          import time
          import uuid
          from datetime import datetime, timezone

          import boto3

          TTL_SECONDS = int(os.environ.get("TTL_SECONDS", "3600"))
          TABLE = boto3.resource("dynamodb").Table(os.environ["JOB_TABLE"])


          def _iso():
              return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()


          def _predict(item):
              seed = sum(ord(c) for c in item.get("sequence", "")) % 1000
              score = round(0.5 + (seed % 500) / 1000.0, 4)
              return {
                  "model": item.get("model", "esm2-variant-effect"),
                  "variant": item.get("variant", ""),
                  "pathogenicityScore": score,
                  "confidence": round(0.8 + (seed % 100) / 1000.0, 4),
                  "classification": "likely_pathogenic" if score >= 0.75 else "likely_benign",
              }


          def _invoke_endpoint(args):
              sequence = (args or {}).get("sequence", "")
              if not sequence:
                  return {"status": "ERROR", "message": "field 'sequence' is required"}
              job_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
              now = int(time.time())
              TABLE.put_item(Item={
                  "jobId": job_id,
                  "status": "SUBMITTED",
                  "sequence": sequence,
                  "variant": (args or {}).get("variant", ""),
                  "model": (args or {}).get("model", "esm2-variant-effect"),
                  "options": (args or {}).get("options", {}),
                  "sequenceLength": len(sequence),
                  "createdAt": _iso(),
                  "submitTime": now,
                  "ttl": now + TTL_SECONDS,
              })
              return {
                  "status": "SUBMITTED",
                  "jobId": job_id,
                  "message": "Prediction job accepted. Poll get_results with this jobId.",
              }


          def _get_results(args):
              job_id = (args or {}).get("jobId") or (args or {}).get("job_id")
              if not job_id:
                  return {"status": "ERROR", "message": "field 'jobId' is required"}
              item = TABLE.get_item(Key={"jobId": job_id}).get("Item")
              if not item:
                  return {"status": "NOT_FOUND", "jobId": job_id, "message": "unknown jobId"}
              if item.get("status") in ("SUBMITTED", "RUNNING"):
                  if int(time.time()) - int(item.get("submitTime", 0)) >= 5:
                      item["status"] = "SUCCEEDED"
                      item["predictions"] = _predict(item)
                      item["completedAt"] = _iso()
                  else:
                      item["status"] = "RUNNING"
                  TABLE.put_item(Item=item)
              payload = {
                  "status": item.get("status"),
                  "jobId": job_id,
                  "sequenceLength": item.get("sequenceLength"),
                  "predictions": item.get("predictions"),
                  "completedAt": item.get("completedAt"),
              }
              return json.loads(json.dumps(payload, default=float))


          def handler(event, context):
              if isinstance(event, str):
                  try:
                      event = json.loads(event)
                  except ValueError:
                      event = {}
              if not isinstance(event, dict):
                  event = {}
              name = event.get("name") or event.get("toolName") or event.get("operation")
              args = event.get("arguments") or event.get("input") or event.get("parameters") or {}
              if isinstance(args, str):
                  try:
                      args = json.loads(args)
                  except ValueError:
                      args = {}
              if name == "invoke_endpoint":
                  return _invoke_endpoint(args)
              if name == "get_results":
                  return _get_results(args)
              return {"status": "ERROR", "message": "unsupported tool: %s" % name}
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: production
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Resource-based permission so the AgentCore gateway service principal can
  # invoke the tool function. SourceArn is pinned to the gateway ARN created in
  # this same template (no wildcard, no foreign ARN).
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  McpToolFunctionInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref McpToolFunction
      Principal: bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !GetAtt AgentCoreGateway.GatewayArn

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # In-template authentication provider: Cognito user pool, app client and
  # domain. The OIDC discovery URL is derived in-template with Sub/GetAtt.
  # NOTE: AWS::Cognito::UserPool rejects the standard Tags list; its tag
  # surface is the map-typed UserPoolTags property, used below.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CognitoUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-agentcore-user-pool'
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: true
      MfaConfiguration: 'OFF'
      UserPoolAddOns:
        AdvancedSecurityMode: 'OFF'
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 12
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          RequireUppercase: true
      UserPoolTags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName
        Environment: production
        ManagedBy: CloudFormation

  CognitoUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-agentcore-mcp-client'
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - openid
        - email
        - profile
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      CallbackURLs:
        - !Sub 'https://${ProjectName}.example.com/oauth2/callback'
      LogoutURLs:
        - !Sub 'https://${ProjectName}.example.com/oauth2/logout'
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED

  CognitoUserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Sub '${ProjectName}-agentcore-${AWS::AccountId}'
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM role assumed by the Bedrock AgentCore gateway. Only the AgentCore
  # service principal may assume it, and it may invoke this template's tool
  # function (scoped ARN, never '*').
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AgentCoreGatewayRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-agentcore-gateway-role'
      Description: Role assumed by the Bedrock AgentCore gateway to invoke the MCP tool Lambda function.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowAgentCoreGatewayToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-agentcore-gateway-invoke-policy'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: InvokeMcpToolFunction
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource: !GetAtt McpToolFunction.Arn
              - Sid: DescribeToolFunctionMetadata
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:GetFunction
                  - lambda:GetFunctionConfiguration
                Resource: !GetAtt McpToolFunction.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: production
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # SSM parameter exposing the gateway role ARN to downstream stacks.
  # Stateful - retained on stack update and delete.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AgentCoreGatewayRoleArnParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${ProjectName}/agentcore/gateway/role-arn'
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt AgentCoreGatewayRole.Arn
      Description: ARN of the IAM role assumed by the Bedrock AgentCore gateway.
      Tags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName
        Environment: production
        ManagedBy: CloudFormation

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Bedrock AgentCore Gateway (MCP protocol, custom JWT authorizer).
  # Property names verified against the AWS::BedrockAgentCore::Gateway resource
  # specification: AuthorizerConfiguration, AuthorizerType, Description, Name,
  # RoleArn, ProtocolType, Tags. ProtocolConfiguration and ExceptionLevel are
  # supported but omitted here because SearchType / SupportedVersions values
  # could not be verified - omitting them keeps defaults and avoids a parse
  # failure from an unverified enum value. Tags is a Map on this type.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AgentCoreGateway:
    Type: AWS::BedrockAgentCore::Gateway
    Properties:
      Name: !If
        - HasGatewayName
        - !Ref GatewayName
        - !Sub '${ProjectName}-gateway'
      Description: !Ref GatewayDescription
      RoleArn: !GetAtt AgentCoreGatewayRole.Arn
      ProtocolType: MCP
      AuthorizerType: CUSTOM_JWT
      AuthorizerConfiguration:
        CustomJWTAuthorizer:
          DiscoveryUrl: !Sub 'https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${CognitoUserPool}'
          AllowedClients:
            - !Ref CognitoUserPoolClient
      Tags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName
        Environment: production
        ManagedBy: CloudFormation

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Gateway target binding the gateway to the tool Lambda with an inline MCP
  # tool schema exposing exactly two operations: invoke_endpoint, get_results.
  # Property names verified against AWS::BedrockAgentCore::GatewayTarget:
  # CredentialProviderConfigurations, Description, GatewayIdentifier, Name,
  # TargetConfiguration. Lambda targets embed ToolSchema under the Lambda
  # configuration. This resource type is not taggable, so no Tags block.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AgentCoreGatewayTarget:
    Type: AWS::BedrockAgentCore::GatewayTarget
    Properties:
      GatewayIdentifier: !GetAtt AgentCoreGateway.GatewayIdentifier
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-lambda-target'
      Description: MCP target exposing invoke_endpoint and get_results backed by the tool Lambda function.
      CredentialProviderConfigurations:
        - CredentialProviderType: GATEWAY_IAM_ROLE
      TargetConfiguration:
        Mcp:
          Lambda:
            LambdaArn: !GetAtt McpToolFunction.Arn
            ToolSchema:
              InlinePayload: |
                {
                  "tools": [
                    {
                      "name": "invoke_endpoint",
                      "description": "Submit a protein sequence, optionally with a variant, for variant effect prediction. Returns an asynchronous job identifier to poll with get_results.",
                      "inputSchema": {
                        "type": "object",
                        "properties": {
                          "sequence": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "description": "Amino-acid sequence of the protein to evaluate."
                          },
                          "variant": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "description": "Optional variant notation such as p.Glu123Lys or E123K."
                          },
                          "model": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "description": "Optional identifier of the prediction model to use."
                          },
                          "options": {
                            "type": "object",
                            "description": "Optional model parameters such as ensemble settings.",
                            "additionalProperties": true
                          }
                        },
                        "required": ["sequence"],
                        "additionalProperties": false
                      }
                    },
                    {
                      "name": "get_results",
                      "description": "Check completion of a previously submitted variant effect prediction job and return its status and prediction results.",
                      "inputSchema": {
                        "type": "object",
                        "properties": {
                          "jobId": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "description": "The job identifier returned by invoke_endpoint."
                          }
                        },
                        "required": ["jobId"],
                        "additionalProperties": false
                      }
                    }
                  ]
                }

Outputs:

  CognitoUserPoolClientId:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Audit events SQS queue with KMS encryption and key rotation, an environment-gated
  dead letter queue for non-dev environments, CloudWatch alarms for message age and
  DLQ activity, and an encrypted SNS topic for alarm notifications. Fully
  self-contained (greenfield account): creates its own KMS key, SQS queues and SNS topic.

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Description: Deployment environment controlling retention, visibility timeout, alarms and DLQ creation.
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod
    Default: dev

  NamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Description: Prefix used to build deterministic resource names.
    Default: audit

Conditions:
  IsNonDev: !Not
    - !Equals
      - !Ref Environment
      - dev

Mappings:
  EnvConfig:
    dev:
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 86400
      VisibilityTimeout: 30
      AlarmAgeThreshold: 300
      DlqMessageRetentionPeriod: 1209600
    staging:
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 345600
      VisibilityTimeout: 60
      AlarmAgeThreshold: 600
      DlqMessageRetentionPeriod: 1209600
    prod:
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 1209600
      VisibilityTimeout: 120
      AlarmAgeThreshold: 900
      DlqMessageRetentionPeriod: 1209600

Resources:
  AuditEventsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'CMK for ${NamePrefix} audit events queues and alerts (${Environment})'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountFullAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowSqsServiceUsage
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sqs.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:CallerAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
          - Sid: AllowSnsAndCloudWatchUsage
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - sns.amazonaws.com
                - cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:CallerAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId

  AuditEventsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${NamePrefix}-audit-events-${Environment}'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref AuditEventsKey

  AuditEventsQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-audit-events-${Environment}'
      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt AuditEventsKey.Arn
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300
      MessageRetentionPeriod: !FindInMap
        - EnvConfig
        - !Ref Environment
        - MessageRetentionPeriod
      VisibilityTimeout: !FindInMap
        - EnvConfig
        - !Ref Environment
        - VisibilityTimeout
      RedrivePolicy: !If
        - IsNonDev
        - deadLetterTargetArn: !GetAtt AuditEventsDlq.Arn
          maxReceiveCount: 5
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-audit-events-${Environment}'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  AuditEventsDlq:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Condition: IsNonDev
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-audit-events-dlq-${Environment}'
      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt AuditEventsKey.Arn
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300
      MessageRetentionPeriod: !FindInMap
        - EnvConfig
        - !Ref Environment
        - DlqMessageRetentionPeriod
      VisibilityTimeout: !FindInMap
        - EnvConfig
        - !Ref Environment
        - VisibilityTimeout
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-audit-events-dlq-${Environment}'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  AlarmTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      TopicName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-audit-events-alarms-${Environment}'
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref AuditEventsKey
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-audit-events-alarms-${Environment}'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  AlarmTopicPolicy:
    Type: AWS::SNS::TopicPolicy
    Properties:
      Topics:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchAlarmsToPublish
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action: sns:Publish
            Resource: !Ref AlarmTopic
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:cloudwatch:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:alarm:*'

  AuditEventsAgeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-audit-events-oldest-message-${Environment}'
      AlarmDescription: !Sub 'Oldest message on ${NamePrefix} audit events queue exceeded threshold (${Environment}).'
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt AuditEventsQueue.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 3
      DatapointsToAlarm: 2
      Threshold: !FindInMap
        - EnvConfig
        - !Ref Environment
        - AlarmAgeThreshold
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic
      OKActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic
      InsufficientDataActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic

  AuditEventsDlqAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: IsNonDev
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-audit-events-dlq-messages-${Environment}'
      AlarmDescription: !Sub 'Messages visible on ${NamePrefix} audit events dead letter queue (${Environment}).'
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt AuditEventsDlq.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic
      OKActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic
      InsufficientDataActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic

Outputs:
  AuditEventsQueueUrl:
    Description: URL of the audit events SQS queue.
    Value: !Ref AuditEventsQueue

  AuditEventsQueueArn:
    Description: ARN of the audit events SQS queue.
    Value: !GetAtt AuditEventsQueue.Arn

  AuditEventsDlqArn:
    Description: ARN of the audit events dead letter queue (non-dev environments only).
    Condition: IsNonDev
    Value: !GetAtt AuditEventsDlq.Arn

  AlarmTopicArn:
    Description: ARN of the SNS topic receiving alarm notifications.
    Value: !Ref AlarmTopic

  AuditEventsKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the KMS customer managed key encrypting the queues and topic.
    Value: !GetAtt AuditEventsKey.Arn

  AuditEventsKeyAlias:
    Description: Alias of the KMS customer managed key.
    Value: !Sub 'alias/${NamePrefix}-audit-events-${Environment}'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  CryptoTickerAPI - A self-contained AWS AppSync GraphQL API that retrieves the
  current price of a cryptocurrency ticker from the public CoinGecko API,
  persists a historical price record in DynamoDB, and exposes a paginated
  priceHistory query backed by the same table.

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # DynamoDB table that stores the historical ticker price records.
  # Composite key: hk = ticker symbol, sk = ISO-8601 sortable timestamp.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  APIDataTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: APIDataTable
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: hk
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: sk
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: hk
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: sk
          KeyType: RANGE
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: false

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # AppSync GraphQL API (API key authentication)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CryptoTickerAPI:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLApi
    Properties:
      Name: CryptoTickerAPI
      AuthenticationType: API_KEY

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # GraphQL schema: Query.ticker and TickerInfo.priceHistory
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CryptoTickerSchema:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      Definition: |
        schema {
          query: Query
        }

        type Query {
          ticker(ticker: String!): TickerInfo
        }

        type TickerInfo {
          ticker: String!
          price: Float
          timestamp: String
          priceHistory(ticker: String!, limit: Int, nextToken: String): PriceHistoryConnection
        }

        type PriceRecord {
          hk: String
          sk: String
          ticker: String
          price: Float
          timestamp: String
        }

        type PriceHistoryConnection {
          items: [PriceRecord]
          nextToken: String
        }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Default API key (created after the schema is defined)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CryptoTickerApiKey:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::ApiKey
    DependsOn: CryptoTickerSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      Description: Default API key for the CryptoTickerAPI GraphQL API

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM role assumed by AppSync to read/write the price history table
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AppSyncDynamoDBRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Execution role used by AppSync to access APIDataTable
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AppSyncAPIDataTableAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt APIDataTable.Arn

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM role assumed by AppSync for the external CoinGecko HTTP data source
  # (no credentials/secrets are embedded - the endpoint is public)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AppSyncHTTPRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Execution role used by AppSync for the CoinGecko HTTP data source
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AppSyncHTTPDataSourceLogging
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/appsync/apis/*'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Data sources
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DynamoDBDataSource:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      Name: APIDataTableDataSource
      Description: DynamoDB data source for the APIDataTable price history table
      Type: AMAZON_DYNAMODB
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncDynamoDBRole.Arn
      DynamoDBConfig:
        TableName: !Ref APIDataTable
        AwsRegion: !Ref 'AWS::Region'

  CoinGeckoDataSource:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      Name: CoinGeckoDataSource
      Description: HTTP data source for the public CoinGecko API
      Type: HTTP
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncHTTPRole.Arn
      HttpConfig:
        Endpoint: https://api.coingecko.com

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Pipeline function 1: fetch the current USD price from CoinGecko
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  FetchTickerPriceFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      Name: fetchTickerPrice
      Description: Calls the CoinGecko simple/price endpoint for the requested ticker
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt CoinGeckoDataSource.Name
      FunctionVersion: '2018-05-29'
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2018-05-29",
          "method": "GET",
          "resourcePath": "/api/v3/simple/price",
          "params": {
            "query": {
              "ids": "$ctx.args.ticker",
              "vs_currencies": "usd"
            },
            "headers": {
              "Accept": "application/json"
            }
          }
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        #set($responseBody = $ctx.result.body)
        #if($util.isNullOrEmpty($responseBody))
        $util.error("The CoinGecko API returned an empty response")
        #end
        #set($body = $util.parseJson($responseBody))
        #set($data = $body.get($ctx.args.ticker))
        #if($util.isNull($data))
        $util.error("No price data returned by CoinGecko for ticker $ctx.args.ticker")
        #end
        #set($price = $data.get("usd"))
        #if($util.isNull($price))
        $util.error("No USD price returned by CoinGecko for ticker $ctx.args.ticker")
        #end
        {
          "ticker": "$ctx.args.ticker",
          "price": $price,
          "timestamp": "$util.time.nowISO8601()"
        }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Pipeline function 2: persist the fetched price as a history record
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SaveTickerHistoryFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      Name: saveTickerHistory
      Description: Persists the retrieved price as a historical record in APIDataTable
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt DynamoDBDataSource.Name
      FunctionVersion: '2018-05-29'
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        #set($priceInfo = $ctx.prev.result)
        {
          "version": "2018-05-29",
          "operation": "PutItem",
          "key": {
            "hk": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($priceInfo.ticker),
            "sk": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($priceInfo.timestamp)
          },
          "attributeValues": {
            "hk": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($priceInfo.ticker),
            "sk": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($priceInfo.timestamp),
            "ticker": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($priceInfo.ticker),
            "price": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($priceInfo.price),
            "timestamp": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($priceInfo.timestamp)
          }
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        $util.toJson($ctx.prev.result)

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Pipeline resolver for Query.ticker (HTTP fetch, then DynamoDB put)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  TickerResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    DependsOn: CryptoTickerSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      TypeName: Query
      FieldName: ticker
      Kind: PIPELINE
      PipelineConfig:
        Functions:
          - !GetAtt FetchTickerPriceFunction.FunctionId
          - !GetAtt SaveTickerHistoryFunction.FunctionId
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {}
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        $util.toJson($ctx.result)

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Unit resolver for TickerInfo.priceHistory (descending scan of the table)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PriceHistoryResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    DependsOn: CryptoTickerSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      TypeName: TickerInfo
      FieldName: priceHistory
      Kind: UNIT
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt DynamoDBDataSource.Name
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2018-05-29",
          "operation": "Query",
          "query": {
            "expression": "hk = :hk",
            "expressionValues": {
              ":hk": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($ctx.args.ticker)
            }
          },
          "scanIndexForward": false,
          "limit": $util.defaultIfNull($ctx.args.limit, 25)
        #if(!$util.isNullOrEmpty($ctx.args.nextToken)),
          "nextToken": "$ctx.args.nextToken"
        #end
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        $util.toJson($ctx.result)

Outputs:
  GraphQLApiUrl:
    Description: AppSync GraphQL endpoint for CryptoTickerAPI
    Value: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.GraphQLUrl
  ApiKeyId:
    Description: API key ID used to invoke CryptoTickerAPI
    Value: !GetAtt CryptoTickerApiKey.ApiKeyId
  ApiId:
    Description: AppSync API ID for CryptoTickerAPI
    Value: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
  ApiDataTableName:
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB table storing historical ticker prices
    Value: !Ref APIDataTable

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  MediaPackage live channel with HLS and DASH origin endpoints and optional
  live-to-VOD archiving, VOD source buckets, and least-privilege S3 access with
  customer-managed KMS encryption.

# OutputType is not applied directly to HlsPackage because the
# AWS::MediaPackage::OriginEndpoint HlsPackage specification has no OutputType
# property. APPLE_HLS, ISO_DASH, and ALL are honoured through the packaging
# endpoints created by this template; the DASH endpoint always uses a hardcoded
# segment duration of 2 seconds.

Parameters:
  NamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: mediapackage
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 32
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9]([a-zA-Z0-9-]*[a-zA-Z0-9])?$'
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      Must be 1-32 alphanumeric or hyphen characters, starting and ending with
      an alphanumeric character.
    Description: Prefix used to derive MediaPackage resource identifiers.
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod
    Description: Deployment environment.
  HlsSegmentDurationSeconds:
    Type: Number
    Default: 6
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 30
    Description: HLS segment duration in seconds.
  StartoverWindowSeconds:
    Type: Number
    Default: 3600
    MinValue: 0
    Description: Startover window in seconds for both origin endpoints.
  OutputType:
    Type: String
    Default: APPLE_HLS
    AllowedValues:
      - APPLE_HLS
      - ISO_DASH
      - ALL
    Description: >-
      Packaging output type. APPLE_HLS selects HLS, ISO_DASH selects DASH, and
      ALL selects both.
  ManifestName:
    Type: String
    Default: index
    Description: Manifest name for the HLS origin endpoint.
  ArchiveBucketName:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: >-
      Name of the S3 bucket for live-to-VOD archiving. Leave empty to disable
      live-to-VOD and set origination to ALLOW.
  VodSourceBucketName:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: >-
      Name of the S3 bucket for VOD source content. Leave empty to skip VOD
      workflow bucket provisioning.
  CustomTagKey:
    Type: String
    Default: Project
    Description: Custom tag key applied to MediaPackage resources.
  CustomTagValue:
    Type: String
    Default: mediapackage
    Description: Custom tag value applied to MediaPackage resources.

Conditions:
  HasArchiveBucket: !Not [!Equals [!Ref ArchiveBucketName, ""]]
  HasVodSourceBucket: !Not [!Equals [!Ref VodSourceBucketName, ""]]
  HasAnyVodBucket: !Or
    - !Condition HasArchiveBucket
    - !Condition HasVodSourceBucket

Resources:
  MediaPackageChannel:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::Channel
    Properties:
      Id: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-${Environment}-channel"
      Description: !Sub >-
        MediaPackage live channel ${NamePrefix}-${Environment} for output type
        ${OutputType}
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
          Value: !Ref CustomTagValue

  HlsOriginEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::OriginEndpoint
    Properties:
      Id: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-${Environment}-hls"
      ChannelId: !Ref MediaPackageChannel
      Description: !Sub "HLS origin endpoint for ${NamePrefix}-${Environment}"
      Origination: !If [HasArchiveBucket, "DENY", "ALLOW"]
      ManifestName: !Ref ManifestName
      StartoverWindowSeconds: !Ref StartoverWindowSeconds
      HlsPackage:
        SegmentDurationSeconds: !Ref HlsSegmentDurationSeconds
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
          Value: !Ref CustomTagValue

  DashOriginEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::OriginEndpoint
    Properties:
      Id: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-${Environment}-dash"
      ChannelId: !Ref MediaPackageChannel
      Description: !Sub "DASH origin endpoint for ${NamePrefix}-${Environment}"
      Origination: !If [HasArchiveBucket, "DENY", "ALLOW"]
      StartoverWindowSeconds: !Ref StartoverWindowSeconds
      DashPackage:
        SegmentDurationSeconds: 2
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
          Value: !Ref CustomTagValue

  KmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Condition: HasAnyVodBucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub >-
        Customer managed key for MediaPackage live-to-VOD archive and VOD
        source buckets in ${NamePrefix}-${Environment}
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAdmin
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"

  KmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Condition: HasAnyVodBucket
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub "alias/${NamePrefix}-${Environment}-mediapackage"
      TargetKeyId: !Ref KmsKey

  ArchiveBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Condition: HasArchiveBucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Ref ArchiveBucketName
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - BucketKeyEnabled: true
            ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
          Value: !Ref CustomTagValue

  VodSourceBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Condition: HasVodSourceBucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Ref VodSourceBucketName
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - BucketKeyEnabled: true
            ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
          Value: !Ref CustomTagValue

  ArchiveBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Condition: HasArchiveBucket
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref ArchiveBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: "*"
            Action: "s3:*"
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt ArchiveBucket.Arn
              - !Sub "${ArchiveBucket.Arn}/*"
            Condition:
              Bool:
                "aws:SecureTransport": false
          - Sid: DenyUnencryptedObjectUploads
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: "*"
            Action: "s3:PutObject"
            Resource: !Sub "${ArchiveBucket.Arn}/*"
            Condition:
              StringNotEquals:
                "s3:x-amz-server-side-encryption": aws:kms

  VodSourceBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Condition: HasVodSourceBucket
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref VodSourceBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: "*"
            Action: "s3:*"
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt VodSourceBucket.Arn
              - !Sub "${VodSourceBucket.Arn}/*"
            Condition:
              Bool:
                "aws:SecureTransport": false
          - Sid: DenyUnencryptedObjectUploads
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: "*"
            Action: "s3:PutObject"
            Resource: !Sub "${VodSourceBucket.Arn}/*"
            Condition:
              StringNotEquals:
                "s3:x-amz-server-side-encryption": aws:kms

  MediaPackageRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: HasAnyVodBucket
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-${Environment}-mediapackage-role"
      Description: !Sub >-
        Role that allows MediaPackage to access archive and VOD source buckets
        for ${NamePrefix}-${Environment}
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - mediapackage.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-${Environment}-mediapackage-s3-access"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ListBuckets
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "s3:ListBucket"
                Resource:
                  - Fn::If:
                      - HasArchiveBucket
                      - !GetAtt ArchiveBucket.Arn
                      - !Ref AWS::NoValue
                  - Fn::If:
                      - HasVodSourceBucket
                      - !GetAtt VodSourceBucket.Arn
                      - !Ref AWS::NoValue
              - Sid: ReadWriteObjects
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "s3:GetObject"
                  - "s3:PutObject"
                Resource:
                  - Fn::If:
                      - HasArchiveBucket
                      - !Sub "${ArchiveBucket.Arn}/*"
                      - !Ref AWS::NoValue
                  - Fn::If:
                      - HasVodSourceBucket
                      - !Sub "${VodSourceBucket.Arn}/*"
                      - !Ref AWS::NoValue
              - Sid: UseCustomerManagedKey
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "kms:Decrypt"
                  - "kms:DescribeKey"
                  - "kms:GenerateDataKey"
                Resource: !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn

Outputs:
  ChannelId:
    Description: MediaPackage channel Id.
    Value: !Ref MediaPackageChannel
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-channel-id"
  HlsOriginEndpointId:
    Description: HLS origin endpoint Id.
    Value: !Ref HlsOriginEndpoint
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-hls-origin-endpoint-id"
  DashOriginEndpointId:
    Description: DASH origin endpoint Id.
    Value: !Ref DashOriginEndpoint
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-dash-origin-endpoint-id"
  ArchiveBucketName:
    Description: S3 bucket name used for live-to-VOD archiving.
    Condition: HasArchiveBucket
    Value: !Ref ArchiveBucket
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-archive-bucket-name"
  VodSourceBucketName:
    Description: S3 bucket name used for VOD source content.
    Condition: HasVodSourceBucket
    Value: !Ref VodSourceBucket
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-vod-source-bucket-name"
  MediaPackageRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the MediaPackage S3 access role.
    Condition: HasAnyVodBucket
    Value: !GetAtt MediaPackageRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-mediapackage-role-arn"
  MediaPackageKmsKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the customer managed KMS key protecting the bucket data.
    Condition: HasAnyVodBucket
    Value: !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-kms-key-arn"

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Cluster API Provider AWS (CAPA) IAM bootstrap stack. Creates the IAM roles,
  instance profiles, and AWS-managed and customer-managed policies required for
  CAPA to manage EC2-based and EKS-based Kubernetes cluster lifecycles. The
  stack is fully self-contained: every role, instance profile, policy, and ARN
  it depends on is created inside this template.

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - production
    Description: >-
      Environment name applied as a tag to every IAM role created by this
      stack so that CAPA IAM resources can be identified and governed.

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Control plane: managed policy, role, instance profile
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  ControlPlanePolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-control-plane-policy'
      Description: >-
        Broad EC2, Elastic Load Balancing, Auto Scaling, and KMS permissions
        used by the Cluster API Provider AWS control plane.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EC2InstancesVolumesNetworkingImages
            Effect: Allow
            Action: 'ec2:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: ElasticLoadBalancingLifecycle
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancers
              - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyLoadBalancerAttributes
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancerAttributes
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateTargetGroup
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteTargetGroup
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetGroups
              - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyTargetGroup
              - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyTargetGroupAttributes
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetGroupAttributes
              - elasticloadbalancing:RegisterTargets
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeregisterTargets
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetHealth
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateListener
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteListener
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeListeners
              - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyListener
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateRule
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteRule
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeRules
              - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyRule
              - elasticloadbalancing:SetSubnets
              - elasticloadbalancing:SetSecurityGroups
              - elasticloadbalancing:AddTags
              - elasticloadbalancing:RemoveTags
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTags
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AutoScalingLifecycle
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - autoscaling:CreateAutoScalingGroup
              - autoscaling:UpdateAutoScalingGroup
              - autoscaling:DeleteAutoScalingGroup
              - autoscaling:DescribeAutoScalingGroups
              - autoscaling:DescribeAutoScalingInstances
              - autoscaling:DescribeScalingActivities
              - autoscaling:DescribeLaunchConfigurations
              - autoscaling:CreateLaunchConfiguration
              - autoscaling:DeleteLaunchConfiguration
              - autoscaling:CreateOrUpdateTags
              - autoscaling:DeleteTags
              - autoscaling:DescribeTags
              - autoscaling:SetDesiredCapacity
              - autoscaling:TerminateInstanceInAutoScalingGroup
              - autoscaling:SuspendProcesses
              - autoscaling:ResumeProcesses
              - autoscaling:AttachInstances
              - autoscaling:DetachInstances
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: KMSKeyUsage
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext
              - kms:ReEncryptFrom
              - kms:ReEncryptTo
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:CreateGrant
              - kms:ListGrants
              - kms:RevokeGrant
            Resource: '*'

  ControlPlaneRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-control-plane-role'
      Description: >-
        IAM role assumed by the Cluster API Provider AWS control plane to
        provision and manage EC2-based cluster infrastructure.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowEC2ToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref ControlPlanePolicy
        - !Ref ControllersEksPolicy
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: ClusterAPI
          Value: 'true'

  ControlPlaneInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-control-plane'
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControlPlaneRole

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Controllers: managed policy, role, instance profile
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  ControllersPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-controllers-policy'
      Description: >-
        Permissions used by the Cluster API Provider AWS controllers to manage
        VPC networking, security groups, load balancers, Auto Scaling groups,
        launch templates, and EKS access entries.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: VPCAndNetworkingLifecycle
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:CreateVpc
              - ec2:DeleteVpc
              - ec2:DescribeVpcs
              - ec2:ModifyVpcAttribute
              - ec2:CreateSubnet
              - ec2:DeleteSubnet
              - ec2:DescribeSubnets
              - ec2:ModifySubnetAttribute
              - ec2:AssociateSubnetCidrBlock
              - ec2:DisassociateSubnetCidrBlock
              - ec2:CreateRouteTable
              - ec2:DeleteRouteTable
              - ec2:DescribeRouteTables
              - ec2:AssociateRouteTable
              - ec2:DisassociateRouteTable
              - ec2:CreateRoute
              - ec2:DeleteRoute
              - ec2:ReplaceRoute
              - ec2:CreateInternetGateway
              - ec2:DeleteInternetGateway
              - ec2:AttachInternetGateway
              - ec2:DetachInternetGateway
              - ec2:DescribeInternetGateways
              - ec2:CreateNatGateway
              - ec2:DeleteNatGateway
              - ec2:DescribeNatGateways
              - ec2:AllocateAddress
              - ec2:ReleaseAddress
              - ec2:DescribeAddresses
              - ec2:AssociateAddress
              - ec2:DisassociateAddress
              - ec2:CreateNetworkAcl
              - ec2:DeleteNetworkAcl
              - ec2:DescribeNetworkAcls
              - ec2:CreateNetworkAclEntry
              - ec2:DeleteNetworkAclEntry
              - ec2:ReplaceNetworkAclEntry
              - ec2:CreateDhcpOptions
              - ec2:DeleteDhcpOptions
              - ec2:DescribeDhcpOptions
              - ec2:AssociateDhcpOptions
              - ec2:CreateTags
              - ec2:DeleteTags
              - ec2:DescribeTags
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: SecurityGroupLifecycle
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:CreateSecurityGroup
              - ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup
              - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
              - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress
              - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupEgress
              - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
              - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupEgress
              - ec2:UpdateSecurityGroupRuleDescriptionsIngress
              - ec2:UpdateSecurityGroupRuleDescriptionsEgress
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: ElasticLoadBalancingLifecycle
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancers
              - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyLoadBalancerAttributes
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancerAttributes
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateTargetGroup
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteTargetGroup
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetGroups
              - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyTargetGroup
              - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyTargetGroupAttributes
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetGroupAttributes
              - elasticloadbalancing:RegisterTargets
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeregisterTargets
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetHealth
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateListener
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteListener
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeListeners
              - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyListener
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateRule
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteRule
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeRules
              - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyRule
              - elasticloadbalancing:SetSubnets
              - elasticloadbalancing:SetSecurityGroups
              - elasticloadbalancing:AddTags
              - elasticloadbalancing:RemoveTags
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTags
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AutoScalingAndLaunchTemplates
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - autoscaling:CreateAutoScalingGroup
              - autoscaling:UpdateAutoScalingGroup
              - autoscaling:DeleteAutoScalingGroup
              - autoscaling:DescribeAutoScalingGroups
              - autoscaling:DescribeAutoScalingInstances
              - autoscaling:DescribeScalingActivities
              - autoscaling:SetDesiredCapacity
              - autoscaling:TerminateInstanceInAutoScalingGroup
              - autoscaling:CreateOrUpdateTags
              - autoscaling:DeleteTags
              - autoscaling:DescribeTags
              - autoscaling:SuspendProcesses
              - autoscaling:ResumeProcesses
              - ec2:CreateLaunchTemplate
              - ec2:DeleteLaunchTemplate
              - ec2:DescribeLaunchTemplates
              - ec2:DescribeLaunchTemplateVersions
              - ec2:CreateLaunchTemplateVersion
              - ec2:DeleteLaunchTemplateVersions
              - ec2:ModifyLaunchTemplate
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: EKSAccessEntries
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - eks:CreateAccessEntry
              - eks:DeleteAccessEntry
              - eks:DescribeAccessEntry
              - eks:ListAccessEntries
              - eks:AssociateAccessPolicy
              - eks:DisassociateAccessPolicy
              - eks:ListAssociatedAccessPolicies
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: IAMServiceLinkedRoles
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                iam:AWSServiceName:
                  - autoscaling.amazonaws.com
                  - elasticloadbalancing.amazonaws.com
                  - spot.amazonaws.com
                  - ec2.amazonaws.com
          - Sid: IAMRoleInspectionAndPassRole
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - iam:PassRole
              - iam:GetRole
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/*'

  ControllersEksPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-controllers-eks-policy'
      Description: >-
        EKS cluster and nodegroup lifecycle, SSM parameter retrieval, IAM and
        KMS inspection, and EKS service-linked role creation used by the
        Cluster API Provider AWS controllers and control plane.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EKSClusterAndNodegroupLifecycle
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - eks:CreateCluster
              - eks:DeleteCluster
              - eks:DescribeCluster
              - eks:CreateNodegroup
              - eks:DeleteNodegroup
              - eks:DescribeNodegroup
              - eks:UpdateNodegroupConfig
              - eks:ListClusters
              - eks:ListNodegroups
              - eks:TagResource
              - eks:UntagResource
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: SSMParameterRetrieval
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ssm:GetParameter
              - ssm:GetParameters
              - ssm:GetParametersByPath
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/*'
          - Sid: IAMRoleAndPolicyInspection
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - iam:GetRole
              - iam:ListRoles
              - iam:GetPolicy
              - iam:GetPolicyVersion
              - iam:ListAttachedRolePolicies
              - iam:ListRolePolicies
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: KMSKeyOperationsForClusterAPI
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:CreateGrant
              - kms:ListGrants
              - kms:RevokeGrant
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringLike:
                kms:RequestAlias: 'alias/*cluster-api*'
          - Sid: EKSServiceLinkedRoles
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aws-service-role/*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                iam:AWSServiceName:
                  - eks.amazonaws.com
                  - eks-nodegroup.amazonaws.com
                  - eks-fargate.amazonaws.com

  ControllersRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-controllers-role'
      Description: >-
        IAM role used by the Cluster API Provider AWS controllers and, through
        EKS Pod Identity, by the controllers running inside an EKS cluster.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowEC2ToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
          - Sid: AllowEKSPodIdentityToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: pods.eks.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
              - sts:TagSession
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref ControllersPolicy
        - !Ref ControllersEksPolicy
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: ClusterAPI
          Value: 'true'

  ControllersInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-controllers'
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControllersRole

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Nodes: managed policy, role, instance profile
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  NodesPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nodes-policy'
      Description: >-
        EC2, ECR, Secrets Manager, SSM, and S3 permissions required by workload
        cluster nodes to bootstrap and pull Cluster API machine secrets.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EC2NodeBootstrapRead
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:DescribeInstances
              - ec2:DescribeInstanceTypes
              - ec2:DescribeInstanceStatus
              - ec2:DescribeTags
              - ec2:DescribeVolumes
              - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
              - ec2:DescribeAvailabilityZones
              - ec2:DescribeImages
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: ECRImagePull
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
              - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
              - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
              - ecr:BatchGetImage
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: ClusterAPIBootstrapSecrets
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
              - secretsmanager:DescribeSecret
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:secretsmanager:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:secret:aws.cluster.x-k8s.io/*'
          - Sid: SSMParameterRead
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ssm:GetParameter
              - ssm:GetParameters
              - ssm:GetParametersByPath
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/*'
          - Sid: BootstrapObjectRead
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - s3:GetObject
              - s3:GetObjectVersion
              - s3:GetBucketLocation
              - s3:ListBucket
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::*'

  NodesRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nodes-role'
      Description: >-
        IAM role assumed by EC2 worker nodes of Cluster API Provider AWS
        managed clusters.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowEC2ToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy
