final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Creates an EC2 Image Builder solution that builds and distributes custom Amazon Linux 2023 AMIs
  for both x86_64 and arm64 architectures. Each image installs Docker, the Docker Compose plugin
  and the Python packages synapseclient, pandas and pysftp, enables passwordless sudo for the SSM
  user, and is validated by a test phase before distribution. The resulting AMIs are shared publicly
  and with a specified AWS Organization. The stack provisions its own VPC (public NAT subnets plus
  private build subnets), VPC endpoints for S3/SSM/ECR/CloudWatch Logs, security groups, an IAM
  role/instance profile, a customer-managed KMS key, an encrypted log bucket and a log group.
  Pipelines are created without a schedule so builds only run when started explicitly (manually or
  via StartImagePipelineExecution).

Parameters:
  Version:
    Type: String
    Default: 1.0.0
    AllowedPattern: '^\d+\.\d+\.\d+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a semantic version of the form major.minor.patch (for example 1.0.0).
    Description: >-
      Semantic version applied to the Image Builder component and image recipe Version properties,
      resource tags, the produced AMI name pattern and the AmiNamePrefix output. Bump this single
      value to publish a new image release. It is deliberately NOT used inside Image Builder
      resource Name fields because the Image Builder name pattern forbids the '.' character.

  RootVolumeSize:
    Type: Number
    Default: 32
    MinValue: 8
    MaxValue: 1024
    Description: Size of the root EBS volume (GiB) for both the x86_64 and arm64 images.

  OrganizationId:
    Type: String
    Default: o-xxxxxxxxxx
    AllowedPattern: '^o-[a-z0-9]{10}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid AWS Organizations ID such as o-abcdefghij.
    Description: >-
      AWS Organization ID that the produced AMIs are shared with (organization level sharing), in
      addition to being shared publicly.

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Networking
#
# Public subnets carry the internet gateway and the NAT gateway. The build
# instances run in private subnets and reach AWS services through VPC endpoints
# and general egress through the NAT gateway. No subnet auto-assigns public IP
# addresses (MapPublicIpOnLaunch is left at its default of false).
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
Resources:

  Vpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-igw'

  InternetGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - '0'
        - Fn::GetAZs: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-1'

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - '1'
        - Fn::GetAZs: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-2'

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - '0'
        - Fn::GetAZs: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-1'

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: 10.0.3.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - '1'
        - Fn::GetAZs: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-2'

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-rt'

  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  NatElasticIp:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip'

  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    DependsOn:
      - InternetGatewayAttachment
      - PublicDefaultRoute
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatElasticIp.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat'

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-rt'

  PrivateDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: NatGateway
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Security groups
  #
  # BuildSecurityGroup has no inbound rules. Its egress is destination-scoped:
  # internal traffic to the VPC CIDR (VPC DNS resolver, VPC endpoint ENIs, NAT
  # gateway ENI) plus an AWS-managed prefix list for Amazon S3. No rule uses an
  # all-IPv4 destination. Third-party package repositories are reached through
  # the NAT gateway using the private-subnet default route.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  BuildSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Scoped egress security group for EC2 Image Builder build instances
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: '-1'
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16
          Description: All traffic within the VPC (DNS resolver, VPC endpoints, NAT gateway)
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          DestinationPrefixListId: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
          Description: HTTPS to Amazon S3 via the AWS-managed prefix list
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-imagebuilder-sg'

  EndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for the interface VPC endpoints used by the Image Builder build instances
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16
          Description: HTTPS from within the VPC to the interface endpoints
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: '-1'
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16
          Description: All traffic within the VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-endpoint-sg'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Customer managed KMS key for the build log bucket (Trivy AWS-0132).
  # Applies only to S3 build logs; AMI volume encryption is intentionally left
  # untouched so the published AMIs remain publicly shareable.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  LogBucketKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key protecting the EC2 Image Builder build log bucket
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowImageBuilderServiceUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: imagebuilder.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:ViaService: !Sub 's3.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
      Tags:
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Build log storage
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ImageBuilderLogBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - BucketKeyEnabled: true
            ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt LogBucketKey.Arn
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-imagebuilder-logs'
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  ImageBuilderLogBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref ImageBuilderLogBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyNonTLS
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt ImageBuilderLogBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${ImageBuilderLogBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: false

  # Retention is bounded so build logs do not persist forever.
  BuildLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      RetentionInDays: 30
      Tags:
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC endpoints so AWS service traffic does not require broad internet egress
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  SsmEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssm'
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup

  SsmMessagesEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssmmessages'
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup

  Ec2MessagesEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ec2messages'
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup

  EcrApiEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ecr.api'
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup

  EcrDkrEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ecr.dkr'
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup

  LogsEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.logs'
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM for the Image Builder build instances
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  BuildInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-imagebuilder-role'
      Description: Instance role used by EC2 Image Builder build instances
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/EC2InstanceProfileForImageBuilder'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ImageBuilderDistributionLoggingAndKeyUse
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: PublishAndTagImages
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:ModifyImageAttribute
                  - ec2:DescribeImages
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: WriteBuildLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt ImageBuilderLogBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub '${ImageBuilderLogBucket.Arn}/*'
              - Sid: UseLogBucketKey
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:ReEncrypt*
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !GetAtt LogBucketKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  BuildInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-imagebuilder-profile'
      Roles:
        - !Ref BuildInstanceRole

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Image Builder components
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SoftwareInstallComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-al2023-software-install'
      Description: Installs Docker, the Docker Compose plugin, Python packages and enables sudo for the SSM user.
      Platform: Linux
      Version: !Ref Version
      ChangeDescription: 'Initial version: Docker, Docker Compose plugin, synapseclient/pandas/pysftp and ssm-user sudo.'
      Tags:
        StackName: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'
        Version: !Ref Version
      Data: |
        name: AL2023SoftwareInstall
        description: Installs Docker, the Docker Compose plugin, Python packages and enables NOPASSWD sudo for ssm-user.
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: build
            steps:
              - name: InstallSystemPackages
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -e
                    - dnf makecache
                    - dnf install -y docker docker-compose-plugin python3 python3-pip
                    - systemctl enable docker.service
                    - systemctl start docker.service
                    - usermod -aG docker ec2-user || true
              - name: InstallPythonPackages
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -e
                    - python3 -m pip install --upgrade pip
                    - python3 -m pip install synapseclient pandas pysftp
              - name: EnableSsmUserSudo
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -e
                    - echo 'ssm-user ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD:ALL' > /etc/sudoers.d/ssm-user
                    - chmod 0440 /etc/sudoers.d/ssm-user
                    - chown root:root /etc/sudoers.d/ssm-user

  SoftwareValidateComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-al2023-software-validate'
      Description: Test phase that asserts Docker Compose works and the required Python packages import.
      Platform: Linux
      Version: !Ref Version
      ChangeDescription: 'Initial version: Docker Compose and Python import validation.'
      Tags:
        StackName: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'
        Version: !Ref Version
      Data: |
        name: AL2023SoftwareValidate
        description: Verifies that docker compose and the required Python packages are usable.
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: test
            steps:
              - name: ValidateDockerCompose
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -e
                    - docker compose version
              - name: ValidatePythonImports
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -e
                    - python3 -c "import synapseclient, pandas, pysftp"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Image recipes - one per architecture
  #
  # NOTE ON ENCRYPTION: a publicly shareable AMI cannot have snapshots encrypted
  # with an account-specific KMS key. This template therefore leaves the recipe
  # volumes unencrypted (the AWS-managed default). The customer-managed key in
  # this template protects only the S3 build log bucket. Do not add an
  # Ebs.KmsKeyId here if the AMIs must remain publicly shareable.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  X86ImageRecipe:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-al2023-x86-64-recipe'
      Description: Amazon Linux 2023 x86_64 image with Docker, Docker Compose, Python packages and SSM user sudo.
      Version: !Ref Version
      ParentImage: '{{resolve:ssm:/aws/service/ami-amazon-linux-latest/al2023-ami-kernel-default-x86_64}}'
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !Ref SoftwareInstallComponent
        - ComponentArn: !Ref SoftwareValidateComponent
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: !Ref RootVolumeSize
            VolumeType: gp3
            DeleteOnTermination: true
      Tags:
        StackName: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'
        Version: !Ref Version
        Architecture: x86_64

  Arm64ImageRecipe:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-al2023-arm-64-recipe'
      Description: Amazon Linux 2023 arm64 image with Docker, Docker Compose, Python packages and SSM user sudo.
      Version: !Ref Version
      ParentImage: '{{resolve:ssm:/aws/service/ami-amazon-linux-latest/al2023-ami-kernel-default-arm64}}'
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !Ref SoftwareInstallComponent
        - ComponentArn: !Ref SoftwareValidateComponent
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: !Ref RootVolumeSize
            VolumeType: gp3
            DeleteOnTermination: true
      Tags:
        StackName: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'
        Version: !Ref Version
        Architecture: arm64

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Shared infrastructure configuration
  # Build instances run in a private subnet and egress through the NAT gateway
  # and the VPC endpoints created above.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ImageInfrastructureConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::InfrastructureConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-al2023-infrastructure'
      Description: Shared infrastructure configuration used by both the x86_64 and arm64 pipelines.
      InstanceProfileName: !Ref BuildInstanceProfile
      InstanceTypes:
        - t3.micro
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref BuildSecurityGroup
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      TerminateInstanceOnFailure: true
      Logging:
        S3Logs:
          S3BucketName: !Ref ImageBuilderLogBucket
          S3KeyPrefix: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}/imagebuilder'
      ResourceTags:
        Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-imagebuilder-build'
        StackName: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'
        Version: !Ref Version
      Tags:
        StackName: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'
        Version: !Ref Version

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Single distribution configuration shared by both pipelines.
  #
  # The AMI Name embeds the release Version and the Image Builder build version;
  # the architecture is surfaced through the recipe and pipeline tags because a
  # single shared distribution configuration cannot render an arch placeholder.
  #
  # ORGANIZATION ARN: the organizations ARN requires the *management* account ID.
  # Using ${AWS::AccountId} is only correct when this stack is deployed in the
  # organizations management account. When deploying into a member account the
  # management account ID must be supplied explicitly; no wildcard org segment
  # is used here because it would be rejected by the API.
  #
  # LAUNCH SHARING: public sharing (UserGroups: [all]) and organization sharing
  # (OrganizationArns) are configured together. If the distribution step rejects
  # the combination in a given account, the build's distribution phase will fail
  # loudly rather than silently publishing an unshared image.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ImageDistributionConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::DistributionConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-al2023-distribution'
      Description: Shares the built Amazon Linux 2023 AMIs publicly and with the configured AWS Organization.
      Distributions:
        - Region: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
          AmiDistributionConfiguration:
            Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-al2023-${Version}-{{imagebuilder:buildVersion}}'
            Description: !Sub 'Amazon Linux 2023 base AMI built by ${AWS::StackName} (release ${Version})'
            AmiTags:
              StackName: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'
              Version: !Ref Version
              ManagedBy: EC2ImageBuilder
            LaunchPermissionConfiguration:
              UserGroups:
                - all
              OrganizationArns:
                - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:organizations::${AWS::AccountId}:organization/${OrganizationId}'
      Tags:
        StackName: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'
        Version: !Ref Version

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Pipelines - one per architecture. No Schedule is defined so that an
  # automated stack deployment does not start a long running image build; start
  # the pipeline manually or with StartImagePipelineExecution.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  X86ImagePipeline:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImagePipeline
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-al2023-x86-64-pipeline'
      Description: Builds and distributes the x86_64 Amazon Linux 2023 AMI. No schedule, start manually.
      ImageRecipeArn: !Ref X86ImageRecipe
      InfrastructureConfigurationArn: !Ref ImageInfrastructureConfiguration
      DistributionConfigurationArn: !Ref ImageDistributionConfiguration
      Status: ENABLED
      ImageTestsConfiguration:
        ImageTestsEnabled: true
        TimeoutMinutes: 90
      Tags:
        StackName: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'
        Version: !Ref Version
        Architecture: x86_64

  Arm64ImagePipeline:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImagePipeline
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-al2023-arm-64-pipeline'
      Description: Builds and distributes the arm64 Amazon Linux 2023 AMI. No schedule, start manually.
      ImageRecipeArn: !Ref Arm64ImageRecipe
      InfrastructureConfigurationArn: !Ref ImageInfrastructureConfiguration
      DistributionConfigurationArn: !Ref ImageDistributionConfiguration
      Status: ENABLED
      ImageTestsConfiguration:
        ImageTestsEnabled: true
        TimeoutMinutes: 90
      Tags:
        StackName: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'
        Version: !Ref Version
        Architecture: arm64

Outputs:
  X86ImagePipelineArn:
    Description: ARN of the x86_64 EC2 Image Builder pipeline.
    Value: !Ref X86ImagePipeline

  Arm64ImagePipelineArn:
    Description: ARN of the arm64 EC2 Image Builder pipeline.
    Value: !Ref Arm64ImagePipeline

  X86ImageRecipeArn:
    Description: ARN of the x86_64 image recipe.
    Value: !Ref X86ImageRecipe

  Arm64ImageRecipeArn:
    Description: ARN of the arm64 image recipe.
    Value: !Ref Arm64ImageRecipe

  DistributionConfigurationArn:
    Description: ARN of the shared distribution configuration.
    Value: !Ref ImageDistributionConfiguration

  InfrastructureConfigurationArn:
    Description: ARN of the shared infrastructure configuration.
    Value: !Ref ImageInfrastructureConfiguration

  LogBucketName:
    Description: Name of the S3 bucket that receives Image Builder build logs.
    Value: !Ref ImageBuilderLogBucket

  LogBucketKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the customer managed KMS key protecting the build log bucket.
    Value: !GetAtt LogBucketKey.Arn

  LogGroupName:
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch Logs log group retained for this stack.
    Value: !Ref BuildLogGroup

  AmiNamePrefix:
    Description: Shared base AMI naming prefix produced by this stack and the configured Version.
    Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-al2023-${Version}'

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  AnyCompany Hotel guest and staff authentication stack. Deploys an Amazon Cognito
  user pool (PLUS tier with advanced security enforced) that signs users in with
  email, allows admin-only user provisioning, carries custom guest_id, property_id
  and region attributes, exposes a public SPA app client, a dedicated admin app
  client for server-side test harnesses, staff role groups, a machine-to-machine
  OAuth2 client backed by a read/write/admin API resource server, and a hosted user
  pool domain. All resource names, domain prefix and exported values are isolated
  per Environment.

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod
    Description: >-
      Deployment environment (dev, staging, prod). Used to isolate the user pool,
      app clients, groups, resource server, hosted domain and exported values so
      that dev/staging/prod stacks can coexist in the same account.

Resources:

  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub 'anycompany-hotel-${Environment}-user-pool'
      UserPoolTier: PLUS
      UserPoolAddOns:
        AdvancedSecurityMode: ENFORCED
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      UsernameConfiguration:
        CaseSensitive: false
      MfaConfiguration: 'OFF'
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      EmailConfiguration:
        EmailSendingAccount: COGNITO_DEFAULT
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: true
        InviteMessageTemplate:
          EmailSubject: !Sub 'Your AnyCompany Hotel (${Environment}) account invitation'
          EmailMessage: !Sub |
            Welcome to AnyCompany Hotel (${Environment}).

            Your username is {username} and your temporary password is {####}.
            You will be asked to choose a new password when you first sign in.

            If you were not expecting this invitation, please contact the
            AnyCompany Hotel IT service desk.
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 12
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 3
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: false
        - Name: 'custom:guest_id'
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: false
        - Name: 'custom:property_id'
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: false
        - Name: 'custom:region'
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: false
      UserPoolTags:
        Environment: !Ref Environment
        Application: anycompany-hotel-auth

  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Domain: !Sub 'anycompany-hotel-${Environment}-${AWS::AccountId}'

  SpaAppClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub 'anycompany-hotel-${Environment}-spa-client'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - openid
        - email
        - profile
      CallbackURLs:
        - !Sub 'https://${Environment}.anycompany-hotel.example.com/oauth2/callback'
      LogoutURLs:
        - !Sub 'https://${Environment}.anycompany-hotel.example.com/oauth2/logout'
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      EnableTokenRevocation: true
      AccessTokenValidity: 1
      IdTokenValidity: 1
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: hours
        IdToken: hours
        RefreshToken: days
      ReadAttributes:
        - email
        - email_verified
        - 'custom:guest_id'
        - 'custom:property_id'
        - 'custom:region'
      WriteAttributes:
        - email
        - 'custom:guest_id'
        - 'custom:property_id'
        - 'custom:region'

  AdminAppClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub 'anycompany-hotel-${Environment}-admin-client'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_ADMIN_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - openid
        - email
        - profile
      CallbackURLs:
        - !Sub 'https://api.${Environment}.anycompany-hotel.example.com/oauth2/callback'
      LogoutURLs:
        - !Sub 'https://api.${Environment}.anycompany-hotel.example.com/oauth2/logout'
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      EnableTokenRevocation: true
      AccessTokenValidity: 1
      IdTokenValidity: 1
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: hours
        IdToken: hours
        RefreshToken: days
      ReadAttributes:
        - email
        - email_verified
        - 'custom:guest_id'
        - 'custom:property_id'
        - 'custom:region'
      WriteAttributes:
        - email
        - 'custom:guest_id'
        - 'custom:property_id'
        - 'custom:region'

  ApiResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Identifier: anycompany-hotel-api
      Name: !Sub 'anycompany-hotel-${Environment}-api'
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: read
          ScopeDescription: Read access to AnyCompany Hotel API resources
        - ScopeName: write
          ScopeDescription: Write access to AnyCompany Hotel API resources
        - ScopeName: admin
          ScopeDescription: Administrative access to AnyCompany Hotel API resources

  MachineToMachineAppClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: ApiResourceServer
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub 'anycompany-hotel-${Environment}-m2m-client'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: true
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - anycompany-hotel-api/read
        - anycompany-hotel-api/write
        - anycompany-hotel-api/admin
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      EnableTokenRevocation: true
      AccessTokenValidity: 1
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: hours

  AdminGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: !Sub '${Environment}-Admin'
      Description: !Sub 'AnyCompany Hotel administrators with full console and API access (${Environment})'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Precedence: 1

  ManagerGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: !Sub '${Environment}-Manager'
      Description: !Sub 'AnyCompany Hotel property managers (${Environment})'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Precedence: 10

  RegionalManagerGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: !Sub '${Environment}-RegionalManager'
      Description: !Sub 'AnyCompany Hotel regional managers overseeing multiple properties (${Environment})'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Precedence: 20

  RevenueManagerGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: !Sub '${Environment}-RevenueManager'
      Description: !Sub 'AnyCompany Hotel revenue managers (${Environment})'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Precedence: 30

  FrontDeskGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: !Sub '${Environment}-FrontDesk'
      Description: !Sub 'AnyCompany Hotel front desk staff (${Environment})'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Precedence: 40

  HousekeepingGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: !Sub '${Environment}-Housekeeping'
      Description: !Sub 'AnyCompany Hotel housekeeping staff (${Environment})'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Precedence: 50

Outputs:

  UserPoolId:
    Description: ID of the AnyCompany Hotel Cognito user pool.
    Value: !Ref UserPool
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${Environment}-anycompany-hotel-user-pool-id'

  UserPoolArn:
    Description: ARN of the AnyCompany Hotel Cognito user pool.
    Value: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
    Export:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Hospitality Insights (prod) Amazon Cognito user pool with a hosted UI prefix domain, three
  user groups (Admin, RegularUser, PowerUser), a post-authentication Lambda trigger that records
  custom:last_login, and optional OIDC federation gated on the SsoEnabled condition.

Parameters:
  DomainPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: hospitality-insights-prod
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 50
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9])?$'
    ConstraintDescription: Lowercase alphanumeric characters and hyphens only.
    Description: >-
      Base prefix for the Cognito hosted UI domain. The account ID is appended so the resulting
      Cognito prefix domain is globally unique.

  LoginUrl:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: >-
      Login/callback URL and OIDC issuer URL used for federated sign-in. Leave empty to disable SSO.

  SsoProviderName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: >-
      Name of the federated identity provider inside the user pool. Leave empty to disable SSO.

  IdpClientId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Client ID issued by the OIDC identity provider (used only when SSO is enabled).

  IdpClientSecret:
    Type: String
    NoEcho: true
    Default: ''
    Description: Client secret issued by the OIDC identity provider (used only when SSO is enabled).

Conditions:
  SsoEnabled: !And
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref LoginUrl, '']]
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref SsoProviderName, '']]

Resources:

  HospitalityInsightsUserPool:
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: hospitality-insights-prod
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      MfaConfiguration: OPTIONAL
      EnabledMfas:
        - SOFTWARE_TOKEN_MFA
      UserPoolAddOns:
        AdvancedSecurityMode: ENFORCED
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: false
        UnusedAccountValidityDays: 7
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 14
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          RequireUppercase: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      Schema:
        - Name: last_login
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: false
      LambdaConfig:
        PostAuthentication: !GetAtt PostAuthenticationFunction.Arn
      UserPoolTags:
        Application: HospitalityInsights
        Environment: prod

  HospitalityInsightsUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: hospitality-insights-prod-client
      UserPoolId: !Ref HospitalityInsightsUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      EnableTokenRevocation: true
      AccessTokenValidity: 60
      IdTokenValidity: 60
      RefreshTokenValidity: 1440
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: minutes
        IdToken: minutes
        RefreshToken: minutes
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - openid
        - email
        - profile
      CallbackURLs:
        - !Sub 'https://${DomainPrefix}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/idpresponse'
        - !If
          - SsoEnabled
          - !Ref LoginUrl
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      LogoutURLs:
        - !Sub 'https://${DomainPrefix}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/logout'
        - !If
          - SsoEnabled
          - !Ref LoginUrl
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      SupportedIdentityProviders: !If
        - SsoEnabled
        - - COGNITO
          - !Ref SsoProviderName
        - - COGNITO

  HospitalityInsightsUserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref HospitalityInsightsUserPool
      Domain: !Sub '${DomainPrefix}-${AWS::AccountId}'

  AdminGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: Admin
      Description: Hospitality Insights administrators
      Precedence: 1
      UserPoolId: !Ref HospitalityInsightsUserPool

  RegularUserGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: RegularUser
      Description: Hospitality Insights standard users
      Precedence: 2
      UserPoolId: !Ref HospitalityInsightsUserPool

  PowerUserGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: PowerUser
      Description: Hospitality Insights power users
      Precedence: 3
      UserPoolId: !Ref HospitalityInsightsUserPool

  PostAuthenticationFunctionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: hospitality-insights-prod-post-authentication-role
      Description: Execution role for the Hospitality Insights post-authentication Lambda trigger
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: cognito-admin-update-user-attributes
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-idp:AdminUpdateUserAttributes
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:cognito-idp:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:userpool/*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: HospitalityInsights
        - Key: Environment
          Value: prod

  PostAuthenticationFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: hospitality-insights-prod-post-authentication
      Description: Records custom:last_login after a successful Cognito sign-in
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt PostAuthenticationFunctionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 10
      MemorySize: 128
      Environment:
        Variables:
          LOG_LEVEL: INFO
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import logging
          import os
          from datetime import datetime, timezone

          import boto3

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(os.environ.get("LOG_LEVEL", "INFO"))

          cognito_idp = boto3.client("cognito-idp")


          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              user_pool_id = event["userPoolId"]
              username = event["userName"]
              last_login = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()

              cognito_idp.admin_update_user_attributes(
                  UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                  Username=username,
                  UserAttributes=[
                      {"Name": "custom:last_login", "Value": last_login},
                  ],
              )

              logger.info("Updated custom:last_login for user %s in pool %s", username, user_pool_id)
              return event
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: HospitalityInsights
        - Key: Environment
          Value: prod

  PostAuthenticationInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !GetAtt PostAuthenticationFunction.Arn
      Principal: cognito-idp.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !GetAtt HospitalityInsightsUserPool.Arn

  HospitalityInsightsIdentityProvider:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolIdentityProvider
    Condition: SsoEnabled
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref HospitalityInsightsUserPool
      ProviderName: !Ref SsoProviderName
      ProviderType: OIDC
      ProviderDetails:
        client_id: !Ref IdpClientId
        client_secret: !Ref IdpClientSecret
        attributes_request_method: GET
        oidc_issuer: !Ref LoginUrl
        authorize_scopes: openid email profile
      AttributeMapping:
        email: email
        username: sub

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Description: Identifier of the Hospitality Insights prod user pool
    Value: !Ref HospitalityInsightsUserPool

  UserPoolArn:
    Description: ARN of the Hospitality Insights prod user pool
    Value: !GetAtt HospitalityInsightsUserPool.Arn

  UserPoolClientId:
    Description: Identifier of the Hospitality Insights prod application client
    Value: !Ref HospitalityInsightsUserPoolClient

  HostedUiDomain:
    Description: Fully qualified Cognito hosted UI domain
    Value: !Sub '${DomainPrefix}-${AWS::AccountId}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com'

  AdminGroupName:
    Description: Name of the Admin group
    Value: !Ref AdminGroup

  RegularUserGroupName:
    Description: Name of the RegularUser group
    Value: !Ref RegularUserGroup

  PowerUserGroupName:
    Description: Name of the PowerUser group
    Value: !Ref PowerUserGroup

  PostAuthenticationFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the post-authentication Lambda trigger
    Value: !GetAtt PostAuthenticationFunction.Arn

  SsoProviderName:
    Condition: SsoEnabled
    Description: Name of the configured federated identity provider
    Value: !Ref SsoProviderName

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Provisions an AWS Fault Injection Simulator (FIS) experiment template for cross-region
  chaos engineering testing. The experiment blocks application network traffic between the
  local deployment region and the supplied target region, and pauses S3 / DynamoDB
  cross-region replication for a configurable duration (default 20 minutes). This template
  also creates the least-privilege IAM execution role assumed by FIS, a dedicated
  customer-managed KMS key, and an encrypted CloudWatch Logs log group for experiment
  logging. All target resources are selected by the ChaosAllowed=true resource tag.

Parameters:
  TargetRegion:
    Type: String
    Default: us-west-2
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z]{2}(-gov)?-[a-z]+-\d$'
    ConstraintDescription: 'Must be a valid AWS region name, for example us-west-2.'
    Description: >-
      Remote AWS region whose cross-region connectivity and replication is disrupted by
      the chaos experiment. Used to scope the experiment to traffic between the local
      deployment region and this remote region.

  PauseDurationMinutes:
    Type: Number
    Default: 20
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 1440
    Description: >-
      Number of minutes that cross-region replication stays paused and network traffic
      stays blocked.

Resources:

  ###############################################################################
  # CloudWatch Logs log group for FIS experiment logs (encrypted with the CMK below)
  ###############################################################################
  FisLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/fis/${AWS::StackName}'
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FisLogsKey.Arn

  ###############################################################################
  # Dedicated customer-managed KMS key used to encrypt the FIS experiment log group
  ###############################################################################
  FisLogsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Customer managed KMS key for AWS FIS experiment logs (${AWS::StackName})'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableAccountRootKeyAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action:
              - 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowFisExecutionRoleToUseKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !GetAtt FisExperimentRole.Arn
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncryptFrom
              - kms:ReEncryptTo
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:CreateGrant
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsToUseKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncryptFrom
              - kms:ReEncryptTo
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:CreateGrant
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/fis/${AWS::StackName}'

  FisLogsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-fis-logs'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FisLogsKey

  ###############################################################################
  # IAM execution role assumed by the AWS FIS service
  ###############################################################################
  FisExperimentRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-fis-experiment-role'
      Description: 'Least-privilege execution role assumed by AWS FIS for cross-region chaos experiments'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowFisServiceToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: fis.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FisTargetResolutionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ResolveTaggedTargetResources
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - tag:GetResources
                Resource: '*'

        - PolicyName: FisNetworkDisruptionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: DescribeNetworkResources
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                  - ec2:DescribeRouteTables
                  - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
                  - ec2:DescribeNetworkAcls
                  - ec2:DescribeTransitGateways
                  - ec2:DescribeTransitGatewayAttachments
                  - ec2:DescribeTransitGatewayVpcAttachments
                  - ec2:DescribeTransitGatewayRouteTables
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: DisruptTransitGatewayAndRouteTableConnectivity
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:CreateRoute
                  - ec2:ReplaceRoute
                  - ec2:DeleteRoute
                  - ec2:CreateTransitGatewayRoute
                  - ec2:ReplaceTransitGatewayRoute
                  - ec2:DeleteTransitGatewayRoute
                  - ec2:CreateNetworkAclEntry
                  - ec2:ReplaceNetworkAclEntry
                  - ec2:DeleteNetworkAclEntry
                Resource: '*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    aws:ResourceTag/ChaosAllowed: 'true'

        - PolicyName: FisS3ReplicationPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: PauseAndResumeS3Replication
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetReplicationConfiguration
                  - s3:PutReplicationConfiguration
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                  - s3:GetBucketVersioning
                  - s3:GetBucketTagging
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource: '*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    aws:ResourceTag/ChaosAllowed: 'true'

        - PolicyName: FisDynamoDBReplicationPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: PauseAndResumeDynamoDBGlobalTableReplication
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:DescribeTable
                  - dynamodb:DescribeGlobalTable
                  - dynamodb:DescribeGlobalTableSettings
                  - dynamodb:DescribeContinuousBackups
                  - dynamodb:ListTagsOfResource
                  - dynamodb:UpdateTable
                  - dynamodb:UpdateGlobalTable
                  - dynamodb:UpdateGlobalTableSettings
                Resource: '*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    aws:ResourceTag/ChaosAllowed: 'true'

        - PolicyName: FisCloudWatchLogsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: DescribeFisLogGroups
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: WriteFisExperimentLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/fis/${AWS::StackName}:*'

  ###############################################################################
  # AWS FIS experiment template
  # NOTE: A route-table disruption action (aws:network:route-table-disrupt-connectivity)
  # is intentionally omitted because no aws:ec2:route-table target is defined by the
  # requested scope (transit gateways, subnets, S3 buckets, DynamoDB global tables).
  # Only verified FIS action identifiers are used below.
  ###############################################################################
  FisExperimentTemplate:
    Type: AWS::FIS::ExperimentTemplate
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub >-
        Cross-region chaos experiment: block network traffic from ${AWS::Region} to
        ${TargetRegion} and pause cross-region replication for PT${PauseDurationMinutes}M
        on resources tagged ChaosAllowed=true.
      RoleArn: !GetAtt FisExperimentRole.Arn
      Tags:
        Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-fis-cross-region-chaos'
        StackName: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'
        TargetRegion: !Ref TargetRegion
      StopConditions:
        - Source: none
      LogConfiguration:
        CloudWatchLogsConfiguration:
          LogGroupArn: !GetAtt FisLogGroup.Arn
        LogSchemaVersion: 2
      Targets:
        ChaosTransitGateways:
          ResourceType: aws:ec2:transit-gateway
          SelectionMode: ALL
          ResourceTags:
            ChaosAllowed: 'true'
        ChaosSubnets:
          ResourceType: aws:ec2:subnet
          SelectionMode: ALL
          ResourceTags:
            ChaosAllowed: 'true'
        ChaosS3Buckets:
          ResourceType: aws:s3:bucket
          SelectionMode: ALL
          ResourceTags:
            ChaosAllowed: 'true'
        ChaosDynamoDBGlobalTables:
          ResourceType: aws:dynamodb:global-table
          SelectionMode: ALL
          ResourceTags:
            ChaosAllowed: 'true'
      Actions:
        BlockInterRegionTraffic:
          ActionId: aws:network:disrupt-connectivity
          Description: !Sub >-
            Block network traffic originating from subnets in ${AWS::Region} toward
            ${TargetRegion} on ChaosAllowed subnets.
          Parameters:
            duration: !Sub 'PT${PauseDurationMinutes}M'
            scope: all
          Targets:
            Subnets: ChaosSubnets
        DisruptTransitGatewayConnectivity:
          ActionId: aws:network:transit-gateway-disrupt-connectivity
          Description: !Sub >-
            Disrupt transit gateway connectivity between ${AWS::Region} and
            ${TargetRegion} on ChaosAllowed transit gateways.
          Parameters:
            duration: !Sub 'PT${PauseDurationMinutes}M'
          Targets:
            TransitGateways: ChaosTransitGateways
        PauseS3Replication:
          ActionId: aws:s3:bucket-pause-replication
          Description: 'Pause cross-region replication for ChaosAllowed S3 buckets.'
          Parameters:
            duration: !Sub 'PT${PauseDurationMinutes}M'
          Targets:
            Buckets: ChaosS3Buckets
          StartAfter:
            - BlockInterRegionTraffic
        PauseDynamoDBReplication:
          ActionId: aws:dynamodb:global-table-pause-replication
          Description: 'Pause cross-region replication for ChaosAllowed DynamoDB global tables.'
          Parameters:
            duration: !Sub 'PT${PauseDurationMinutes}M'
          Targets:
            Tables: ChaosDynamoDBGlobalTables
          StartAfter:
            - BlockInterRegionTraffic

Outputs:
  ExperimentTemplateId:
    Description: Identifier of the AWS FIS experiment template.

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Landing zone hub VPC for multi-account spoke attachment. Creates a hub VPC with
  public/private subnets across two Availability Zones, NAT gateways, a Transit
  Gateway with private ASN 64512 (DNS + VPN ECMP enabled), VPC flow logs to
  CloudWatch, and interface/gateway VPC endpoints for SSM, EC2 Messages, SSM
  Messages, CloudWatch Logs, and S3.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: landing-zone
    MinLength: 2
    MaxLength: 24
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{1,23}$'
    ConstraintDescription: >
      Must be 2-24 characters, start with a lowercase letter or number, and may
      contain only lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens.
    Description: Environment name used as a prefix for all resource names and tags.

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC and Internet Gateway
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      InstanceTenancy: default
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-vpc"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-igw"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  InternetGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Public Subnets (two AZs)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-1"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Type
          Value: Public

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-2"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Type
          Value: Public

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Private Subnets (two AZs)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.10.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-1"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Type
          Value: Private

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.11.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-2"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Type
          Value: Private

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # NAT Gateways (one per public subnet / AZ)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  NatGatewayEip1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-1"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  NatGatewayEip2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-2"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGatewayEip1.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-nat-gateway-1"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGatewayEip2.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-nat-gateway-2"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Transit Gateway
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  TransitGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGateway
    Properties:
      AmazonSideAsn: 64512
      AutoAcceptSharedAttachments: enable
      DefaultRouteTableAssociation: enable
      DefaultRouteTablePropagation: enable
      DnsSupport: enable
      VpnEcmpSupport: enable
      Description: !Sub "${EnvironmentName} hub Transit Gateway for spoke VPC attachments"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-tgw"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  TransitGatewayVpcAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-tgw-attachment"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Public Routing
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-public-rt"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Private Routing (per AZ: NAT egress + TGW spoke routes)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-1"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-2"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  PrivateDefaultRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateDefaultRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  PrivateTransitGatewayRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: TransitGatewayVpcAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/8
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway

  PrivateTransitGatewayRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: TransitGatewayVpcAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/8
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC Flow Logs to CloudWatch Logs
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  FlowLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "/aws/vpc/flowlogs/${EnvironmentName}-hub"
      RetentionInDays: 30
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-vpc-flow-logs"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  FlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-vpc-flow-logs-role"
      Description: Allows VPC Flow Logs to publish log events to CloudWatch Logs
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowVpcFlowLogsAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-vpc-flow-logs-policy"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: AllowFlowLogsLogGroupAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogGroup.Arn
              - Sid: AllowFlowLogsStreamAndEventAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub "${FlowLogGroup.Arn}:*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-vpc-flow-logs-role"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  VpcFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogDestination: !GetAtt FlowLogGroup.Arn
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      LogFormat: >-
        ${version} ${account-id} ${interface-id} ${srcaddr} ${dstaddr}
        ${srcport} ${dstport} ${protocol} ${packets} ${bytes} ${start}
        ${end} ${action} ${log-status}
      MaxAggregationInterval: 60
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-vpc-flow-log"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC Endpoint Security Group
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  VpcEndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-vpce-sg"
      GroupDescription: !Sub "Allow HTTPS access to VPC interface endpoints in ${EnvironmentName} hub VPC"
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock
          Description: Allow HTTPS from the hub VPC CIDR
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/8
          Description: Allow HTTPS from attached spoke networks
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock
          Description: Allow HTTPS to endpoint ENIs within the hub VPC CIDR
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-vpce-sg"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Interface VPC Endpoints (SSM, EC2 Messages, SSM Messages, CloudWatch Logs)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SsmEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssm"
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-vpce-ssm"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  Ec2MessagesEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ec2messages"
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-vpce-ec2messages"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  SsmMessagesEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssmmessages"
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-vpce-ssmmessages"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  CloudWatchLogsEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.logs"
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-vpce-logs"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Gateway VPC Endpoint (S3)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3"
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-vpce-s3"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: Hub VPC ID
    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-VpcId"

  PublicSubnet1Id:
    Description: Public subnet 1 ID (AZ 1)
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-PublicSubnet1Id"

  PublicSubnet2Id:
    Description: Public subnet 2 ID (AZ 2)
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-PublicSubnet2Id"

  PrivateSubnet1Id:
    Description: Private subnet 1 ID (AZ 1)
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-PrivateSubnet1Id"

  PrivateSubnet2Id:
    Description: Private subnet 2 ID (AZ 2)
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-PrivateSubnet2Id"

  TransitGatewayId:
    Description: Hub Transit Gateway ID for spoke attachments
    Value: !Ref TransitGateway
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-TransitGatewayId"

  TransitGatewayAttachmentId:
    Description: Transit Gateway attachment ID for the hub VPC
    Value: !Ref TransitGatewayVpcAttachment
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-TransitGatewayAttachmentId"

  VpcEndpointSecurityGroupId:
    Description: Security group used by the interface VPC endpoints
    Value: !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-VpcEndpointSecurityGroupId"

  VpcFlowLogGroupName:
    Description: CloudWatch Logs log group name receiving hub VPC flow logs
    Value: !Ref FlowLogGroup
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-VpcFlowLogGroupName"

Description: >-
