  controls. Creates an encrypted CloudWatch Logs log group for CloudTrail management events,
  a customer managed KMS key, an encrypted SNS notification topic, and 14 metric filter /
  CloudWatch alarm / Logs Insights query definition triples covering CIS controls 3.1 through
  3.14. All dependencies are created inside this template; no pre-existing infrastructure is
  referenced.

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# NOTE: CloudTrail delivery source is out of scope for this template. A CloudTrail trail (or
# CloudTrail Lake / an AWS service delivery source) must be configured to deliver management
# events into the log group created below (see the CloudTrailLogGroup resource). Once events
# are flowing, the metric filters and alarms created here fire on the CIS Section 3 conditions.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Resources:

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # KMS customer managed key used to encrypt the CloudTrail log group and the alarm SNS topic.
  # The key policy scopes service principal access with aws:SourceArn patterns built purely from
  # pseudo parameters and the stack name so that no dependency cycle is created with the log
  # group or the topic that reference this key.
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CisMonitoringKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key for CIS Section 3 log-based monitoring (CloudTrail log group and alarm SNS topic)
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAdminAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncryptFrom
              - kms:ReEncryptTo
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/cloudtrail/${AWS::StackName}-cis-monitoring:*'
          - Sid: AllowSnsTopicUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: 'sns.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sns:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${AWS::StackName}-cis-alerts'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchAlarmsToPublishToEncryptedTopic
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: 'cloudwatch.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:cloudwatch:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:alarm:CIS-3.*'

  # Stable alias so alarms, filters and operational tooling can reference the key by name.
  CisMonitoringKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-cis-monitoring'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref CisMonitoringKey

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CloudWatch Logs log group receiving CloudTrail management events.
  # A delivery source (CloudTrail trail) must be configured to send events here.
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CloudTrailLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/cloudtrail/${AWS::StackName}-cis-monitoring'
      RetentionInDays: 365
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt CisMonitoringKey.Arn

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # SNS topic (encrypted with the customer managed key) that receives every alarm notification.
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CisAlarmTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TopicName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cis-alerts'
      DisplayName: CIS Section 3 Monitoring Alerts
      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt CisMonitoringKey.Arn

  CisAlarmTopicPolicy:
    Type: AWS::SNS::TopicPolicy
    Properties:
      Topics:
        - !Ref CisAlarmTopic
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowAccountOwnerFullControl
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'sns:*'
            Resource: !Ref CisAlarmTopic
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchAlarmsToPublish
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: 'cloudwatch.amazonaws.com'
            Action: 'sns:Publish'
            Resource: !Ref CisAlarmTopic
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:cloudwatch:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:alarm:CIS-3.*'

  # ===========================================================================================
  # CIS 3.1 - Unauthorized API call attempts
  # ===========================================================================================
  MetricFilterUnauthorizedApiCalls:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.errorCode = "*UnauthorizedOperation") || ($.errorCode = "AccessDenied*") }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: CISBenchmark
          MetricName: CIS-3.1-UnauthorizedAPICalls
          MetricValue: '1'

  AlarmUnauthorizedApiCalls:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: CIS-3.1-UnauthorizedAPICalls
      AlarmDescription: 'CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark v1.4/1.5 control 3.1 - Unauthorized API call attempts (>= 1 in 5 minutes)'
      Namespace: CISBenchmark
      MetricName: CIS-3.1-UnauthorizedAPICalls
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref CisAlarmTopic

  QueryDefinitionUnauthorizedApiCalls:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: CIS-3.1-UnauthorizedAPICalls
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      QueryString: 'fields @timestamp, userIdentity.arn, sourceIPAddress, eventName, errorCode, errorMessage | filter (errorCode like /AccessDenied/ or errorCode like /UnauthorizedOperation/) | sort @timestamp desc | limit 20'

  # ===========================================================================================
  # CIS 3.2 - Console sign-in without MFA
  # ===========================================================================================
  MetricFilterConsoleSignInWithoutMFA:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.eventName = "ConsoleLogin") && ($.additionalEventData.MFAUsed != "Yes") && ($.userIdentity.type = "IAMUser") && ($.responseElements.ConsoleLogin = "Success") }'

      QueryString: 'fields @timestamp, userIdentity.arn, sourceIPAddress, responseElements.ConsoleLogin, additionalEventData.MFAUsed | filter (eventName = "ConsoleLogin" and additionalEventData.MFAUsed != "Yes" and userIdentity.type = "IAMUser" and responseElements.ConsoleLogin = "Success") | sort @timestamp desc | limit 20'

  # ===========================================================================================
  # CIS 3.3 - Use of the root account
  # ===========================================================================================
  MetricFilterRootAccountUsage:

    Properties:

      FilterPattern: '{ ($.userIdentity.type = "Root") && ($.userIdentity.invokedBy NOT EXISTS) && ($.eventType != "AwsServiceEvent") }'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Shared and fully self-contained IAM roles, GuardDuty detector, KMS-encrypted
  bastion-accessible S3 bucket, CloudFormation registry log groups, and Kubernetes/EKS
  type activations for use across multiple EKS deployments. Every dependency is created
  inside this template; no pre-existing infrastructure is referenced.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentAlias:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    MaxLength: 16
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9-]*$'
    Description: >-
      Optional lowercase environment alias used as a naming prefix for every role
      and supporting resource created by this stack. Leave empty for no prefix.
  EnvironmentHash:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    MaxLength: 8
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9]*$'
    Description: >-
      Optional lowercase hash appended to resource names to disambiguate multiple
      deployments of this stack. Leave empty for no suffix.
  S3BucketName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9.-]*[a-z0-9]$'
    Description: >-
      Optional globally unique name for the bastion-accessible S3 bucket created by
      this stack. Leave empty to let CloudFormation generate a unique name.
  PermissionsBoundary:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: >-
      Optional ARN of an IAM permissions boundary policy applied to every role
      created by this stack. Leave empty to deploy without a permissions boundary.

Conditions:
  HasEnvironmentAlias: !Not [!Equals [!Ref EnvironmentAlias, '']]
  HasEnvironmentHash: !Not [!Equals [!Ref EnvironmentHash, '']]
  HasS3BucketName: !Not [!Equals [!Ref S3BucketName, '']]
  HasPermissionsBoundary: !Not [!Equals [!Ref PermissionsBoundary, '']]

Resources:

  GuardDutyDetector:
    Type: AWS::GuardDuty::Detector
    Properties:
      Enable: true
      FindingPublishingFrequency: FIFTEEN_MINUTES

  BastionKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key used for SSE-KMS encryption of the bastion-accessible S3 bucket created by this stack.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'

  LambdaDiscoveryRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Join
        - ''
        - - !If [HasEnvironmentAlias, !Sub '${EnvironmentAlias}-', '']
          - lambda-discovery-role
          - !If [HasEnvironmentHash, !Sub '-${EnvironmentHash}', '']
      PermissionsBoundary: !If [HasPermissionsBoundary, !Ref PermissionsBoundary, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/ReadOnlyAccess'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: resource-discovery
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: DiscoveryReads
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:Describe*
                  - eks:List*
                  - eks:Describe*
                  - s3:ListAllMyBuckets
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                  - cloudformation:Describe*
                  - cloudformation:List*
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameters
                  - ssm:GetParametersByPath
                  - ssm:DescribeParameters
                  - tag:GetResources
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: LambdaLogging
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/*'

  LambdaIdentityRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Join
        - ''
        - - !If [HasEnvironmentAlias, !Sub '${EnvironmentAlias}-', '']
          - lambda-identity-role
          - !If [HasEnvironmentHash, !Sub '-${EnvironmentHash}', '']
      PermissionsBoundary: !If [HasPermissionsBoundary, !Ref PermissionsBoundary, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: identity-and-diagnostics
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: CallerIdentity
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sts:GetCallerIdentity
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: CloudFormationReads
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStacks
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackEvents
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackResources
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackResource
                  - cloudformation:GetTemplate
                  - cloudformation:ListStacks
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:cloudformation:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:stack/*'
              - Sid: CloudTrailReads
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudtrail:LookupEvents
                  - cloudtrail:DescribeTrails
                  - cloudtrail:GetTrailStatus
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: LogGroupReads
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:FilterLogEvents
                  - logs:GetLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*'
              - Sid: LogGroupDiscovery
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: LambdaLogging
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/*'

  EksNodeGroupInspectionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Join
        - ''
        - - !If [HasEnvironmentAlias, !Sub '${EnvironmentAlias}-', '']
          - eks-nodegroup-inspect-role
          - !If [HasEnvironmentHash, !Sub '-${EnvironmentHash}', '']
      PermissionsBoundary: !If [HasPermissionsBoundary, !Ref PermissionsBoundary, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: eks-nodegroup-read
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:

                Effect: Allow

                  - eks:ListClusters
                  - eks:DescribeCluster
                  - eks:ListNodegroups
                  - eks:DescribeNodegroup
                  - eks:ListUpdates
                  - eks:DescribeUpdate
                  - eks:ListTagsForResource
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:eks:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:cluster/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:eks:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:nodegroup/*/*'

  CloudFormationExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Join
        - ''
        - - !If [HasEnvironmentAlias, !Sub '${EnvironmentAlias}-', '']
          - cloudformation-execution-role
          - !If [HasEnvironmentHash, !Sub '-${EnvironmentHash}', '']
      PermissionsBoundary: !If [HasPermissionsBoundary, !Ref PermissionsBoundary, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']

      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:

            Principal:

            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole

            Version: '2012-10-17'

                  - eks:CreateNodegroup

                  - eks:DescribeNodegroup
                  - eks:ListNodegroups
                  - eks:UpdateNodegroupConfig
                  - eks:UpdateNodegroupVersion
                  - eks:CreateAddon

                  - eks:DescribeAddon
                  - eks:UpdateAddon
                  - eks:ListAddons
                  - eks:AccessKubernetesApi

                  - secretsmanager:UpdateSecretVersionStage

        - PolicyName: kms-access

            Version: '2012-10-17'

      Must be 1-40 characters using only letters, numbers, and hyphens.
    Description: >-
      Prefix applied to every SQS queue name and to the KMS alias in this stack. Must not be
      account-specific.

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Customer managed KMS key + alias used for SSE-KMS on every queue in the stack
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SqsKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Customer managed KMS key for SQS test queues in ${AWS::StackName}'
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountKeyAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowSqsServiceToUseKeyForStackQueues
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sqs.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncryptFrom
              - kms:ReEncryptTo
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Sub '${AWS::AccountId}'
              StringLike:
                # Scoped to the queues created by this template; uses the naming pattern rather
                # than Fn::GetAtt on the queues to avoid a circular dependency with the key.
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sqs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${NamePrefix}-*'

  SqsKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${NamePrefix}-sqs'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref SqsKmsKey

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 1. Standalone FIFO queue without a dead-letter queue
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  FifoNoDlq:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-fifo-no-dlq.fifo'
      FifoQueue: true
      ContentBasedDeduplication: true
      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt SqsKmsKey.Arn
      SqsManagedSseEnabled: false

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2. FIFO queue with a redrive policy pointing at the FIFO DLQ below
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  FifoWithDlq:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-fifo-with-dlq.fifo'
      FifoQueue: true
      ContentBasedDeduplication: true
      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt SqsKmsKey.Arn
      SqsManagedSseEnabled: false
      RedrivePolicy:
        deadLetterTargetArn: !GetAtt FifoWithDlqDlq.Arn
        maxReceiveCount: 5

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3. FIFO dead-letter queue for the FIFO queue above (must itself be FIFO)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  FifoWithDlqDlq:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-fifo-with-dlq-dlq.fifo'
      FifoQueue: true
      ContentBasedDeduplication: true
      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt SqsKmsKey.Arn
      SqsManagedSseEnabled: false

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 4. Standard queue with a redrive policy (maxReceiveCount 5)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  StandardWithDlq:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-standard-with-dlq'
      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt SqsKmsKey.Arn
      SqsManagedSseEnabled: false
      RedrivePolicy:
        deadLetterTargetArn: !GetAtt StandardWithDlqDlq.Arn
        maxReceiveCount: 5

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 5. Standard dead-letter queue for the standard queue above
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  StandardWithDlqDlq:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-standard-with-dlq-dlq'
      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt SqsKmsKey.Arn
      SqsManagedSseEnabled: false

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 6. Separate, standalone FIFO DLQ - not a redrive target of any queue
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  FifoDlq:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-fifo-dlq.fifo'
      FifoQueue: true
      ContentBasedDeduplication: true
      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt SqsKmsKey.Arn
      SqsManagedSseEnabled: false

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CloudWatch alarms (all with alarm actions disabled - no targets configured)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  # 13. Standard queue - sum of messages sent, breaching on missing data
  StandardQueueMessagesSentAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-standard-queue-messages-sent'
      AlarmDescription: !Sub >-
        Standard queue ${NamePrefix}-standard-with-dlq: sum of NumberOfMessagesSent over the
        period is at or above the threshold of 1. Missing data is treated as breaching.
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: NumberOfMessagesSent
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardWithDlq.QueueName
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      Threshold: 1
      TreatMissingData: breaching

  # 14. FIFO queue with DLQ - average messages sent compared against an anomaly band
  FifoWithDlqMessagesSentAnomalyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-fifo-with-dlq-messages-sent-anomaly'
      AlarmDescription: !Sub >-
        FIFO queue ${NamePrefix}-fifo-with-dlq.fifo: average NumberOfMessagesSent outside the
        ANOMALY_DETECTION_BAND(m1, 2) prediction band. Missing data is treated as not breaching.
      Metrics:
        - Id: m1
          ReturnData: false
          MetricStat:
            Metric:
              Namespace: AWS/SQS
              MetricName: NumberOfMessagesSent
              Dimensions:
                - Name: QueueName
                  Value: !GetAtt FifoWithDlq.QueueName
            Period: 300
            Stat: Average
        - Id: ad1
          Expression: 'ANOMALY_DETECTION_BAND(m1, 2)'
          Label: NumberOfMessagesSent expected band
          ReturnData: true
      ThresholdMetricId: ad1
      ComparisonOperator: LessThanLowerOrGreaterThanUpperThreshold
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  # 15a. Standard queue - maximum sent message size (AWS/SQS SentMessageSize), 183500 bytes
  StandardQueueSentMessageSizeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-standard-queue-sent-message-size'
      AlarmDescription: !Sub >-
        Standard queue ${NamePrefix}-standard-with-dlq: maximum SentMessageSize exceeds
        183500 bytes. Missing data is treated as not breaching.
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: SentMessageSize
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardWithDlq.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      Threshold: 183500
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  # 15b. Separate FIFO queue - maximum sent message size, 183500 bytes
  FifoDlqSentMessageSizeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-fifo-dlq-sent-message-size'
      AlarmDescription: !Sub >-
        FIFO queue ${NamePrefix}-fifo-dlq.fifo: maximum SentMessageSize exceeds 183500 bytes.
        Missing data is treated as not breaching.
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: SentMessageSize
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt FifoDlq.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      Threshold: 183500
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  # 12. Sum of visible messages across the standard DLQ and the FIFO-with-DLQ DLQ, > 0
  DlqsVisibleMessagesAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-dlqs-visible-messages'
      AlarmDescription: !Sub >-
        Dead-letter queues ${NamePrefix}-standard-with-dlq-dlq and
        ${NamePrefix}-fifo-with-dlq-dlq.fifo: summed ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible is
        greater than 0. Missing data is treated as not breaching.
      Metrics:
        - Id: m1
          ReturnData: false
          MetricStat:
            Metric:
              Namespace: AWS/SQS
              MetricName: ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible
              Dimensions:
                - Name: QueueName
                  Value: !GetAtt StandardWithDlqDlq.QueueName
            Period: 300
            Stat: Sum
        - Id: m2
          ReturnData: false
          MetricStat:
            Metric:
              Namespace: AWS/SQS
              MetricName: ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible
              Dimensions:
                - Name: QueueName
                  Value: !GetAtt FifoWithDlqDlq.QueueName
            Period: 300
            Stat: Sum
        - Id: e1
          Expression: 'm1 + m2'
          Label: Summed visible messages on both DLQs
          ReturnData: true
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      Threshold: 0
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  # 16. Standard queue - maximum age of the oldest message, 15 seconds
  StandardQueueOldestMessageAgeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-standard-queue-oldest-message-age'
      AlarmDescription: !Sub >-
        Standard queue ${NamePrefix}-standard-with-dlq: maximum ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage
        exceeds 15 seconds. Missing data is treated as not breaching.
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardWithDlq.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      Threshold: 15
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  # 17. Separate FIFO queue - maximum age of the oldest message, 15 seconds
  FifoDlqOldestMessageAgeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-fifo-dlq-oldest-message-age'
      AlarmDescription: !Sub >-
        FIFO queue ${NamePrefix}-fifo-dlq.fifo: maximum ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage exceeds
        15 seconds. Missing data is treated as not breaching.
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt FifoDlq.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      Threshold: 15
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  # 18. Standard queue - maximum messages not visible, 108000
  StandardQueueNotVisibleAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-standard-queue-not-visible-messages'
      AlarmDescription: !Sub >-
        Standard queue ${NamePrefix}-standard-with-dlq: maximum
        ApproximateNumberOfMessagesNotVisible exceeds 108000. Missing data is treated as
        not breaching.
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateNumberOfMessagesNotVisible
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardWithDlq.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      Threshold: 108000
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  # 19. Separate FIFO queue - maximum messages not visible, 18000
  FifoDlqNotVisibleAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-fifo-dlq-not-visible-messages'
      AlarmDescription: !Sub >-
        FIFO queue ${NamePrefix}-fifo-dlq.fifo: maximum ApproximateNumberOfMessagesNotVisible
        exceeds 18000. Missing data is treated as not breaching.
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateNumberOfMessagesNotVisible
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt FifoDlq.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      Threshold: 18000
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  # 20. Standard DLQ - maximum age of the oldest message, 90 seconds
  StandardDlqOldestMessageAgeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-standard-dlq-oldest-message-age'
      AlarmDescription: !Sub >-
        Dead-letter queue ${NamePrefix}-standard-with-dlq-dlq: maximum
        ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage exceeds 90 seconds. Missing data is treated as not breaching.
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardWithDlqDlq.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      Threshold: 90
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  # 21. Synthetic "always OK" alarm - metric math expression always resolves below threshold
  SyntheticAlwaysOkAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-synthetic-always-ok'
      AlarmDescription: !Sub >-
        Synthetic alarm that multiplies a real AWS/SQS metric (NumberOfMessagesSent on
        ${NamePrefix}-standard-with-dlq) by zero, so it always evaluates below the threshold of 1
        and never enters ALARM. Missing data is treated as not breaching.
      Metrics:
        - Id: m1
          ReturnData: false
          MetricStat:
            Metric:
              Namespace: AWS/SQS
              MetricName: NumberOfMessagesSent
              Dimensions:
                - Name: QueueName
                  Value: !GetAtt StandardWithDlq.QueueName
            Period: 300
            Stat: Sum
        - Id: e1
          Expression: 'm1 * 0'
          Label: Synthetic always OK
          ReturnData: true
      ComparisonOperator: LessThanThreshold
      Threshold: 1
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

# NOTE: No alarm is created for a "maximum sent message size" metric other than AWS/SQS

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Provisions the PCI DSS remediation prerequisites (a CloudTrail CloudWatch Logs
  log group with five year retention, a KMS customer managed key with key rotation
  enabled, an IAM role for the Systems Manager Automation documents, and an IAM
  role that allows CloudTrail to write to CloudWatch Logs) together with nine AWS
  Systems Manager Automation documents that remediate specific PCI DSS controls.
  Every prerequisite and every remediation document is exported so that custom
  AWS Config conformance packs can resolve them without hardcoded names.

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Prerequisite 1: CloudWatch Logs log group that receives CloudTrail events.
  # RetentionInDays 1827 is the CloudWatch retention value that corresponds to
  # five years, matching the PCI DSS audit log retention requirement.
  # DeletionPolicy/UpdateReplacePolicy Retain keep the audit log data intact.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  TrailCloudWatchLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/cloudtrail/${AWS::StackName}'
      RetentionInDays: 1827

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Prerequisite 2: KMS customer managed key used to encrypt trail logs.
  # Key rotation is enabled and the key is retained on stack teardown.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  TrailEncryptionKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'PCI DSS CloudTrail trail encryption key for ${AWS::StackName}'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableFullAccessForAccountRoot
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudTrailToUseTheKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudtrail.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsToUseTheKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt*
              - kms:Decrypt*
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Describe*
            Resource: '*'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Prerequisite 3: IAM role assumed by every Systems Manager Automation
  # document in this template.
  #
  # NOTE (deliberate design decision): AdministratorAccess (and IAMFullAccess)
  # on this role is intentionally over-broad because the requested PCI DSS
  # remediation automations must be able to touch CloudTrail, KMS, IAM, EC2 and
  # CodeBuild resources. In a production account this role should be replaced by
  # tightly scoped inline policies or a customer managed policy limited to the
  # exact API calls each automation document performs.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AutomationAssumeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-AutomationAssumeRole'
      Description: >-
        Role assumed by the PCI DSS remediation Systems Manager Automation
        documents. AdministratorAccess is applied deliberately per the PCI
        remediation requirement and should be tightened for production use.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowSystemsManagerAutomationToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/IAMFullAccess
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Prerequisite 4: IAM role that CloudTrail assumes to deliver trail events
  # into the CloudWatch Logs log group created above.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CloudTrailCloudWatchLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CloudTrail-CloudWatchLogs-Role'
      Description: >-
        Role assumed by CloudTrail to write trail events into the CloudWatch
        Logs log group created by this stack.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowCloudTrailToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudtrail.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CloudTrailCloudWatchLogsDeliveryPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: AllowCloudTrailToManageAndWriteLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt TrailCloudWatchLogGroup.Arn
                  - !Sub '${TrailCloudWatchLogGroup.Arn}:*'

  # ===========================================================================
  # Automation Document 1 of 9
  # Encrypts a CloudTrail trail with a supplied KMS key and integrates the
  # trail with a supplied CloudWatch Logs log group.
  # ===========================================================================
  EncryptCloudTrailTrailDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-EncryptTrailKmsCloudWatch'
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: >-
          Encrypts the specified AWS CloudTrail trail using the supplied KMS
          customer managed key and configures the trail to deliver events to the
          supplied CloudWatch Logs log group, then verifies the resulting
          configuration with cloudtrail:DescribeTrails.
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          TrailName:
            type: String
            description: (Required) Name of the CloudTrail trail to remediate.
          KmsKeyArn:
            type: String
            description: (Required) ARN of the KMS customer managed key used to encrypt trail logs.
          LogGroupArn:
            type: String
            description: (Required) ARN of the CloudWatch Logs log group that receives trail events.
          CloudWatchLogsRoleArn:
            type: String
            description: (Required) ARN of the IAM role CloudTrail assumes to write to CloudWatch Logs.
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: >-
              (Required) ARN of the IAM role that allows Systems Manager
              Automation to perform the actions on your behalf. Pass the ARN of
              the AutomationAssumeRole resource created by this stack.
            default: ''
        mainSteps:
          - name: UpdateTrailWithKmsKeyAndCloudWatchLogs
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: cloudtrail
              Api: UpdateTrail
              Name: '{{ TrailName }}'
              KmsKeyId: '{{ KmsKeyArn }}'
              CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn: '{{ LogGroupArn }}'
              CloudWatchLogsRoleArn: '{{ CloudWatchLogsRoleArn }}'
          - name: VerifyTrailConfiguration
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: cloudtrail
              Api: DescribeTrails
              trailNameList:
                - '{{ TrailName }}'

  # ===========================================================================
  # Automation Document 2 of 9
  # Enables automatic key rotation for a specified KMS key.
  # ===========================================================================
  EnableKmsKeyRotationDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-EnableKmsKeyRotation'
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: >-
          Accepts a KMS key identifier (key ID, key ARN, alias name or alias
          ARN), enables automatic annual key rotation for the key and then
          verifies that rotation is enabled.
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          KmsKeyId:
            type: String
            description: >-
              (Required) Key ID, key ARN, alias name or alias ARN of the KMS
              customer managed key whose rotation should be enabled.
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: >-
              (Required) ARN of the IAM role that allows Systems Manager
              Automation to perform the actions on your behalf. Pass the ARN of
              the AutomationAssumeRole resource created by this stack.
            default: ''
        mainSteps:
          - name: EnableKeyRotation
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: kms
              Api: EnableKeyRotation
              KeyId: '{{ KmsKeyId }}'
          - name: VerifyKeyRotationStatus
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: kms
              Api: GetKeyRotationStatus
              KeyId: '{{ KmsKeyId }}'

  # ===========================================================================
  # Automation Document 3 of 9
  # Integrates a CloudTrail trail with CloudWatch Logs only, leaving KMS
  # settings untouched.
  # ===========================================================================
  IntegrateCloudTrailWithCloudWatchLogsDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CloudTrailToCloudWatchLogs'
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: >-
          Configures the specified CloudTrail trail to deliver events to the
          supplied CloudWatch Logs log group. Only the CloudWatch Logs delivery
          fields are updated so that existing KMS encryption settings are left
          untouched.
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          TrailName:
            type: String
            description: (Required) Name of the CloudTrail trail to remediate.
          LogGroupArn:
            type: String
            description: (Required) ARN of the CloudWatch Logs log group that receives trail events.
          CloudWatchLogsRoleArn:
            type: String
            description: (Required) ARN of the IAM role CloudTrail assumes to write to CloudWatch Logs.
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: >-
              (Required) ARN of the IAM role that allows Systems Manager
              Automation to perform the actions on your behalf. Pass the ARN of
              the AutomationAssumeRole resource created by this stack.
            default: ''
        mainSteps:
          - name: UpdateTrailCloudWatchLogsDelivery
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: cloudtrail
              Api: UpdateTrail
              Name: '{{ TrailName }}'
              CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn: '{{ LogGroupArn }}'
              CloudWatchLogsRoleArn: '{{ CloudWatchLogsRoleArn }}'
          - name: VerifyTrailConfiguration
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: cloudtrail
              Api: DescribeTrails
              trailNameList:
                - '{{ TrailName }}'

  # ===========================================================================
  # Automation Document 4 of 9
  # Updates the account IAM password policy to satisfy the PCI DSS requirements.
  # ===========================================================================
  UpdateIamPasswordPolicyDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-UpdateIamPasswordPolicy'
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: >-
          Updates the account level IAM password policy: minimum length 14,
          uppercase, lowercase, numeric and symbol characters required, users
          allowed to change their own password, hard expiry, maximum password
          age of 90 days and prevention of reuse of the last 24 passwords.
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: >-
              (Required) ARN of the IAM role that allows Systems Manager
              Automation to perform the actions on your behalf. Pass the ARN of
              the AutomationAssumeRole resource created by this stack.
            default: ''
        mainSteps:
          - name: UpdateAccountPasswordPolicy
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: iam
              Api: UpdateAccountPasswordPolicy
              MinimumPasswordLength: 14
              RequireUppercaseCharacters: true
              RequireLowercaseCharacters: true
              RequireNumbers: true
              RequireSymbols: true
              AllowUsersToChangePassword: true
              HardExpiry: true
              MaxPasswordAge: 90
              PasswordReusePrevention: 24
              ExpirePasswords: true

  # ===========================================================================
  # Automation Document 5 of 9
  # Enables CloudTrail log file validation while also enforcing multi-region
  # coverage and CloudWatch Logs delivery.
  # ===========================================================================
  EnableCloudTrailLogFileValidationDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-EnableTrailLogFileValidation'
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: >-
          Enables CloudTrail log file validation for the specified trail and
          additionally enforces multi-region trail coverage and CloudWatch Logs
          delivery, so tamper evidence, multi-region logging and log delivery
          are remediated in a single run.
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          TrailName:
            type: String
            description: (Required) Name of the CloudTrail trail to remediate.
          LogGroupArn:
            type: String
            description: (Required) ARN of the CloudWatch Logs log group that receives trail events.
          CloudWatchLogsRoleArn:
            type: String
            description: (Required) ARN of the IAM role CloudTrail assumes to write to CloudWatch Logs.
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: >-
              (Required) ARN of the IAM role that allows Systems Manager
              Automation to perform the actions on your behalf. Pass the ARN of
              the AutomationAssumeRole resource created by this stack.
            default: ''
        mainSteps:
          - name: EnableLogFileValidationMultiRegionAndCloudWatchLogs
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: cloudtrail
              Api: UpdateTrail
              Name: '{{ TrailName }}'
              EnableLogFileValidation: true
              IsMultiRegionTrail: true
              CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn: '{{ LogGroupArn }}'
              CloudWatchLogsRoleArn: '{{ CloudWatchLogsRoleArn }}'
          - name: VerifyTrailConfiguration
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: cloudtrail
              Api: DescribeTrails
              trailNameList:
                - '{{ TrailName }}'

  # ===========================================================================
  # Automation Document 6 of 9
  # Revokes every inbound and outbound rule from a (default) security group.
  # ===========================================================================
  RevokeDefaultSecurityGroupRulesDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-RevokeDefaultSgRules'
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: >-
          Removes every inbound (IpPermissions) and outbound
          (IpPermissionsEgress) rule from the specified security group and then
          verifies with a describe based step that zero rules remain.
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          SecurityGroupId:
            type: String
            description: (Required) ID of the security group whose rules should be revoked.
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: >-
              (Required) ARN of the IAM role that allows Systems Manager
              Automation to perform the actions on your behalf. Pass the ARN of
              the AutomationAssumeRole resource created by this stack.
            default: ''
        mainSteps:
          - name: RevokeAllSecurityGroupRules
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.11
              Handler: revoke_all_rules
              InputPayload:
                SecurityGroupId: '{{ SecurityGroupId }}'
              Script: |-
                import boto3
                from botocore.exceptions import ClientError

                def revoke_all_rules(events, context):
                    ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')
                    group_id = events['SecurityGroupId']
                    try:
                        response = ec2.describe_security_groups(GroupIds=[group_id])
                    except ClientError as error:
                        raise Exception(
                            'Unable to describe security group {0}: {1}'.format(
                                group_id, error.response['Error']['Message']
                            )
                        )
                    if not response['SecurityGroups']:
                        raise Exception(
                            'Security group {0} was not found.'.format(group_id)
                        )
                    group = response['SecurityGroups'][0]
                    ingress_rules = group.get('IpPermissions', [])
                    egress_rules = group.get('IpPermissionsEgress', [])
                    if ingress_rules:
                        ec2.revoke_security_group_ingress(
                            GroupId=group_id, IpPermissions=ingress_rules
                        )
                    if egress_rules:
                        ec2.revoke_security_group_egress(
                            GroupId=group_id, IpPermissions=egress_rules
                        )
                    return {
                        'SecurityGroupId': group_id,
                        'RevokedIngressRules': len(ingress_rules),
                        'RevokedEgressRules': len(egress_rules)
                    }
          - name: VerifyNoRulesRemain
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.11
              Handler: verify_no_rules
              InputPayload:
                SecurityGroupId: '{{ SecurityGroupId }}'
              Script: |-
                import boto3

                def verify_no_rules(events, context):
                    ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')
                    group_id = events['SecurityGroupId']
                    response = ec2.describe_security_groups(GroupIds=[group_id])
                    group = response['SecurityGroups'][0]
                    ingress_rules = group.get('IpPermissions', [])
                    egress_rules = group.get('IpPermissionsEgress', [])
                    remaining_rules = len(ingress_rules) + len(egress_rules)
                    if remaining_rules > 0:
                        raise Exception(
                            'Security group {0} still has {1} rule(s) after remediation.'.format(
                                group_id, remaining_rules
                            )
                        )
                    return {
                        'SecurityGroupId': group_id,
                        'RemainingRules': 0
                    }

  # ===========================================================================
  # Automation Document 7 of 9
  # Deletes a specified security group (idempotent, fails gracefully).
  # ===========================================================================
  DeleteSecurityGroupDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-DeleteSecurityGroup'
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: >-
          Deletes the specified security group. The remediation is idempotent -
          if the group has already been deleted the step reports success - and
          fails with a descriptive message when the group is still in use.
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          SecurityGroupId:
            type: String
            description: (Required) ID of the security group that should be deleted.
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: >-
              (Required) ARN of the IAM role that allows Systems Manager
              Automation to perform the actions on your behalf. Pass the ARN of
              the AutomationAssumeRole resource created by this stack.
            default: ''
        mainSteps:
          - name: DeleteSecurityGroup
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.11
              Handler: delete_security_group
              InputPayload:
                SecurityGroupId: '{{ SecurityGroupId }}'
              Script: |-
                import boto3
                from botocore.exceptions import ClientError

                def delete_security_group(events, context):
                    ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')
                    group_id = events['SecurityGroupId']
                    try:
                        response = ec2.describe_security_groups(GroupIds=[group_id])
                    except ClientError as error:
                        if error.response['Error']['Code'] == 'InvalidGroup.NotFound':
                            return {
                                'SecurityGroupId': group_id,
                                'Status': 'ALREADY_DELETED'
                            }
                        raise Exception(
                            'Unable to describe security group {0}: {1}'.format(
                                group_id, error.response['Error']['Message']
                            )
                        )
                    if not response['SecurityGroups']:
                        return {
                            'SecurityGroupId': group_id,
                            'Status': 'ALREADY_DELETED'
                        }
                    try:
                        ec2.delete_security_group(GroupId=group_id)
                    except ClientError as error:
                        error_code = error.response['Error']['Code']
                        if error_code in ('DependencyViolation', 'InvalidGroup.InUse'):
                            raise Exception(
                                'Security group {0} is still in use and cannot be deleted: {1}'.format(
                                    group_id, error.response['Error']['Message']
                                )
                            )
                        raise Exception(
                            'Unable to delete security group {0}: {1}'.format(
                                group_id, error.response['Error']['Message']
                            )
                        )
                    return {
                        'SecurityGroupId': group_id,
                        'Status': 'DELETED'
                    }

  # ===========================================================================
  # Automation Document 8 of 9
  # Releases an unused (unassociated) Elastic IP address.
  # ===========================================================================
  ReleaseUnusedElasticIpDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ReleaseUnusedElasticIp'
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: >-
          Confirms with ec2:DescribeAddresses that the Elastic IP address
          identified by the supplied allocation ID is not associated with any
          resource and then releases it. An in-use address is never released -
          the automation fails with a descriptive error instead.
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          AllocationId:
            type: String
            description: (Required) Allocation ID of the Elastic IP address to release.
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: >-
              (Required) ARN of the IAM role that allows Systems Manager
              Automation to perform the actions on your behalf. Pass the ARN of
              the AutomationAssumeRole resource created by this stack.
            default: ''
        mainSteps:
          - name: VerifyUnassociatedAndReleaseElasticIp
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.11
              Handler: release_elastic_ip
              InputPayload:
                AllocationId: '{{ AllocationId }}'
              Script: |-
                import boto3
                from botocore.exceptions import ClientError

                def release_elastic_ip(events, context):
                    ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')
                    allocation_id = events['AllocationId']
                    try:
                        response = ec2.describe_addresses(AllocationIds=[allocation_id])
                    except ClientError as error:
                        raise Exception(
                            'Unable to describe Elastic IP {0}: {1}'.format(
                                allocation_id, error.response['Error']['Message']
                            )
                        )
                    addresses = response.get('Addresses', [])
                    if not addresses:
                        raise Exception(
                            'No Elastic IP address was found for allocation ID {0}.'.format(
                                allocation_id
                            )
                        )
                    address = addresses[0]
                    association_id = address.get('AssociationId')
                    if association_id:
                        raise Exception(
                            'Refusing to release Elastic IP {0}: it is still associated ({1}) '
                            'with {2}.'.format(
                                allocation_id,
                                association_id,
                                address.get('InstanceId', 'another resource')
                            )
                        )
                    ec2.release_address(AllocationId=allocation_id)
                    return {
                        'AllocationId': allocation_id,
                        'Status': 'RELEASED'
                    }

  # ===========================================================================
  # Automation Document 9 of 9
  # Removes long lived AWS credential environment variables from a CodeBuild
  # project while preserving all other project settings.
  # ===========================================================================
  RemoveAwsCredentialsFromCodeBuildProjectDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-RemoveCodeBuildAwsKeys'
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: >-
          Reads the specified CodeBuild project with codebuild:BatchGetProjects,
          removes any environment variable named AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID or
          AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY and writes the filtered environment back with
          codebuild:UpdateProject so that all other project settings are
          preserved unchanged.
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          ProjectName:
            type: String
            description: (Required) Name of the CodeBuild project to remediate.
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: >-
              (Required) ARN of the IAM role that allows Systems Manager
              Automation to perform the actions on your behalf. Pass the ARN of
              the AutomationAssumeRole resource created by this stack.
            default: ''
        mainSteps:
          - name: RemoveLongLivedCredentialEnvironmentVariables
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.11
              Handler: remove_credentials
              InputPayload:
                ProjectName: '{{ ProjectName }}'
              Script: |-
                import boto3
                from botocore.exceptions import ClientError

                CREDENTIAL_VARIABLE_NAMES = (
                    'AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID',
                    'AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY'
                )

                def remove_credentials(events, context):
                    codebuild = boto3.client('codebuild')
                    project_name = events['ProjectName']
                    try:
                        response = codebuild.batch_get_projects(names=[project_name])
                    except ClientError as error:
                        raise Exception(
                            'Unable to read CodeBuild project {0}: {1}'.format(
                                project_name, error.response['Error']['Message']
                            )
                        )
                    projects = response.get('projects', [])
                    if not projects:
                        raise Exception(
                            'CodeBuild project {0} was not found.'.format(project_name)
                        )
                    project = projects[0]
                    environment = project.get('environment', {})
                    environment_variables = environment.get('environmentVariables', [])
                    removed_variables = [
                        variable.get('name') for variable in environment_variables
                        if variable.get('name') in CREDENTIAL_VARIABLE_NAMES
                    ]
                    if not removed_variables:
                        return {
                            'ProjectName': project_name,
                            'RemovedVariables': [],
                            'Status': 'NO_CHANGE'
                        }
                    environment['environmentVariables'] = [
                        variable for variable in environment_variables
                        if variable.get('name') not in CREDENTIAL_VARIABLE_NAMES
                    ]
                    try:
                        codebuild.update_project(
                            name=project_name,
                            environment=environment
                        )
                    except ClientError as error:
                        raise Exception(
                            'Unable to update CodeBuild project {0}: {1}'.format(
                                project_name, error.response['Error']['Message']
                            )
                        )
                    return {

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  CoWork (Claude Desktop) telemetry monitoring. Creates a CloudWatch Logs log group that
  receives Claude Desktop / CoWork telemetry events, CloudWatch Logs metric filters that
  extract input tokens, output tokens, cache read tokens, cache creation tokens, estimated
  cost and session turn counts from both the "local agent mode" and the "Claude Code for
  Desktop" event schemas into the same CoWork/Telemetry metric names (with and without
  User/Model dimensions), and a CloudWatch dashboard that visualizes total token usage,
  total cost, session turns, cache hit tokens, usage/cost trends, average cost per turn,
  per-user breakdowns, active users and recent raw telemetry events.

Parameters:
  DashboardName:
    Type: String
    Default: CoWorkTelemetryDashboard
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 255
    Description: >-
      Name of the CloudWatch dashboard created for Claude Desktop (CoWork) telemetry monitoring.

  MetricsRegion:
    Type: String
    Default: us-east-1
    MinLength: 9
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z]{2}(-gov)?-[a-z]+-\d$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid AWS Region name, for example us-east-1 or eu-west-1.
    Description: >-
      AWS Region that the dashboard metric widgets and the Logs Insights widget read metrics
      and log events from. Defaults to us-east-1.

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Log group that receives CoWork (Claude Desktop / Claude Code for Desktop)
  # telemetry events. Retained on stack deletion / replacement to protect logs.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CoWorkTelemetryLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      RetentionInDays: 365

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Schema 1: "local agent mode" telemetry (snake_case fields)
  # Discriminator: $.schema = "local_agent"
  #
  # Aggregate metric filters (NO User/Model dimensions). Because these filters do
  # not require user or model attribution, token/cost/turn metrics are still
  # published (with value 0 when there was no usage) even for events that carry
  # no user or model fields.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CoWorkLocalInputTokens:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkTelemetryLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.schema = "local_agent" && $.input_tokens = * }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricName: InputTokens
          MetricNamespace: CoWork/Telemetry
          MetricValue: '$.input_tokens'

  CoWorkLocalOutputTokens:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkTelemetryLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.schema = "local_agent" && $.output_tokens = * }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricName: OutputTokens
          MetricNamespace: CoWork/Telemetry
          MetricValue: '$.output_tokens'

  CoWorkLocalCacheReadTokens:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkTelemetryLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.schema = "local_agent" && $.cache_read_input_tokens = * }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricName: CacheReadTokens
          MetricNamespace: CoWork/Telemetry
          MetricValue: '$.cache_read_input_tokens'

  CoWorkLocalCacheCreationTokens:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkTelemetryLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.schema = "local_agent" && $.cache_creation_input_tokens = * }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricName: CacheCreationTokens
          MetricNamespace: CoWork/Telemetry
          MetricValue: '$.cache_creation_input_tokens'

  CoWorkLocalEstimatedCost:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkTelemetryLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.schema = "local_agent" && $.estimated_cost_usd = * }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricName: EstimatedCost
          MetricNamespace: CoWork/Telemetry
          MetricValue: '$.estimated_cost_usd'

  CoWorkLocalSessionTurns:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkTelemetryLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.schema = "local_agent" && $.turn_count = * }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricName: SessionTurnCount
          MetricNamespace: CoWork/Telemetry
          MetricValue: '$.turn_count'

  # --- Schema 1 with User dimension (per-user attribution) -------------------
  CoWorkLocalInputTokensByUser:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkTelemetryLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.schema = "local_agent" && $.input_tokens = * && $.user_id = * }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricName: InputTokens
          MetricNamespace: CoWork/Telemetry
          MetricValue: '$.input_tokens'
          Dimensions:
            - Key: User
              Value: $.user_id

  CoWorkLocalOutputTokensByUser:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkTelemetryLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.schema = "local_agent" && $.output_tokens = * && $.user_id = * }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricName: OutputTokens
          MetricNamespace: CoWork/Telemetry
          MetricValue: '$.output_tokens'
          Dimensions:
            - Key: User
              Value: $.user_id

  CoWorkLocalCacheReadTokensByUser:

    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkTelemetryLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.schema = "local_agent" && $.cache_read_input_tokens = * && $.user_id = * }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricName: CacheReadTokens
          MetricNamespace: CoWork/Telemetry
          MetricValue: '$.cache_read_input_tokens'
          Dimensions:
            - Key: User
              Value: $.user_id

  CoWorkLocalCacheCreationTokensByUser:

    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkTelemetryLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.schema = "local_agent" && $.cache_creation_input_tokens = * && $.user_id = * }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricName: CacheCreationTokens
          MetricNamespace: CoWork/Telemetry
          MetricValue: '$.cache_creation_input_tokens'
          Dimensions:
            - Key: User

  CoWorkLocalEstimatedCostByUser:

    Properties:

      FilterPattern: '{ $.schema = "local_agent" && $.estimated_cost_usd = * && $.user_id = * }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricName: EstimatedCost
          MetricNamespace: CoWork/Telemetry
          MetricValue: '$.estimated_cost_usd'
          Dimensions:
            - Key: User
              Value: $.user_id

  CoWorkLocalSessionTurnsByUser:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkTelemetryLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.schema = "local_agent" && $.turn_count = * && $.user_id = * }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricName: SessionTurnCount
          MetricNamespace: CoWork/Telemetry
          MetricValue: '$.turn_count'
          Dimensions:
            - Key: User
              Value: $.user_id

  # --- Schema 1 with Model dimension (per-model attribution) -----------------
