final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Self-contained AWS CDK bootstrap stack. Creates the encrypted file asset bucket,
  the immutable container asset repository, a KMS key for asset encryption, the CDK
  IAM roles, and the bootstrap version SSM parameter, all scoped by a short qualifier.

Parameters:
  Qualifier:
    Type: String
    Default: hnb659fds
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9]{1,10}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a lowercase alphanumeric string of 1 to 10 characters.
    Description: >-
      Short qualifier appended to every resource name created by this stack so multiple
      bootstrap stacks can coexist in the same account and Region.

  FileAssetBucketName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: >-
      Name to give the file asset bucket. Leave empty to generate a qualifier scoped bucket name.

  TrustedAccounts:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ''
    Description: >-
      Comma separated list of AWS account IDs that are trusted to assume the bootstrap roles.

  KmsKeyAlias:
    Type: String
    Default: alias/cdk-bootstrap-key
    AllowedPattern: '^alias/[a-zA-Z0-9/_-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid KMS alias name beginning with alias/.
    Description: Alias of the KMS key that is created to encrypt the asset bucket.

  KmsKeyArnForBucket:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: >-
      ARN of an existing KMS key to use for asset bucket encryption. Leave empty to create a new key.

  CloudFormationExecutionPolicies:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess
    Description: >-
      Comma separated list of managed policy ARNs granted to the CloudFormation execution role.

Conditions:
  CreateNewBucket: !Equals [!Ref FileAssetBucketName, '']
  CreateNewKey: !Equals [!Ref KmsKeyArnForBucket, '']
  HasTrustedAccounts: !Not [!Equals [!Join ['', !Ref TrustedAccounts], '']]

Resources:

  FileAssetBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !If
        - CreateNewBucket
        - !Sub '${Qualifier}-assets-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
        - !Ref FileAssetBucketName
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !If
                - CreateNewKey
                - !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn
                - !Ref KmsKeyArnForBucket
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true

  FileAssetBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref FileAssetBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyNonSecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt FileAssetBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${FileAssetBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'

  ContainerAssetsRepository:
    Type: AWS::ECR::Repository
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      RepositoryName: !Sub '${Qualifier}-container-assets-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      ImageTagMutability: IMMUTABLE
      ImageScanningConfiguration:
        ScanOnPush: true
      RepositoryPolicyText:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowAccountAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action:
              - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
              - ecr:BatchGetImage
              - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
              - ecr:PutImage
              - ecr:InitiateLayerUpload
              - ecr:UploadLayerPart
              - ecr:CompleteLayerUpload
          - !If
            - HasTrustedAccounts
            - Sid: AllowTrustedAccountAccess
              Effect: Allow
              Principal:
                AWS: !Ref TrustedAccounts
              Action:
                - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
                - ecr:BatchGetImage
                - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
                - ecr:PutImage
                - ecr:InitiateLayerUpload
                - ecr:UploadLayerPart
                - ecr:CompleteLayerUpload
            - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'

  KmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Condition: CreateNewKey
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Key used to encrypt CDK bootstrap assets for the ${Qualifier} bootstrap stack'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowAccountAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowAssetPublishingRolesUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS:
                - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/${Qualifier}-file-publishing-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
                - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/${Qualifier}-image-publishing-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'

  KmsAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Condition: CreateNewKey
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Ref KmsKeyAlias
      TargetKeyId: !Ref KmsKey

  FilePublishingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${Qualifier}-file-publishing-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
          - !If
            - HasTrustedAccounts
            - Effect: Allow
              Principal:
                AWS: !Ref TrustedAccounts
              Action: sts:AssumeRole
              Condition:
                StringLike:
                  aws:PrincipalArn:
                    - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::*:root'
                    - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::*:user/*'
                    - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sts::*:assumed-role/*'
            - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FileAssetPublishingPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: AssetBucketObjects
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                Resource: !Sub '${FileAssetBucket.Arn}/*'
              - Sid: AssetBucketLocation
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                Resource: !GetAtt FileAssetBucket.Arn
              - Sid: AssetBucketKeyUsage
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:ReEncrypt*
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !If [CreateNewKey, !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn, !Ref KmsKeyArnForBucket]

  ImagePublishingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${Qualifier}-image-publishing-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
          - !If
            - HasTrustedAccounts
            - Effect: Allow
              Principal:
                AWS: !Ref TrustedAccounts
              Action: sts:AssumeRole
              Condition:
                StringLike:
                  aws:PrincipalArn:
                    - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::*:root'
                    - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::*:user/*'
                    - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sts::*:assumed-role/*'
            - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ContainerAssetPublishingPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: EcrAuthorization
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: ContainerRepositoryAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
                  - ecr:InitiateLayerUpload
                  - ecr:UploadLayerPart
                  - ecr:CompleteLayerUpload
                  - ecr:PutImage
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                  - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Provisions a self-contained AWS Service Catalog environment for the ML workshop.
  The template creates an admin portfolio and an end-user portfolio, the workshop
  products (VPC with private subnets and endpoints, IAM roles with KMS keys and S3
  buckets, an infrastructure product, an application product, a SageMaker notebook
  instance, an AWS Data Exchange data product, and a third-party ML model), a
  dedicated launch role per product bound with a launch role constraint, a customer
  managed KMS key with alias, an encrypted and versioned S3 bucket, SSM parameters
  under the /MLWorkshop/ path, and the lead (admin) and developer end-user roles that
  are associated to the correct portfolios. Every resource referenced by this template
  is created inside this same template.

Parameters:
  RootS3URL:
    Type: String
    Default: https://aws-service-catalog-reference-architectures.s3.amazonaws.com/blog_content/securing-third-party-data-and-ml-apps
    Description: Base URL of the S3 location that holds the nested product templates.
  EnvPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: user-1
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,15}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be 1-16 lowercase alphanumeric or hyphen characters, starting with alphanumeric.
    Description: Prefix used to namespace and tag all ML workshop resources.

Resources:

  ###############################################################################
  # Service Catalog portfolios
  ###############################################################################

  AdminPortfolio:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::Portfolio
    Properties:
      DisplayName: !Sub '${EnvPrefix}-ml-workshop-admin'
      ProviderName: MLWorkshopTeam
      Description: Admin portfolio for the machine learning workshop
      Tags:
        - Key: EnvPrefix
          Value: !Ref EnvPrefix
        - Key: Project
          Value: MLWorkshop
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: AdminPortfolio

  EndUserPortfolio:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::Portfolio
    Properties:
      DisplayName: !Sub '${EnvPrefix}-ml-workshop-enduser'
      ProviderName: MLWorkshopTeam
      Description: End user portfolio for the machine learning workshop
      Tags:
        - Key: EnvPrefix
          Value: !Ref EnvPrefix
        - Key: Project
          Value: MLWorkshop
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: EndUserPortfolio

  ###############################################################################
  # Service Catalog products (CloudFormation backed)
  ###############################################################################

  VpcProduct:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvPrefix}-ml-workshop-vpc'
      Owner: MLWorkshopTeam
      Description: VPC with private subnets and VPC endpoints for the ML workshop
      ProductType: CLOUD_FORMATION_TEMPLATE
      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Name: v1
          Description: Initial version of the workshop VPC product
          Info:
            LoadTemplateFromURL: !Sub '${RootS3URL}/vpc.yaml'
      Tags:
        - Key: EnvPrefix
          Value: !Ref EnvPrefix
        - Key: Project
          Value: MLWorkshop
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: VpcProduct

  IamProduct:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvPrefix}-ml-workshop-iam'
      Owner: MLWorkshopTeam
      Description: IAM roles with KMS keys and S3 buckets for the ML workshop
      ProductType: CLOUD_FORMATION_TEMPLATE
      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Name: v1
          Description: Initial version of the workshop IAM product
          Info:
            LoadTemplateFromURL: !Sub '${RootS3URL}/iam.yaml'
      Tags:
        - Key: EnvPrefix
          Value: !Ref EnvPrefix
        - Key: Project
          Value: MLWorkshop
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: IamProduct

  InfrastructureProduct:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvPrefix}-ml-workshop-infrastructure'
      Owner: MLWorkshopTeam
      Description: Shared workshop infrastructure product
      ProductType: CLOUD_FORMATION_TEMPLATE
      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Name: v1
          Description: Initial version of the workshop infrastructure product
          Info:
            LoadTemplateFromURL: !Sub '${RootS3URL}/infrastructure.yaml'
      Tags:
        - Key: EnvPrefix
          Value: !Ref EnvPrefix
        - Key: Project
          Value: MLWorkshop
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: InfrastructureProduct

  ApplicationProduct:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvPrefix}-ml-workshop-application'
      Owner: MLWorkshopTeam
      Description: Workshop application product
      ProductType: CLOUD_FORMATION_TEMPLATE
      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Name: v1
          Description: Initial version of the workshop application product
          Info:
            LoadTemplateFromURL: !Sub '${RootS3URL}/application.yaml'
      Tags:
        - Key: EnvPrefix
          Value: !Ref EnvPrefix
        - Key: Project
          Value: MLWorkshop
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: ApplicationProduct

  SageMakerNotebookProduct:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvPrefix}-ml-workshop-sagemaker-notebook'
      Owner: MLWorkshopTeam
      Description: SageMaker notebook instance product for the ML workshop
      ProductType: CLOUD_FORMATION_TEMPLATE
      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Name: v1
          Description: Initial version of the workshop SageMaker notebook product
          Info:
            LoadTemplateFromURL: !Sub '${RootS3URL}/sagemaker-notebook.yaml'
      Tags:
        - Key: EnvPrefix
          Value: !Ref EnvPrefix
        - Key: Project
          Value: MLWorkshop
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: SageMakerNotebookProduct

  ###############################################################################
  # Service Catalog products (marketplace backed listings)
  ###############################################################################

  DataExchangeProduct:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvPrefix}-ml-workshop-aws-data-exchange'
      Owner: MLWorkshopTeam
      Description: AWS Data Exchange third party data listing for the ML workshop
      ProductType: MARKETPLACE
      Tags:
        - Key: EnvPrefix
          Value: !Ref EnvPrefix
        - Key: Project
          Value: MLWorkshop
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: DataExchangeProduct

  ThirdPartyModelProduct:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvPrefix}-ml-workshop-third-party-model'
      Owner: MLWorkshopTeam
      Description: Third party machine learning model listing for the ML workshop
      ProductType: MARKETPLACE
      Tags:
        - Key: EnvPrefix
          Value: !Ref EnvPrefix
        - Key: Project
          Value: MLWorkshop
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: ThirdPartyModelProduct

  ###############################################################################
  # Portfolio / product associations
  ###############################################################################

  VpcProductAssociation:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::PortfolioProductAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref EndUserPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref VpcProduct

  ApplicationProductAssociation:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::PortfolioProductAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref EndUserPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref ApplicationProduct

  SageMakerNotebookProductAssociation:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::PortfolioProductAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref EndUserPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref SageMakerNotebookProduct

  DataExchangeProductAssociation:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::PortfolioProductAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref EndUserPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref DataExchangeProduct

  ThirdPartyModelProductAssociation:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::PortfolioProductAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref EndUserPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref ThirdPartyModelProduct

  IamProductAssociation:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::PortfolioProductAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref AdminPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref IamProduct

  InfrastructureProductAssociation:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::PortfolioProductAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref AdminPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref InfrastructureProduct

  ###############################################################################

    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvPrefix}-ml-workshop-launch-vpc'

                  - ec2:DescribeVpcEndpointServices

                  - ec2:CreateTags

                  - ec2:DescribeTags
                Resource:
                  - '*'
      Tags:

          Value: !Ref EnvPrefix
        - Key: Project

        - Key: Purpose

  IamLaunchRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role

    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub '${EnvPrefix} ML workshop customer managed key'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action:
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:GetKeyPolicy
              - kms:PutKeyPolicy
              - kms:CreateAlias
              - kms:UpdateAlias
              - kms:DeleteAlias
              - kms:EnableKeyRotation
              - kms:DisableKeyRotation
              - kms:TagResource
              - kms:UntagResource
              - kms:ListResourceTags
              - kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion
              - kms:CancelKeyDeletion
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncryptFrom
              - kms:ReEncryptTo
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext
            Resource:
              - '*'
          - Sid: AllowWorkshopRolesToUseKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS:

                - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/${EnvPrefix}-ml-workshop-enduser-developer'
            Action:

              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncryptFrom
              - kms:ReEncryptTo
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext
              - kms:DescribeKey

              - '*'

  WorkshopBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket

    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:

        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !Ref WorkshopKey
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      Tags:
        - Key: EnvPrefix
          Value: !Ref EnvPrefix
        - Key: Project
          Value: MLWorkshop
        - Key: workshop
          Value: ml
        - Key: provisioning
          Value: 'true'
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: WorkshopBucket

  WorkshopBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref WorkshopBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal:
              AWS:
                - '*'
            Action:
              - s3:GetObject
              - s3:PutObject
              - s3:DeleteObject
              - s3:ListBucket
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt WorkshopBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${WorkshopBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'
          - Sid: DenyUnencryptedObjectUploads
            Effect: Deny
            Principal:
              AWS:
                - '*'
            Action:
              - s3:PutObject
            Resource:
              - !Sub '${WorkshopBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              StringNotEquals:
                s3:x-amz-server-side-encryption: aws:kms

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Dual-stack (IPv4/IPv6) VPC network for a staging or production environment:
  three public subnets (two in the first Availability Zone for load balancer /
  presentation-tier use and one in a second Availability Zone for compute use),
  two private subnets in the first Availability Zone, an internet gateway, an
  egress-only internet gateway, public and private route tables, an optional NAT
  gateway, public and private network ACLs, an EC2 cluster placement group, and
  a DHCP options set. Exports the VPC, subnet, and private route table
  identifiers so sibling stacks can reference this network.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentType:
    Type: String
    Default: staging
    AllowedValues:
      - staging
      - production
    Description: Environment to build. Drives CIDR selection, resource naming, and the DHCP domain name.

  CreateNatGateway:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Set to 'true' to deploy a NAT gateway with an Elastic IP for private subnet IPv4 egress. Leave 'false' when a bastion host provides that role.

Conditions:
  IsNatGatewayEnabled: !Equals [!Ref CreateNatGateway, 'true']

Mappings:
  EnvironmentConfig:
    staging:
      VpcCidr: 10.0.0.0/16
      PublicSubnet1Cidr: 10.0.0.0/20
      PublicSubnet2Cidr: 10.0.16.0/20
      PublicSubnet3Cidr: 10.0.32.0/20
      PrivateSubnet1Cidr: 10.0.48.0/20
      PrivateSubnet2Cidr: 10.0.64.0/20
      DomainName: staging.internal
    production:
      VpcCidr: 10.1.0.0/16
      PublicSubnet1Cidr: 10.1.0.0/20
      PublicSubnet2Cidr: 10.1.16.0/20
      PublicSubnet3Cidr: 10.1.32.0/20
      PrivateSubnet1Cidr: 10.1.48.0/20
      PrivateSubnet2Cidr: 10.1.64.0/20
      DomainName: prod.internal

Resources:

  Vpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref EnvironmentType, VpcCidr]
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentType}-vpc'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentType

  VpcIpv6CidrBlock:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCCidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      AmazonProvidedIpv6CidrBlock: true

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DependsOn: VpcIpv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref EnvironmentType, PublicSubnet1Cidr]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentType}-public-subnet-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentType

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DependsOn: VpcIpv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref EnvironmentType, PublicSubnet2Cidr]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentType}-public-subnet-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentType

  PublicSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DependsOn: VpcIpv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref EnvironmentType, PublicSubnet3Cidr]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentType}-public-subnet-3'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentType

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DependsOn: VpcIpv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref EnvironmentType, PrivateSubnet1Cidr]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentType}-private-subnet-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentType

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DependsOn: VpcIpv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref EnvironmentType, PrivateSubnet2Cidr]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentType}-private-subnet-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentType

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentType}-igw'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentType

  VpcGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  EgressOnlyInternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EgressOnlyInternetGateway
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentType}-eigw'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentType

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentType}-public-rt'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentType

  PublicRouteIpv4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicRouteIpv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationIpv6CidrBlock: ::/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2

  PublicSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentType}-private-rt'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentType

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  NatEip:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Condition: IsNatGatewayEnabled
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentType}-nat-eip'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentType

  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Condition: IsNatGatewayEnabled
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEip.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentType}-nat-gateway'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentType

  PrivateRouteIpv4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: IsNatGatewayEnabled
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  PublicNetworkAcl:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAcl
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentType}-public-nacl'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentType

  PublicNaclInboundHttpIpv4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 100
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      CidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      PortRange:
        From: 80
        To: 80

  PublicNaclInboundHttpIpv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 101

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  SageMaker Studio user profile for the MLOps engineer persona together with a
  scoped SageMaker execution role. If an existing Studio domain ID is supplied,
  the user profile is attached to that domain; otherwise the template creates a
  self-contained VPC, two subnets, an internet gateway, a security group, and a
  PublicInternetOnly SageMaker Studio domain.

Parameters:
  StudioDomainId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: >-
      Optional ID of an existing SageMaker Studio domain (for example
      d-xxxxxxxxxxxx). Leave empty to have this template create a new
      self-contained SageMaker Studio domain.
  SecurityGroupIds:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: >-
      Optional comma-separated list of security group IDs that are attached to
      the existing SageMaker Studio domain supplied in StudioDomainId. Only
      used when StudioDomainId is not empty.
  SubnetIds:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: >-
      Optional comma-separated list of subnet IDs that are attached to the
      existing SageMaker Studio domain supplied in StudioDomainId. Only used
      when StudioDomainId is not empty.
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: mlops-platform
    Description: Name of the project that owns these resources (used for tagging).
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - test
      - staging
      - prod
    Description: Deployment environment for these resources (used for tagging).

Conditions:
  HasExistingDomain: !Not [!Equals [!Ref StudioDomainId, '']]
  CreateNewDomain: !Equals [!Ref StudioDomainId, '']

Resources:

  ##########################################################################
  # Greenfield network - created only when no existing domain is supplied
  ##########################################################################

  StudioVpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Condition: CreateNewDomain
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-studio-vpc'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Persona
          Value: MLOpsEngineer
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  PrivateSubnetA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: CreateNewDomain
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref StudioVpc
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 0
        - !GetAZs
          Ref: AWS::Region
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/24
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-studio-subnet-a'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Persona
          Value: MLOpsEngineer
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  PrivateSubnetB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: CreateNewDomain
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref StudioVpc
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 1
        - !GetAZs
          Ref: AWS::Region
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-studio-subnet-b'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Persona
          Value: MLOpsEngineer
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  StudioInternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Condition: CreateNewDomain
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-studio-igw'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Persona
          Value: MLOpsEngineer
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  StudioVpcGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Condition: CreateNewDomain
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref StudioVpc
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref StudioInternetGateway

  StudioRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Condition: CreateNewDomain
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref StudioVpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-studio-rtb'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Persona
          Value: MLOpsEngineer
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  StudioPublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: CreateNewDomain
    DependsOn: StudioVpcGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref StudioRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref StudioInternetGateway

  StudioSubnetARouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: CreateNewDomain
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnetA
      RouteTableId: !Ref StudioRouteTable

  StudioSubnetBRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: CreateNewDomain
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnetB
      RouteTableId: !Ref StudioRouteTable

  DomainSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Condition: CreateNewDomain
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: !Sub '${AWS::StackName} SageMaker Studio domain HTTPS access'
      VpcId: !Ref StudioVpc
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - Description: Allow all outbound traffic within the Studio VPC
          IpProtocol: '-1'
          CidrIp: !GetAtt StudioVpc.CidrBlock
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-studio-domain-sg'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Persona
          Value: MLOpsEngineer
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  DomainSecurityGroupHttpsIngress:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Condition: CreateNewDomain
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref DomainSecurityGroup
      Description: Allow HTTPS traffic between Studio domain resources
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 443
      ToPort: 443
      SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref DomainSecurityGroup

  ##########################################################################
  # IAM roles
  ##########################################################################

  SageMakerUserRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-sagemaker-user-role'
      Description: Per-user SageMaker execution role passed by the MLOps engineer execution role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowSageMakerServiceToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sagemaker.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSageMakerFullAccess
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Persona
          Value: MLOpsEngineer
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  MLOpsExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-mlops-execution-role'
      Description: Execution role for the MLOps engineer SageMaker Studio persona
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowSageMakerServiceToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sagemaker.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PassSageMakerUserRole
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: AllowPassRoleToSageMakerServiceOnly
                Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:PassRole
                Resource: !GetAtt SageMakerUserRole.Arn
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    iam:PassedToService: sagemaker.amazonaws.com
        - PolicyName: SageMakerPipelines
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ManagePipelinesAndPipelineExecutions
                Effect: Allow
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:pipeline/*'
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreatePipeline
                  - sagemaker:UpdatePipeline
                  - sagemaker:DeletePipeline
                  - sagemaker:DescribePipeline
                  - sagemaker:StartPipelineExecution
                  - sagemaker:StopPipelineExecution
                  - sagemaker:RetryPipelineExecution
                  - sagemaker:UpdatePipelineExecution
                  - sagemaker:DescribePipelineExecution
                  - sagemaker:DescribePipelineDefinitionForExecution
              - Sid: ListPipelinesAndPipelineExecutions
                Effect: Allow
                Resource: '*'
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:ListPipelines
                  - sagemaker:ListPipelineExecutions
                  - sagemaker:ListPipelineExecutionSteps
        - PolicyName: SageMakerMonitoringAndProcessing
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ManageMonitoringSchedules
                Effect: Allow
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:monitoring-schedule/*'
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateMonitoringSchedule
                  - sagemaker:UpdateMonitoringSchedule
                  - sagemaker:DeleteMonitoringSchedule
                  - sagemaker:DescribeMonitoringSchedule
                  - sagemaker:StartMonitoringSchedule
                  - sagemaker:StopMonitoringSchedule
              - Sid: ManageMonitoringProcessingJobs
                Effect: Allow
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:processing-job/*'
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateProcessingJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeProcessingJob
                  - sagemaker:StopProcessingJob
              - Sid: ListMonitoringSchedulesAndProcessingJobs
                Effect: Allow
                Resource: '*'
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:ListMonitoringSchedules
                  - sagemaker:ListProcessingJobs
        - PolicyName: SageMakerModelsAndModelRegistry
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ManageModels
                Effect: Allow
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:model/*'
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateModel
                  - sagemaker:DeleteModel
                  - sagemaker:DescribeModel
              - Sid: ManageModelPackageGroupsAndPackages
                Effect: Allow
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:model-package-group/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:model-package/*'
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateModelPackageGroup
                  - sagemaker:DescribeModelPackageGroup
                  - sagemaker:CreateModelPackage
                  - sagemaker:UpdateModelPackage
                  - sagemaker:DescribeModelPackage
                  - sagemaker:PutModelPackageGroupPolicy
                  - sagemaker:GetModelPackageGroupPolicy
              - Sid: ListModelsAndRegistryResources
                Effect: Allow
                Resource: '*'
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:ListModels
                  - sagemaker:ListModelPackageGroups
                  - sagemaker:ListModelPackages
        - PolicyName: SageMakerExperimentsAndLineage
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ManageExperimentsTrialsAndTrialComponents
                Effect: Allow
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:experiment/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:experiment-trial/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:experiment-trial-component/*'
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateExperiment
                  - sagemaker:DescribeExperiment
                  - sagemaker:CreateTrial
                  - sagemaker:DescribeTrial
                  - sagemaker:AssociateTrialComponent
                  - sagemaker:CreateTrialComponent
                  - sagemaker:DescribeTrialComponent
              - Sid: ViewLineageGroups
                Effect: Allow
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:lineage-group/*'
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:DescribeLineageGroup
              - Sid: ListExperimentsTrialsAndLineage
                Effect: Allow
                Resource: '*'
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:ListExperiments
                  - sagemaker:ListTrials
                  - sagemaker:ListTrialComponents
                  - sagemaker:ListLineageGroups
              - Sid: QueryAndAssociateLineage
                Effect: Allow
                Resource: '*'
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:AddAssociation
                  - sagemaker:QueryLineage
        - PolicyName: SageMakerJobExecution
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ManageTrainingTransformAndTuningJobs
                Effect: Allow
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:training-job/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:transform-job/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:hyper-parameter-tuning-job/*'
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateTrainingJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeTrainingJob
                  - sagemaker:StopTrainingJob
                  - sagemaker:CreateTransformJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeTransformJob
                  - sagemaker:StopTransformJob
                  - sagemaker:CreateHyperParameterTuningJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeHyperParameterTuningJob
                  - sagemaker:StopHyperParameterTuningJob
              - Sid: ListJobs
                Effect: Allow
                Resource: '*'
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:ListTrainingJobs
                  - sagemaker:ListTransformJobs
                  - sagemaker:ListHyperParameterTuningJobs
        - PolicyName: SageMakerEndpoints
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ManageEndpointsAndEndpointConfigurations
                Effect: Allow
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:endpoint/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:endpoint-config/*'
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateEndpoint
                  - sagemaker:CreateEndpointConfig
                  - sagemaker:UpdateEndpoint
                  - sagemaker:UpdateEndpointWeightsAndCapacities
                  - sagemaker:DeleteEndpoint
                  - sagemaker:DeleteEndpointConfig
                  - sagemaker:DescribeEndpoint
                  - sagemaker:DescribeEndpointConfig
                  - sagemaker:InvokeEndpoint
                  - sagemaker:InvokeEndpointAsync
              - Sid: ListEndpointsAndEndpointConfigurations
                Effect: Allow
                Resource: '*'
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:ListEndpoints
                  - sagemaker:ListEndpointConfigs
        - PolicyName: SageMakerStudioAppsAndSpaces
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: CreateStudioAppsAndSpaces
                Effect: Allow
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:app/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:space/*'
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateApp
                  - sagemaker:CreateSpace
              - Sid: ManageOwnedStudioAppsAndSpaces
                Effect: Allow
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:app/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:space/*'
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:DeleteApp
                  - sagemaker:DescribeApp
                  - sagemaker:UpdateSpace
                  - sagemaker:DeleteSpace
                  - sagemaker:DescribeSpace
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    aws:ResourceTag/Owner: '${aws:userid}'
              - Sid: ListStudioAppsAndSpaces
                Effect: Allow
                Resource: '*'
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:ListApps
                  - sagemaker:ListSpaces
              - Sid: AccessStudioDomain
                Effect: Allow
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:domain/*'
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:DescribeDomain
                  - sagemaker:CreatePresignedDomainUrl
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Persona
          Value: MLOpsEngineer
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  ##########################################################################
  # SageMaker Studio domain (only created when no existing domain is given)
  ##########################################################################

  SageMakerDomain:
    Type: AWS::SageMaker::Domain
    Condition: CreateNewDomain
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      DomainName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-studio-domain'
      AuthMode: IAM
      AppNetworkAccessType: PublicInternetOnly
      VpcId: !Ref StudioVpc
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnetA
        - !Ref PrivateSubnetB
      DefaultUserSettings:
        ExecutionRole: !GetAtt MLOpsExecutionRole.Arn
        SecurityGroups:
          - !Ref DomainSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Persona
          Value: MLOpsEngineer
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  ##########################################################################
  # SageMaker Studio user profile (attached to either domain)
  ##########################################################################

  SageMakerUserProfile:
    Type: AWS::SageMaker::UserProfile
    Properties:
      DomainId: !If
        - HasExistingDomain
        - !Ref StudioDomainId
        - !GetAtt SageMakerDomain.DomainId
      UserProfileName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-mlops-engineer'
      UserSettings:
        ExecutionRole: !GetAtt MLOpsExecutionRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Persona
          Value: MLOpsEngineer
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

Outputs:
  UserProfileArn:
    Description: ARN of the SageMaker Studio user profile for the MLOps engineer persona
    Value: !GetAtt SageMakerUserProfile.UserProfileArn
  StudioDomainId:
    Description: ID of the SageMaker Studio domain the user profile is attached to
    Value: !If
      - HasExistingDomain
      - !Ref StudioDomainId
      - !GetAtt SageMakerDomain.DomainId
  MLOpsExecutionRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the MLOps engineer SageMaker execution role
    Value: !GetAtt MLOpsExecutionRole.Arn
  SageMakerUserRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the per-user SageMaker execution role that the MLOps engineer role may pass
    Value: !GetAtt SageMakerUserRole.Arn
  ExistingDomainSubnetIds:
    Condition: HasExistingDomain
    Description: Subnet IDs supplied for the existing SageMaker Studio domain
    Value: !Ref SubnetIds
  ExistingDomainSecurityGroupIds:
    Condition: HasExistingDomain
    Description: Security group IDs supplied for the existing SageMaker Studio domain
    Value: !Ref SecurityGroupIds

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Cross-region failover monitoring stack. Defines composite CloudWatch alarms
  (API Gateway Health, Lambda Health, RDS Health) that aggregate OR-based member
  metric alarms for the existing Remittance API Gateway API, the existing
  GetRemittances and CreateRemittance Lambda functions, and the existing
  dbcluster1-instance1 RDS instance. This template creates monitoring resources
  only and references the monitored targets by dimension name.

Parameters:
  ApiGatewayName:
    Type: String
    Default: Remittance
    Description: ApiName dimension value of the existing Remittance API Gateway API.
  GetRemittancesFunctionName:
    Type: String
    Default: GetRemittances
    Description: FunctionName dimension value of the existing GetRemittances Lambda function.
  CreateRemittanceFunctionName:
    Type: String
    Default: CreateRemittance
    Description: FunctionName dimension value of the existing CreateRemittance Lambda function.
  DbInstanceIdentifier:
    Type: String
    Default: dbcluster1-instance1
    Description: DBInstanceIdentifier dimension value of the existing RDS instance.
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod
    Description: Environment name applied to the monitoring resources as a tag.

Resources:

  ###########################################################################
  # API Gateway metric alarms
  ###########################################################################
  ApiGateway4xxErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: API Gateway 4XX Errors
      AlarmDescription: API Gateway 4XX errors averaged over 300 seconds is greater than 0.
      Namespace: AWS/ApiGateway
      MetricName: 4XXError
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ApiName
          Value: !Ref ApiGatewayName
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: Remittance
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  ApiGateway5xxErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: API Gateway 5XX Errors
      AlarmDescription: API Gateway 5XX errors averaged over 60 seconds is greater than 1.
      Namespace: AWS/ApiGateway
      MetricName: 5XXError
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ApiName
          Value: !Ref ApiGatewayName
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: Remittance
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  ApiGatewayLatencyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: API Gateway Latency
      AlarmDescription: API Gateway latency averaged over 300 seconds is at or above 10000 milliseconds.
      Namespace: AWS/ApiGateway
      MetricName: Latency
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ApiName
          Value: !Ref ApiGatewayName
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10000
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: Remittance
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  ###########################################################################
  # Lambda metric alarms - GetRemittances
  ###########################################################################
  GetRemittancesErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${GetRemittancesFunctionName} Errors'
      AlarmDescription: Summed GetRemittances Lambda errors over 60 seconds is greater than 0.
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Errors
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: !Ref GetRemittancesFunctionName
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: Remittance
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  GetRemittancesInvocationsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${GetRemittancesFunctionName} Invocations'
      AlarmDescription: Summed GetRemittances Lambda invocations over 60 seconds is greater than 2.
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Invocations
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: !Ref GetRemittancesFunctionName
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 2
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: Remittance
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  GetRemittancesDurationAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${GetRemittancesFunctionName} Duration'
      AlarmDescription: Average GetRemittances Lambda duration over 900 seconds is at or above 10000 milliseconds.
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Duration
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: !Ref GetRemittancesFunctionName
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 900
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10000
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: missing
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: Remittance
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  ###########################################################################
  # Lambda metric alarms - CreateRemittance
  ###########################################################################
  CreateRemittanceErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${CreateRemittanceFunctionName} Errors'
      AlarmDescription: Summed CreateRemittance Lambda errors over 60 seconds is greater than 0.
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Errors
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: !Ref CreateRemittanceFunctionName
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: Remittance
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  CreateRemittanceInvocationsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${CreateRemittanceFunctionName} Invocations'
      AlarmDescription: Summed CreateRemittance Lambda invocations over 60 seconds is greater than 2.
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Invocations
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: !Ref CreateRemittanceFunctionName
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 2
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: Remittance
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  CreateRemittanceDurationAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${CreateRemittanceFunctionName} Duration'
      AlarmDescription: Average CreateRemittance Lambda duration over 900 seconds is at or above 10000 milliseconds.
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Duration
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: !Ref CreateRemittanceFunctionName
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 900
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10000
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: missing
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: Remittance
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  ###########################################################################
  # RDS metric alarms
  ###########################################################################
  RdsCpuUtilizationAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: RDS CPU Utilization
      AlarmDescription: Average RDS CPU utilization over 300 seconds is at or above 70 percent.
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: CPUUtilization
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref DbInstanceIdentifier
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 70
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: Remittance
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  RdsDatabaseConnectionsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: RDS Database Connections
      AlarmDescription: Average RDS database connections over 300 seconds is at or above 100.
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: DatabaseConnections
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref DbInstanceIdentifier
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 100
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: Remittance
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  RdsDeadlocksAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: RDS Deadlocks
      AlarmDescription: Average RDS deadlocks over 300 seconds is at or above 10.
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: Deadlocks
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref DbInstanceIdentifier
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: Remittance
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  RdsNetworkTransmitThroughputAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: RDS Network Transmit Throughput
      AlarmDescription: Average RDS network transmit throughput over 300 seconds is at or above 10485760 bytes per second.
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: NetworkTransmitThroughput
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref DbInstanceIdentifier
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10485760
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: Remittance
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  RdsNetworkReceiveThroughputAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: RDS Network Receive Throughput
      AlarmDescription: Average RDS network receive throughput over 300 seconds is at or above 10485760 bytes per second.
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: NetworkReceiveThroughput
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref DbInstanceIdentifier
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10485760
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: Remittance
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  RdsQueriesAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: RDS Queries
      AlarmDescription: Average RDS queries over 300 seconds is at or above 100 per second.
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: Queries
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref DbInstanceIdentifier
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 100
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: Remittance
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  RdsDiskQueueDepthAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: RDS Disk Queue Depth
      AlarmDescription: Average RDS disk queue depth over 300 seconds is at or above 50.
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: DiskQueueDepth
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref DbInstanceIdentifier
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 50
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: Remittance
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  RdsReadLatencyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: RDS Read Latency
      AlarmDescription: Average RDS read latency over 300 seconds is at or above 0.1 seconds.
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: ReadLatency
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref DbInstanceIdentifier
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 0.1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: Remittance
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  RdsWriteLatencyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: RDS Write Latency
      AlarmDescription: Average RDS write latency over 300 seconds is at or above 0.1 seconds.
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: WriteLatency
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref DbInstanceIdentifier
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 0.1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: Remittance
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  ###########################################################################
  # Composite health alarms (OR-based rollups)
  ###########################################################################
  ApiGatewayHealthAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::CompositeAlarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: API Gateway Health
      AlarmDescription: Composite health rollup for the Remittance API Gateway; ALARM when any API Gateway metric alarm is in ALARM.
      AlarmRule: !Join
        - ' OR '
        - - !Sub 'ALARM(${ApiGateway4xxErrorsAlarm})'
          - !Sub 'ALARM(${ApiGateway5xxErrorsAlarm})'
          - !Sub 'ALARM(${ApiGatewayLatencyAlarm})'
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: Remittance
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  LambdaHealthAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::CompositeAlarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: Lambda Health
      AlarmDescription: Composite health rollup for the Remittance Lambda functions; ALARM when any Lambda error or duration alarm is in ALARM.
      AlarmRule: !Join
        - ' OR '
        - - !Sub 'ALARM(${GetRemittancesErrorsAlarm})'
          - !Sub 'ALARM(${CreateRemittanceErrorsAlarm})'
          - !Sub 'ALARM(${GetRemittancesDurationAlarm})'
          - !Sub 'ALARM(${CreateRemittanceDurationAlarm})'
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: Remittance
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  RdsHealthAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::CompositeAlarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: RDS Health
      AlarmDescription: Composite health rollup for the Remittance RDS instance; ALARM when any RDS metric alarm is in ALARM.
      AlarmRule: !Join
        - ' OR '
        - - !Sub 'ALARM(${RdsCpuUtilizationAlarm})'
          - !Sub 'ALARM(${RdsDatabaseConnectionsAlarm})'
          - !Sub 'ALARM(${RdsDeadlocksAlarm})'
          - !Sub 'ALARM(${RdsNetworkTransmitThroughputAlarm})'
          - !Sub 'ALARM(${RdsNetworkReceiveThroughputAlarm})'
          - !Sub 'ALARM(${RdsQueriesAlarm})'
          - !Sub 'ALARM(${RdsDiskQueueDepthAlarm})'
          - !Sub 'ALARM(${RdsReadLatencyAlarm})'
          - !Sub 'ALARM(${RdsWriteLatencyAlarm})'
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: Remittance
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

Outputs:
  ApiGatewayHealthAlarmName:
    Description: Name of the API Gateway Health composite alarm.
    Value: !Ref ApiGatewayHealthAlarm
  ApiGatewayHealthAlarmArn:
    Description: ARN of the API Gateway Health composite alarm.
    Value: !GetAtt ApiGatewayHealthAlarm.Arn
  LambdaHealthAlarmName:
    Description: Name of the Lambda Health composite alarm.
    Value: !Ref LambdaHealthAlarm
  LambdaHealthAlarmArn:
    Description: ARN of the Lambda Health composite alarm.
    Value: !GetAtt LambdaHealthAlarm.Arn
  RdsHealthAlarmName:
    Description: Name of the RDS Health composite alarm.
    Value: !Ref RdsHealthAlarm
  RdsHealthAlarmArn:
    Description: ARN of the RDS Health composite alarm.
    Value: !GetAtt RdsHealthAlarm.Arn
