final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Admin Suite QuickSight monitoring and data extraction pipeline: seven AWS Glue jobs
  (five Python shell, two Spark ETL) collecting QuickSight asset access, asset metadata,
  folder structure, Q topic metadata, Q object access, dataset properties, and data source
  properties; five CloudWatch metric streams publishing QuickSight metrics to five
  direct-put Firehose delivery streams; and one private, customer-managed-key encrypted,
  TLS-only S3 bucket (full public-access block, DeletionPolicy Retain) that stores every job
  and stream output. Fully self-contained for a greenfield account. See the template Metadata
  section for the script-staging gap and the PythonVersion deviation notes.

Metadata:
  AdminSuiteNotes:
    ScriptStaging: >-
      KNOWN GAP: CloudFormation cannot upload Glue job script objects. This template creates
      the scripts bucket and the expected s3://<scripts-bucket>/scripts/<job-name>.py layout,
      but the seven script objects must be staged in that bucket before the 3-hour schedules
      fire, since nothing pre-exists in the greenfield account.
    PythonVersionDeviation: >-
      KNOWN DEVIATION: AWS::Glue::Job PythonVersion accepts only '2' or '3'. Glue 3.0
      python-shell runs Python 3.7.9, so a literal Python "3.9" cannot be expressed; '3' is
      used for the five Python shell jobs. The two ETL jobs run on Glue 5.0 with WorkerType
      G.1X and NumberOfWorkers 2.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: prod
    AllowedValues:
      - prod
      - dev
      - test
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 16
    Description: Environment label applied as a tag to the resources created by this template.

Resources:

  ############################################################################
  # Customer managed KMS key (used by both buckets and Firehose delivery)
  ############################################################################

  AdminSuiteKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key for the Admin Suite QuickSight extraction pipeline (S3 output and scripts bucket encryption, Firehose delivery encryption).
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableAccountRootPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowAccountPrincipalsViaServices
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action:
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey'
              - 'kms:DescribeKey'
              - 'kms:Encrypt'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'kms:ViaService':
                  - !Sub 's3.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
                  - !Sub 'firehose.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
          - Sid: AllowServiceUseViaS3AndFirehose
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - glue.amazonaws.com
                - firehose.amazonaws.com
                - streams.metrics.cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey'
              - 'kms:DescribeKey'
              - 'kms:Encrypt'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'kms:ViaService':
                  - !Sub 's3.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
                  - !Sub 'firehose.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'

  AdminSuiteKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/admin-suite-${AWS::AccountId}'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref AdminSuiteKey

  ############################################################################
  # Storage
  ############################################################################

  OutputBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub 'admin-suite-${AWS::AccountId}'
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !Ref AdminSuiteKey
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: AbortIncompleteMultipartUploads
            Status: Enabled
            AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload:
              DaysAfterInitiation: 7
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub 'admin-suite-${AWS::AccountId}'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  ScriptsBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub 'admin-suite-scripts-${AWS::AccountId}'
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !Ref AdminSuiteKey
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub 'admin-suite-scripts-${AWS::AccountId}'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  OutputBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref OutputBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyUnsecuredTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt OutputBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${OutputBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                'aws:SecureTransport': 'false'
          - Sid: DenyPublicPrincipals
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt OutputBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${OutputBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              StringNotEquals:
                'aws:PrincipalAccount': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'

  ScriptsBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref ScriptsBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyUnsecuredTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt ScriptsBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${ScriptsBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                'aws:SecureTransport': 'false'
          - Sid: DenyPublicPrincipals
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt ScriptsBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${ScriptsBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              StringNotEquals:
                'aws:PrincipalAccount': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'

  ############################################################################
  # Shared execution role (Glue jobs, Firehose delivery, CloudWatch metric
  # streams, and CloudFormation administration of this stack)
  ############################################################################

  AdminSuiteRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'admin-suite-role-${AWS::AccountId}'
      Description: Shared role for the Admin Suite QuickSight extraction jobs, Firehose delivery streams, and CloudWatch metric streams.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowServiceAssumption
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - glue.amazonaws.com
                - cloudformation.amazonaws.com
                - firehose.amazonaws.com
                - streams.metrics.cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: admin-suite-access-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: QuickSightReadAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'quicksight:DescribeAccountSettings'
                  - 'quicksight:DescribeAccountSubscription'
                  - 'quicksight:DescribeAnalysis'
                  - 'quicksight:DescribeAnalysisPermissions'
                  - 'quicksight:DescribeDashboard'
                  - 'quicksight:DescribeDashboardPermissions'
                  - 'quicksight:DescribeDataSet'
                  - 'quicksight:DescribeDataSetPermissions'
                  - 'quicksight:DescribeDataSetRefreshProperties'
                  - 'quicksight:DescribeDataSource'
                  - 'quicksight:DescribeDataSourcePermissions'
                  - 'quicksight:DescribeFolder'
                  - 'quicksight:DescribeFolderPermissions'
                  - 'quicksight:DescribeFolderResolvedPermissions'
                  - 'quicksight:DescribeIngestion'
                  - 'quicksight:DescribeTemplate'
                  - 'quicksight:DescribeTheme'
                  - 'quicksight:DescribeTopic'
                  - 'quicksight:DescribeTopicPermissions'
                  - 'quicksight:ListAnalyses'
                  - 'quicksight:ListDashboards'
                  - 'quicksight:ListDataSets'
                  - 'quicksight:ListDataSources'
                  - 'quicksight:ListFolderMembers'
                  - 'quicksight:ListFolders'
                  - 'quicksight:ListGroupMemberships'
                  - 'quicksight:ListGroups'
                  - 'quicksight:ListIngestions'
                  - 'quicksight:ListNamespaces'
                  - 'quicksight:ListTagsForResource'
                  - 'quicksight:ListTemplateAliases'
                  - 'quicksight:ListTemplates'
                  - 'quicksight:ListThemes'
                  - 'quicksight:ListTopicReviewedAnswers'
                  - 'quicksight:ListTopics'
                  - 'quicksight:ListUserGroups'
                  - 'quicksight:ListUsers'
                  - 'quicksight:SearchAnalyses'
                  - 'quicksight:SearchDashboards'
                  - 'quicksight:SearchFolders'
                  - 'quicksight:SearchTopics'
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: GlueJobAndCatalogAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'glue:GetJob'
                  - 'glue:GetJobs'
                  - 'glue:GetJobRun'
                  - 'glue:GetJobRuns'
                  - 'glue:StartJobRun'
                  - 'glue:BatchStopJobRun'
                  - 'glue:GetTrigger'
                  - 'glue:GetTriggers'
                  - 'glue:StartTrigger'
                  - 'glue:StopTrigger'
                  - 'glue:GetDatabase'
                  - 'glue:GetDatabases'
                  - 'glue:GetTable'
                  - 'glue:GetTables'
                  - 'glue:GetPartition'
                  - 'glue:GetPartitions'
                  - 'glue:CreateTable'
                  - 'glue:UpdateTable'
                  - 'glue:BatchCreatePartition'
                  - 'glue:BatchUpdatePartition'
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:glue:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:job/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:glue:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:trigger/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:glue:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:catalog'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:glue:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:database/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:glue:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/*'
              - Sid: TemplateBucketObjectAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 's3:GetObject'
                  - 's3:GetObjectVersion'
                  - 's3:PutObject'
                  - 's3:DeleteObject'
                  - 's3:AbortMultipartUpload'
                  - 's3:ListMultipartUploadParts'
                Resource:
                  - !Sub '${OutputBucket.Arn}/*'
                  - !Sub '${ScriptsBucket.Arn}/*'
              - Sid: TemplateBucketListAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 's3:ListBucket'
                  - 's3:ListBucketMultipartUploads'
                  - 's3:GetBucketLocation'
                  - 's3:GetBucketVersioning'
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt OutputBucket.Arn
                  - !GetAtt ScriptsBucket.Arn
              - Sid: KmsUseForBucketsAndFirehose
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'kms:Decrypt'
                  - 'kms:GenerateDataKey'
                  - 'kms:DescribeKey'
                  - 'kms:Encrypt'
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt AdminSuiteKey.Arn
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    'kms:ViaService':
                      - !Sub 's3.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
                      - !Sub 'firehose.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
              - Sid: CloudWatchMetricsAndLogsAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'cloudwatch:PutMetricData'
                  - 'cloudwatch:ListMetrics'
                  - 'cloudwatch:GetMetricData'
                  - 'cloudwatch:GetMetricStatistics'
                  - 'logs:CreateLogGroup'
                  - 'logs:CreateLogStream'
                  - 'logs:PutLogEvents'
                  - 'logs:DescribeLogGroups'
                  - 'logs:DescribeLogStreams'
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: FirehoseDeliveryAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'firehose:PutRecord'
                  - 'firehose:PutRecordBatch'
                  - 'firehose:CreateDeliveryStream'
                  - 'firehose:DescribeDeliveryStream'
                  - 'firehose:ListDeliveryStreams'
                  - 'firehose:UpdateDestination'
                  - 'firehose:TagDeliveryStream'
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:firehose:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:deliverystream/*'
              - Sid: PassAdminSuiteRoleOnly
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'iam:PassRole'
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/admin-suite-role-${AWS::AccountId}'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    'iam:PassedToService':
                      - glue.amazonaws.com
                      - firehose.amazonaws.com
                      - streams.metrics.cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub 'admin-suite-role-${AWS::AccountId}'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  ############################################################################
  # Glue jobs - five Python shell jobs (Glue 3.0)
  ############################################################################

  GlueJobAssetsAccess:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_assets_access
      Description: Collects Amazon QuickSight asset access details.
      Role: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '3.0'
      MaxCapacity: 1
      Timeout: 120
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: '3'
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${ScriptsBucket}/scripts/etl_job_admin_suite_assets_access.py'
      DefaultArguments:
        '--region': !Ref 'AWS::Region'
        '--account_id': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
        '--output_bucket': !Ref OutputBucket
        '--output_prefix': 'quicksight/assets-access/'

  GlueJobAssetsMetadata:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_assets_metadata
      Description: Collects Amazon QuickSight asset metadata.
      Role: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '3.0'
      MaxCapacity: 1
      Timeout: 120
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: '3'
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${ScriptsBucket}/scripts/etl_job_admin_suite_assets_metadata.py'
      DefaultArguments:
        '--region': !Ref 'AWS::Region'
        '--account_id': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
        '--output_bucket': !Ref OutputBucket
        '--output_prefix': 'quicksight/assets-metadata/'

  GlueJobFolderAssets:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_folder_assets
      Description: Collects Amazon QuickSight folder structure information.
      Role: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '3.0'
      MaxCapacity: 1
      Timeout: 120
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: '3'
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${ScriptsBucket}/scripts/etl_job_admin_suite_folder_assets.py'
      DefaultArguments:
        '--region': !Ref 'AWS::Region'
        '--account_id': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
        '--output_bucket': !Ref OutputBucket
        '--output_prefix': 'quicksight/folder-assets/'

  GlueJobQMetadata:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_q_metadata
      Description: Collects Amazon QuickSight Q topic metadata.
      Role: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '3.0'
      MaxCapacity: 1
      Timeout: 120
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: '3'
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${ScriptsBucket}/scripts/etl_job_admin_suite_q_metadata.py'
      DefaultArguments:
        '--region': !Ref 'AWS::Region'
        '--account_id': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
        '--output_bucket': !Ref OutputBucket
        '--output_prefix': 'quicksight/q-metadata/'

  GlueJobQAccess:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_q_access
      Description: Collects Amazon QuickSight Q object access details.
      Role: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '3.0'
      MaxCapacity: 1
      Timeout: 120
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: '3'
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${ScriptsBucket}/scripts/etl_job_admin_suite_q_access.py'
      DefaultArguments:
        '--region': !Ref 'AWS::Region'
        '--account_id': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
        '--output_bucket': !Ref OutputBucket
        '--output_prefix': 'quicksight/q-access/'

  ############################################################################
  # Glue jobs - two Spark ETL jobs (Glue 5.0, G.1X x 2 workers)
  ############################################################################

  GlueJobDsProperties:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_ds_properties
      Description: Extracts Amazon QuickSight dataset properties.
      Role: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '5.0'
      WorkerType: G.1X
      NumberOfWorkers: 2
      Timeout: 120
      MaxRetries: 0
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${ScriptsBucket}/scripts/etl_job_admin_suite_ds_properties.py'
      DefaultArguments:
        '--region': !Ref 'AWS::Region'
        '--account_id': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
        '--output_bucket': !Ref OutputBucket
        '--output_prefix': 'quicksight/dataset-properties/'
        '--TempDir': !Sub 's3://${ScriptsBucket}/tmp/etl_job_admin_suite_ds_properties/'
        '--enable-metrics': 'true'
        '--enable-continuous-cloudwatch-log': 'true'
        '--job-language': 'python'

  GlueJobDatasourceProperties:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_datasource_properties
      Description: Extracts Amazon QuickSight data source properties.
      Role: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '5.0'
      WorkerType: G.1X
      NumberOfWorkers: 2
      Timeout: 120
      MaxRetries: 0
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${ScriptsBucket}/scripts/etl_job_admin_suite_datasource_properties.py'
      DefaultArguments:
        '--region': !Ref 'AWS::Region'
        '--account_id': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
        '--output_bucket': !Ref OutputBucket
        '--output_prefix': 'quicksight/datasource-properties/'
        '--TempDir': !Sub 's3://${ScriptsBucket}/tmp/etl_job_admin_suite_datasource_properties/'
        '--enable-metrics': 'true'
        '--enable-continuous-cloudwatch-log': 'true'
        '--job-language': 'python'

  ############################################################################
  # Glue triggers - every 3 hours, one per job
  ############################################################################

  TriggerAssetsAccess:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: trigger_admin_suite_assets_access
      Description: Runs etl_job_admin_suite_assets_access every 3 hours.
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: 'cron(0 */3 * * ? *)'
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref GlueJobAssetsAccess

  TriggerAssetsMetadata:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: trigger_admin_suite_assets_metadata
      Description: Runs etl_job_admin_suite_assets_metadata every 3 hours.
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: 'cron(0 */3 * * ? *)'
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref GlueJobAssetsMetadata

  TriggerFolderAssets:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: trigger_admin_suite_folder_assets
      Description: Runs etl_job_admin_suite_folder_assets every 3 hours.
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: 'cron(0 */3 * * ? *)'
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref GlueJobFolderAssets

  TriggerQMetadata:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: trigger_admin_suite_q_metadata
      Description: Runs etl_job_admin_suite_q_metadata every 3 hours.
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: 'cron(0 */3 * * ? *)'
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref GlueJobQMetadata

  TriggerQAccess:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: trigger_admin_suite_q_access
      Description: Runs etl_job_admin_suite_q_access every 3 hours.
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: 'cron(0 */3 * * ? *)'
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref GlueJobQAccess

  TriggerDsProperties:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: trigger_admin_suite_ds_properties
      Description: Runs etl_job_admin_suite_ds_properties every 3 hours.
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: 'cron(0 */3 * * ? *)'
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref GlueJobDsProperties

  TriggerDatasourceProperties:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: trigger_admin_suite_datasource_properties
      Description: Runs etl_job_admin_suite_datasource_properties every 3 hours.
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: 'cron(0 */3 * * ? *)'
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref GlueJobDatasourceProperties

  ############################################################################
  # Firehose direct-put delivery streams writing into the output bucket
  ############################################################################

  DeliveryStreamIngestion:
    Type: AWS::KinesisFirehose::DeliveryStream
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      DeliveryStreamName: admin-suite-quicksight-ingestion
      DeliveryStreamType: DirectPut
      ExtendedS3DestinationConfiguration:
        RoleARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
        BucketARN: !GetAtt OutputBucket.Arn
        Prefix: 'quicksight/ingestion/'
        ErrorOutputPrefix: 'errors/quicksight/ingestion/'
        CompressionFormat: GZIP
        BufferingHints:
          IntervalInSeconds: 300
          SizeInMBs: 5
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  DeliveryStreamVisual:
    Type: AWS::KinesisFirehose::DeliveryStream
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      DeliveryStreamName: admin-suite-quicksight-visual
      DeliveryStreamType: DirectPut
      ExtendedS3DestinationConfiguration:
        RoleARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
        BucketARN: !GetAtt OutputBucket.Arn
        Prefix: 'quicksight/visual/'
        ErrorOutputPrefix: 'errors/quicksight/visual/'
        CompressionFormat: GZIP
        BufferingHints:
          IntervalInSeconds: 300
          SizeInMBs: 5
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  DeliveryStreamSpice:
    Type: AWS::KinesisFirehose::DeliveryStream
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      DeliveryStreamName: admin-suite-quicksight-spice
      DeliveryStreamType: DirectPut
      ExtendedS3DestinationConfiguration:
        RoleARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
        BucketARN: !GetAtt OutputBucket.Arn
        Prefix: 'quicksight/spice/'
        ErrorOutputPrefix: 'errors/quicksight/spice/'
        CompressionFormat: GZIP
        BufferingHints:
          IntervalInSeconds: 300
          SizeInMBs: 5
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  DeliveryStreamQuickIndex:
    Type: AWS::KinesisFirehose::DeliveryStream
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      DeliveryStreamName: admin-suite-quicksight-quickindex
      DeliveryStreamType: DirectPut
      ExtendedS3DestinationConfiguration:
        RoleARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
        BucketARN: !GetAtt OutputBucket.Arn
        Prefix: 'quicksight/quickindex/'
        ErrorOutputPrefix: 'errors/quicksight/quickindex/'
        CompressionFormat: GZIP
        BufferingHints:
          IntervalInSeconds: 300
          SizeInMBs: 5
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  DeliveryStreamAction:
    Type: AWS::KinesisFirehose::DeliveryStream
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      DeliveryStreamName: admin-suite-quicksight-action
      DeliveryStreamType: DirectPut
      ExtendedS3DestinationConfiguration:
        RoleARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
        BucketARN: !GetAtt OutputBucket.Arn
        Prefix: 'quicksight/action/'
        ErrorOutputPrefix: 'errors/quicksight/action/'
        CompressionFormat: GZIP
        BufferingHints:
          IntervalInSeconds: 300
          SizeInMBs: 5
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  ############################################################################
  # CloudWatch metric streams (JSON output) feeding the Firehose streams
  ############################################################################

  MetricStreamIngestion:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::MetricStream
    Properties:
      Name: admin-suite-ingestion-metrics
      OutputFormat: json
      RoleArn: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      FirehoseArn: !GetAtt DeliveryStreamIngestion.Arn
      IncludeFilters:
        - Namespace: AWS/QuickSight
          MetricNames:

      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  MetricStreamVisual:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::MetricStream
    Properties:

      IncludeFilters:
        - Namespace: AWS/QuickSight

      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  MetricStreamSpice:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::MetricStream
    Properties:
      Name: admin-suite-spice-metrics
      OutputFormat: json
      RoleArn: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      FirehoseArn: !GetAtt DeliveryStreamSpice.Arn

        - Namespace: AWS/QuickSight

      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  MetricStreamQuickIndex:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::MetricStream
    Properties:
      Name: admin-suite-quickindex-metrics

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Cluster API Provider AWS (CAPA) IAM bootstrap for an Amazon EKS cluster: CAPA
  control-plane, nodes and controllers roles, the EKS control plane role,
  matching instance profiles, the customer managed policies for the legacy
  in-tree AWS cloud provider, node registration and image pulls, Cluster API
  infrastructure management and EKS lifecycle management, plus a standalone
  read-only EKS console policy that is intentionally left unattached. The
  controllers role is created with an EC2 service trust relationship only;
  enabling IRSA for it is a documented post-deploy step (see Outputs).

Resources:

  ControlPlaneRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: control-plane.cluster-api-provider-aws.sigs.k8s.io
      Description: CAPA control plane role assumed by EC2 instances running the legacy in-tree AWS cloud provider.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Tags:
        - Key: sigs.k8s.io/cluster-api-provider-aws/role
          Value: common

  NodesRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: nodes.cluster-api-provider-aws.sigs.k8s.io
      Description: CAPA role assumed by EC2 instances that act as cluster nodes.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Tags:
        - Key: sigs.k8s.io/cluster-api-provider-aws/role
          Value: common

  ControllersRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: controllers.cluster-api-provider-aws.sigs.k8s.io
      Description: CAPA controllers role assumable by EC2; add an EKS web identity Federated trust statement post-cluster-creation to enable IRSA for EKS pods.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Tags:
        - Key: sigs.k8s.io/cluster-api-provider-aws/role
          Value: common

  EKSControlPlaneRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-control-plane.cluster-api-provider-aws.sigs.k8s.io
      Description: IAM role assumed by the Amazon EKS control plane service.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSClusterPolicy'
      Tags:
        - Key: sigs.k8s.io/cluster-api-provider-aws/role
          Value: common

  ControlPlaneInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: control-plane.cluster-api-provider-aws.sigs.k8s.io
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControlPlaneRole

  ControllersInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: controllers.cluster-api-provider-aws.sigs.k8s.io
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControllersRole

  NodesInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: nodes.cluster-api-provider-aws.sigs.k8s.io
      Roles:
        - !Ref NodesRole

  ControlPlaneLegacyCloudProviderPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: control-plane-legacy-cloud-provider
      Description: Permissions required by the CAPA control plane role to run the legacy in-tree AWS cloud provider (EC2, Auto Scaling, ELB/ELBv2 and KMS).
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControlPlaneRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EC2LegacyCloudProvider
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:DescribeAccountAttributes
              - ec2:DescribeAvailabilityZones
              - ec2:DescribeImages
              - ec2:DescribeInstanceAttribute
              - ec2:DescribeInstanceTopology
              - ec2:DescribeInstanceTypes
              - ec2:DescribeInstances
              - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
              - ec2:DescribeRegions
              - ec2:DescribeRouteTables
              - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
              - ec2:DescribeSubnets
              - ec2:DescribeVolumes
              - ec2:DescribeVolumesModifications
              - ec2:DescribeVpcs
              - ec2:ModifyInstanceAttribute
              - ec2:CreateTags
              - ec2:DeleteTags
              - ec2:CreateVolume
              - ec2:DeleteVolume
              - ec2:ModifyVolume
              - ec2:AttachVolume
              - ec2:DetachVolume
              - ec2:CreateSecurityGroup
              - ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup
              - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress
              - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupEgress
              - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
              - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupEgress
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AutoScalingLegacyCloudProvider
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - autoscaling:DescribeAutoScalingGroups
              - autoscaling:DescribeAutoScalingInstances
              - autoscaling:DescribeLaunchConfigurations
              - autoscaling:DescribeScalingActivities
              - autoscaling:DescribeTags
              - autoscaling:SetDesiredCapacity
              - autoscaling:TerminateInstanceInAutoScalingGroup
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: LoadBalancerLegacyCloudProvider
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - elasticloadbalancing:AddListenerCertificates
              - elasticloadbalancing:AddTags
              - elasticloadbalancing:ApplySecurityGroupsToLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:AttachLoadBalancerToSubnets
              - elasticloadbalancing:ConfigureHealthCheck
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateListener
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateLoadBalancerListeners
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateLoadBalancerPolicy
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateRule
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateTargetGroup
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteListener
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteLoadBalancerListeners
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteLoadBalancerPolicy
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteRule
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteTargetGroup
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeregisterInstancesFromLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeregisterTargets
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeAccountLimits
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeInstanceHealth
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeListenerCertificates
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeListeners
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancerAttributes
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancerPolicies
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancerPolicyTypes
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancers
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeRules
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeSSLPolicies
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTags
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetGroupAttributes
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetGroups
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetHealth
              - elasticloadbalancing:DetachLoadBalancerFromSubnets
              - elasticloadbalancing:DisableAvailabilityZonesForLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:EnableAvailabilityZonesForLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyListener
              - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyLoadBalancerAttributes
              - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyRule
              - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyTargetGroup
              - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyTargetGroupAttributes
              - elasticloadbalancing:RegisterInstancesWithLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:RegisterTargets
              - elasticloadbalancing:RemoveListenerCertificates
              - elasticloadbalancing:RemoveTags
              - elasticloadbalancing:SetIpAddressType
              - elasticloadbalancing:SetLoadBalancerListenerSSLCertificate
              - elasticloadbalancing:SetLoadBalancerPoliciesForBackendServer
              - elasticloadbalancing:SetLoadBalancerPoliciesOfListener
              - elasticloadbalancing:SetRulePriorities
              - elasticloadbalancing:SetSecurityGroups
              - elasticloadbalancing:SetSubnets
              - elasticloadbalancing:SetWebAcl
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: KMSLegacyCloudProvider
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - kms:CreateGrant
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext
              - kms:ListGrants
            Resource: '*'

  NodeRegistrationAndImagePullPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: cluster-node-registration-and-image-pull
      Description: EC2, ECR, Secrets Manager and SSM permissions required for cluster nodes to register and pull container images, attached to the control-plane and nodes roles.
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControlPlaneRole
        - !Ref NodesRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EC2NodeAndClusterDiscovery
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:DescribeAvailabilityZones
              - ec2:DescribeAccountAttributes
              - ec2:DescribeImages
              - ec2:DescribeInstanceAttribute
              - ec2:DescribeInstanceTopology
              - ec2:DescribeInstanceTypes
              - ec2:DescribeInstances
              - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
              - ec2:DescribeRegions
              - ec2:DescribeRouteTables
              - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
              - ec2:DescribeSubnets
              - ec2:DescribeVolumes
              - ec2:DescribeVpcs
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: ECRImagePull
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
              - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
              - ecr:BatchGetImage
              - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: ECRPublicImagePull
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ecr-public:GetAuthorizationToken
              - ecr-public:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
              - ecr-public:GetRepositoryPolicy
              - ecr-public:DescribeRepositories
              - ecr-public:DescribeRegistries
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: ServiceBearerTokenForECRPublic
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sts:GetServiceBearerToken
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: SecretsManagerRead
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
              - secretsmanager:DescribeSecret
              - secretsmanager:ListSecrets
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: SSMParameterRead
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ssm:DescribeParameters
              - ssm:GetParameter
              - ssm:GetParameterHistory
              - ssm:GetParameters
              - ssm:GetParametersByPath

Description: >-
  Provisions the AWS Glue Shapefile-to-GeoJSON ETL job and its supporting Glue
  service role, along with the S3 buckets (raw GIS input, Glue scripts/logs/temp,
  and the knowledge base) that the job reads from and writes to, plus a customer
  managed KMS key used to encrypt the buckets.

Parameters:
  GlueJobName:
    Type: String
    Default: map-appraiser-shapefile-to-geojson-etl
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 255
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      Must contain only letters, numbers, hyphens, and underscores (1-255 characters).
    Description: Name of the AWS Glue ETL job that converts Shapefiles to individual GeoJSON files.

  GlueScriptLocation:
    Type: String
    Default: s3://map-appraiser-glue-scripts/shapefile_to_geojson_etl.py
    AllowedPattern: '^s3://.+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid S3 URI beginning with s3://.
    Description: S3 URI of the Glue ETL Python script.

  GlueServiceRoleName:
    Type: String
    Default: MapAppraiserShapefileGlueServiceRole
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 64
    AllowedPattern: '^[\w+=,.@-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      Must contain only alphanumeric characters and +=,.@- (1-64 characters).
    Description: Name of the IAM service role assumed by the AWS Glue ETL job.

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Customer managed KMS key used for SSE-KMS encryption of the data buckets.
  # Created here because the greenfield account has no pre-existing CMK.
  #
  # NOTE: the Glue role is granted use of this key via a Principal built from
  # the GlueServiceRoleName parameter (Fn::Sub) rather than !GetAtt on the role
  # resource. Using the parameter avoids a DataEncryptionKey -> GlueServiceRole
  # resource dependency, which would otherwise form a dependency cycle with
  # GlueServiceRole -> RawGisBucket -> DataEncryptionKey.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  DataEncryptionKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: CMK used to encrypt the Map Appraiser raw GIS, Glue scripts, and knowledge base buckets.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowAccountRootFullControl
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowGlueServiceRoleUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/${GlueServiceRoleName}'
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - 'kms:ReEncrypt*'
            Resource: '*'

  DataEncryptionKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/map-appraiser-glue-data
      TargetKeyId: !Ref DataEncryptionKey

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # S3 buckets (created here because none pre-exist in the target account)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  RawGisBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: map-appraiser-data-raw-gis
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt DataEncryptionKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true

  GlueScriptsBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: map-appraiser-glue-scripts
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt DataEncryptionKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true

  KnowledgeBaseBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: map-appraiser-data-knowledge-base
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt DataEncryptionKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Bucket policies: enforce TLS-only access (no ACLs are used anywhere)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  RawGisBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref RawGisBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt RawGisBucket.Arn
              - !Sub
                - '${BucketArn}/*'
                - BucketArn: !GetAtt RawGisBucket.Arn
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'

  GlueScriptsBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref GlueScriptsBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt GlueScriptsBucket.Arn
              - !Sub
                - '${BucketArn}/*'
                - BucketArn: !GetAtt GlueScriptsBucket.Arn
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'

  KnowledgeBaseBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref KnowledgeBaseBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt KnowledgeBaseBucket.Arn
              - !Sub
                - '${BucketArn}/*'
                - BucketArn: !GetAtt KnowledgeBaseBucket.Arn
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM service role for the Glue ETL job
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  GlueServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Ref GlueServiceRoleName
      Description: Service role assumed by the Map Appraiser Shapefile-to-GeoJSON Glue ETL job.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowGlueServiceAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: glue.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSGlueServiceRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CloudWatchLogsAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: GlueCloudWatchLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:GetLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws-glue/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws-glue/*:*'

        # Note: no KMS statements are needed here. The Glue role is granted
        # kms:Decrypt / kms:GenerateDataKey / kms:DescribeKey / kms:ReEncrypt*
        # directly in the DataEncryptionKey key policy above, and SSE-KMS
        # encryption is transparent to the s3:* actions scoped below.
        - PolicyName: S3ReadScriptsAndRawGIS
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ReadRawGisAndScriptObjects
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:GetObjectVersion
                Resource:
                  - !Sub
                    - '${BucketArn}/*'
                    - BucketArn: !GetAtt RawGisBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub
                    - '${BucketArn}/*'
                    - BucketArn: !GetAtt GlueScriptsBucket.Arn
              - Sid: ListRawGisAndScriptBuckets
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt RawGisBucket.Arn
                  - !GetAtt GlueScriptsBucket.Arn

        - PolicyName: S3ReadWriteKnowledgeBase
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ReadWriteKnowledgeBaseObjects
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:AbortMultipartUpload
                Resource:
                  - !Sub
                    - '${BucketArn}/*'
                    - BucketArn: !GetAtt KnowledgeBaseBucket.Arn
              - Sid: ListKnowledgeBaseBucket
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt KnowledgeBaseBucket.Arn

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # AWS Glue 4.0 Spark ETL job
  # The Role property references the role above, which creates the dependency
  # implicitly, so no DependsOn is required.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  GlueShapefileToGeoJsonJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref GlueJobName
      Description: Converts Shapefiles from the raw GIS bucket into individual GeoJSON files.
      Role: !GetAtt GlueServiceRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '4.0'
      WorkerType: G.2X
      NumberOfWorkers: 5
      MaxRetries: 0
      Timeout: 2880
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        ScriptLocation: !Ref GlueScriptLocation
        PythonVersion: '3'
      DefaultArguments:
        '--enable-metrics': 'true'
        '--enable-continuous-cloudwatch-log': 'true'
        '--enable-continuous-log-filter': 'true'
        '--enable-spark-ui': 'true'
        '--spark-event-logs-path': 's3://map-appraiser-glue-scripts/spark-logs/'
        '--job-bookmark-option': job-bookmark-enable
        '--TempDir': 's3://map-appraiser-glue-scripts/temp/'
        '--additional-python-modules': 'geopandas0.14.1,shapely2.0.2,pyproj3.6.1,fiona1.9.5'

Outputs:
  GlueJobName:
    Description: Name of the deployed AWS Glue Shapefile-to-GeoJSON ETL job.
    Value: !Ref GlueShapefileToGeoJsonJob

  GlueServiceRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM service role used by the Glue ETL job.
    Value: !GetAtt GlueServiceRole.Arn

  GlueScriptUploadCommand:
    Description: Command to upload the Glue ETL Python script to the scripts bucket.
    Value: !Sub >-
      aws s3 cp ./shapefile_to_geojson_etl.py s3://${GlueScriptsBucket}/shapefile_to_geojson_etl.py

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Enforces account-level S3 Block Public Access on a daily schedule using
  AWS Systems Manager Automation and Amazon EventBridge.

Parameters:
  ResourceNamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: s3bpa
    MinLength: 3
    MaxLength: 20
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9-]*$'
    Description: >-
      Prefix used for naming the IAM roles, SSM Automation document,
      and EventBridge rule created by this stack.

Resources:
  SSMBlockPublicAccessAutomationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}-SSMBlockPublicAccessAutomationRole'
      Description: Role assumed by the SSM Automation document to call S3 Control account-level APIs.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: S3AccountPublicAccessBlockPermissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutAccountPublicAccessBlock
                  - s3:GetAccountPublicAccessBlock
                Resource: '*'

  EventBridgeInvokeSSMRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}-EventBridgeInvokeSSMRole'
      Description: Role assumed by the EventBridge rule to start the SSM Automation execution.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartSSMAutomationAndPassRole
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: ssm:StartAutomationExecution
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:automation-definition/${SSMAutomationDocument}'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:PassRole
                Resource: !GetAtt SSMBlockPublicAccessAutomationRole.Arn

  SSMAutomationDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}-EnforceAccountS3BlockPublicAccess'
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        Fn::Sub:
          - |
            schemaVersion: '0.3'
            description: Enforce account-level S3 Block Public Access.
            assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
            parameters:
              AutomationAssumeRole:
                type: String
                default: '${AutomationRoleArn}'
                description: ARN of the IAM role that Automation assumes to call S3 Control APIs.
            mainSteps:
              - name: PutAccountPublicAccessBlock
                action: aws:executeAwsApi
                inputs:
                  Service: s3control
                  Api: PutPublicAccessBlock
                  AccountId: '${AWS::AccountId}'
                  PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
                    BlockPublicAcls: true
                    BlockPublicPolicy: true
                    IgnorePublicAcls: true
                    RestrictPublicBuckets: true
          - AutomationRoleArn: !GetAtt SSMBlockPublicAccessAutomationRole.Arn

  DailyS3BlockPublicAccessRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}-daily-s3-block-public-access'
      Description: Daily schedule that starts the SSM Automation document to enforce account-level S3 Block Public Access.
      State: ENABLED
      ScheduleExpression: rate(1 day)
      Targets:
        - Id: S3BlockPublicAccessAutomationTarget
          Arn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:automation-definition/${SSMAutomationDocument}'
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeInvokeSSMRole.Arn
          Input:
            Fn::Sub:
              - '{"AutomationAssumeRole":["${AutomationRoleArn}"]}'
              - AutomationRoleArn: !GetAtt SSMBlockPublicAccessAutomationRole.Arn

Outputs:
  AutomationDocumentName:
    Description: Name of the SSM Automation document that enforces account-level S3 Block Public Access.
    Value: !Ref SSMAutomationDocument
  AutomationDocumentArn:
    Description: ARN of the SSM Automation document.
    Value: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:automation-definition/${SSMAutomationDocument}'
  SSMAutomationRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role assumed by the SSM Automation document.
    Value: !GetAtt SSMBlockPublicAccessAutomationRole.Arn
  EventBridgeRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role assumed by the EventBridge rule to start the SSM Automation execution.
    Value: !GetAtt EventBridgeInvokeSSMRole.Arn

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Test environment used to validate Service Catalog preventive controls. It
  creates a private VPC (172.16.0.0/16) with two subnets in the first two
  availability zones, a shared security group, a customer managed KMS key with a
  stable alias, the dms-vpc-role plus a DMS replication subnet group, an
  ElastiCache subnet group and cache security group, a SageMaker execution role,
  and one Service Catalog launch role per product family under test.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: sc-controls-test
    Description: Environment/Name tag value applied to the resources in this test environment.
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 64
    AllowedPattern: '[a-zA-Z0-9\-_]+'

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Network: VPC, two private subnets and the shared test security group
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  TestVpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 172.16.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: ServiceCatalogControlsValidation

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref TestVpc
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: 172.16.1.0/24
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-subnet-1'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: Private
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref TestVpc
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: 172.16.2.0/24
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-subnet-2'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: Private
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  # No 0.0.0.0/0 ingress is defined on this group. The only ingress rule is the
  # self-referential intra-group rule below. Any additional ingress rule must be
  # added deliberately by whoever runs the tests - do not open the group to the
  # world by default.
  TestSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Shared security group for Service Catalog preventive controls test resources
      VpcId: !Ref TestVpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-test-sg'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  # The self-referential intra-group rule is declared as its own resource so the
  # security group does not depend on itself.
  TestSecurityGroupSelfIngress:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref TestSecurityGroup
      SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref TestSecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: '-1'
      Description: Allow all traffic between members of the test security group only

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Customer managed KMS key and alias
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  TestKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key for the Service Catalog preventive controls test environment
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowAccountRootKeyAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowServiceCatalogLaunchRolesToUseKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS:
                - !GetAtt LaunchRoleAlb.Arn
                - !GetAtt LaunchRoleAutoScaling.Arn
                - !GetAtt LaunchRoleDms.Arn
                - !GetAtt LaunchRoleDynamoDb.Arn
                - !GetAtt LaunchRoleEbs.Arn
                - !GetAtt LaunchRoleEfs.Arn
                - !GetAtt LaunchRoleElastiCache.Arn
                - !GetAtt LaunchRoleElasticsearch.Arn
                - !GetAtt LaunchRoleFsx.Arn
                - !GetAtt LaunchRoleKinesis.Arn
                - !GetAtt LaunchRoleSns.Arn
                - !GetAtt LaunchRoleSqs.Arn
                - !GetAtt LaunchRoleSageMaker.Arn
                - !GetAtt LaunchRoleS3.Arn
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncryptFrom
              - kms:ReEncryptTo
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'

  TestKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-sc-controls-test-key'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref TestKmsKey

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # DMS: service role required before a replication subnet group can be created
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  DmsVpcRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: dms-vpc-role
      Description: Service role that DMS requires before a replication subnet group can be created
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowDmsToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: dms.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonDMSVPCManagementRole

  DmsReplicationSubnetGroup:
    Type: AWS::DMS::ReplicationSubnetGroup
    # The dms-vpc-role has to exist before DMS creates the subnet group. That
    # ordering cannot be expressed through a Ref, so it is declared explicitly.
    DependsOn: DmsVpcRole
    Properties:
      ReplicationSubnetGroupDescription: Subnet group used by DMS replication instances in the Service Catalog controls test VPC
      ReplicationSubnetGroupIdentifier: sc-controls-dms-subnet-group
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-dms-subnet-group'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # ElastiCache subnet group and cache security group
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  ElastiCacheSubnetGroup:
    Type: AWS::ElastiCache::SubnetGroup
    # NOTE: AWS::ElastiCache::SubnetGroup has no VPC property; the VPC is
    # implied by the subnets listed below.
    Properties:
      CacheSubnetGroupName: sc-controls-cache-subnet-group
      Description: Subnet group used by ElastiCache clusters in the Service Catalog controls test VPC
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-cache-subnet-group'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  ElastiCacheSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::ElastiCache::SecurityGroup
    # NOTE: only the documented property of AWS::ElastiCache::SecurityGroup is
    # set here; no other property is invented. This group must be referenced by
    # name (Ref) from any cache cluster that uses it.
    Properties:
      Description: Cache security group for ElastiCache clusters in the Service Catalog controls test VPC

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # S3 data bucket used by the SageMaker role and by S3 products under test
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  TestDataBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-sc-controls-test-${AWS::AccountId}'
      # Access is controlled with the separate AWS::S3::BucketPolicy below plus
      # the public access block; the deprecated AccessControl property is not
      # used and AWS::S3::BucketPublicAccessBlock is not used because the block
      # configuration belongs on the bucket itself.
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt TestKmsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-data-bucket'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  TestDataBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref TestDataBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt TestDataBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${TestDataBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                'aws:SecureTransport': 'false'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # SageMaker execution role
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  SageMakerExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: sc-controls-sagemaker-execution-role
      Description: Execution role assumed by SageMaker resources created in the Service Catalog controls test environment
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowSageMakerToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sagemaker.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSageMakerFullAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: sc-controls-sagemaker-bucket-and-key-access
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: TestDataBucketAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt TestDataBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub '${TestDataBucket.Arn}/*'
              - Sid: TestKmsKeyAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !GetAtt TestKmsKey.Arn

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Service Catalog launch roles - one per product family under test.
  # Each trust policy allows the CloudFormation/Service Catalog launch
  # mechanism and the account root to assume the role at product provisioning
  # time. No launch role references the KMS key ARN, which keeps the key policy
  # (which references the roles) free of a circular dependency.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  LaunchRoleAlb:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: sc-controls-launch-role-alb
      Description: Service Catalog launch role for application load balancer, listener and target group products
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowServiceCatalogLaunch
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudformation.amazonaws.com
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/ElasticLoadBalancingFullAccess

  LaunchRoleAutoScaling:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: sc-controls-launch-role-autoscaling
      Description: Service Catalog launch role for Auto Scaling group products
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowServiceCatalogLaunch
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudformation.amazonaws.com
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AutoScalingFullAccess

  LaunchRoleDms:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: sc-controls-launch-role-dms
      Description: Service Catalog launch role for DMS endpoint and replication instance products
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowServiceCatalogLaunch
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudformation.amazonaws.com
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      # No AWS managed policy is used for this product family; the permissions
      # are scoped to the DMS endpoint/instance actions the product needs plus
      # the read-only EC2 actions DMS performs while validating the network.
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: sc-controls-dms-endpoint-and-instance-access
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: DmsEndpointAndInstanceManagement
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dms:CreateEndpoint
                  - dms:DeleteEndpoint
                  - dms:DescribeEndpoints
                  - dms:ModifyEndpoint
                  - dms:CreateReplicationInstance
                  - dms:DeleteReplicationInstance
                  - dms:DescribeReplicationInstances
                  - dms:ModifyReplicationInstance
                  - dms:CreateReplicationSubnetGroup
                  - dms:DeleteReplicationSubnetGroup
                  - dms:DescribeReplicationSubnetGroups
                  - dms:CreateReplicationTask
                  - dms:DeleteReplicationTask
                  - dms:DescribeReplicationTasks
                  - dms:StartReplicationTask
                  - dms:StopReplicationTask
                  - dms:TestConnection
                  - dms:AddTagsToResource
                  - dms:ListTagsForResource
                  - dms:RemoveTagsFromResource
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: Ec2ReadAccessRequiredByDms
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
                  - ec2:DescribeAvailabilityZones
                  - ec2:DescribeAccountAttributes
                Resource: '*'

  LaunchRoleDynamoDb:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: sc-controls-launch-role-dynamodb
      Description: Service Catalog launch role for DynamoDB table products
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowServiceCatalogLaunch
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudformation.amazonaws.com
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonDynamoDBFullAccess

  LaunchRoleEbs:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: sc-controls-launch-role-ebs
      Description: Service Catalog launch role for EBS volume and snapshot products
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowServiceCatalogLaunch
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudformation.amazonaws.com
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      # No AWS managed policy is used for this product family. Several EC2
      # describe actions do not support resource-level permissions, so the
      # resource element is '*' while the action list stays scoped to the EBS
      # volume and snapshot operations the product performs.
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: sc-controls-ebs-volume-access
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: EbsVolumeAndSnapshotManagement
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:CreateVolume
                  - ec2:DeleteVolume
                  - ec2:AttachVolume
                  - ec2:DetachVolume
                  - ec2:ModifyVolume
                  - ec2:CreateSnapshot
                  - ec2:DeleteSnapshot
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                  - ec2:DeleteTags
                  - ec2:DescribeVolumes
                  - ec2:DescribeVolumesModifications
                  - ec2:DescribeSnapshots
                  - ec2:DescribeInstances
                  - ec2:DescribeAvailabilityZones
                Resource: '*'

  LaunchRoleEfs:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: sc-controls-launch-role-efs
      Description: Service Catalog launch role for EFS file system and mount target products
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowServiceCatalogLaunch
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudformation.amazonaws.com
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      # No AWS managed policy is used for this product family; the permissions
      # are scoped to the EFS, EC2 network lookup and KMS grant operations an
      # encrypted file system needs. The KMS resource is '*' on purpose so this
      # launch role never references the KMS key ARN (avoids a circular
      # dependency back into the key policy).
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: sc-controls-efs-access
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: EfsFileSystemManagement
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - elasticfilesystem:CreateFileSystem
                  - elasticfilesystem:DeleteFileSystem
                  - elasticfilesystem:DescribeFileSystems
                  - elasticfilesystem:UpdateFileSystem
                  - elasticfilesystem:CreateMountTarget
                  - elasticfilesystem:DeleteMountTarget
                  - elasticfilesystem:DescribeMountTargets
                  - elasticfilesystem:CreateAccessPoint
                  - elasticfilesystem:DeleteAccessPoint
                  - elasticfilesystem:DescribeAccessPoints
                  - elasticfilesystem:PutFileSystemPolicy
                  - elasticfilesystem:DescribeFileSystemPolicy
                  - elasticfilesystem:DeleteFileSystemPolicy
                  - elasticfilesystem:TagResource
                  - elasticfilesystem:UntagResource
                  - elasticfilesystem:ListTagsForResource
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: Ec2ReadAccessRequiredByEfs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
                  - ec2:DescribeAvailabilityZones
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: KmsAccessRequiredByEfs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:CreateGrant
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                Resource: '*'

  LaunchRoleElastiCache:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: sc-controls-launch-role-elasticache
      Description: Service Catalog launch role for ElastiCache cluster and subnet group products
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:

            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonElastiCacheFullAccess

  LaunchRoleElasticsearch:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: sc-controls-launch-role-elasticsearch

      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:

            Effect: Allow
            Principal:

              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
