AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Serverless AI campaign orchestration platform
Parameters:
  ApplicationName:
    Type: String
    Default: CampaignOrchestrator
    MinLength: 3
    MaxLength: 40
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]+$'
    Description: Resource name prefix
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 12
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9]+$'
    Description: Environment name
  BedrockModelId:
    Type: String
    Default: amazon.nova-lite-v1:0
    Description: Bedrock model id
  NotificationEmailAddress:
    Type: String
    Default: noreply@example.com
    Description: Alert email address
  MessagingPhoneNumberIdentifier:
    Type: String
    Default: '+10000000000'
    Description: SMS origination number
  EnableSemanticSearch:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
    Description: Enable vector search
Conditions:
  EnableSemanticSearch: !Equals [!Ref EnableSemanticSearch, 'true']
Resources:
  DataKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Campaign data key
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: Root
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Sns
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sns.amazonaws.com
            Action: ['kms:Decrypt', 'kms:GenerateDataKey*']
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Cw
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action: ['kms:Decrypt', 'kms:GenerateDataKey*']
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Aoss
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: aoss.amazonaws.com
            Action: ['kms:Decrypt', 'kms:GenerateDataKey', 'kms:DescribeKey', 'kms:CreateGrant']
            Resource: '*'
  DataKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${ApplicationName}-campaign-data'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref DataKey
  ProfilesTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-customer-profiles'
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - {AttributeName: customerId, AttributeType: S}
      KeySchema:
        - {AttributeName: customerId, KeyType: HASH}
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KMSMasterKeyId: !GetAtt DataKey.Arn
  RateLimitsTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-channel-rate-limits'
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - {AttributeName: channel, AttributeType: S}
        - {AttributeName: timeWindow, AttributeType: S}
      KeySchema:
        - {AttributeName: channel, KeyType: HASH}
        - {AttributeName: timeWindow, KeyType: RANGE}
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KMSMasterKeyId: !GetAtt DataKey.Arn
  TrackingTable:

          import os

           p=e.get('parameters') or {};i=e.get('instruction') or e.get('body') or ''
           if isinstance(i,dict): i=i.get('instruction','')
           i=str(i).strip()
           s={'campaignName':p.get('campaignName','campaign'),'objective':i,'instruction':i,'channels':p.get('channels',['email','sms','push']),'segmentCriteria':p.get('segmentCriteria',{}),'tone':p.get('tone','professional'),'language':p.get('language','en'),'assetsBucket':os.environ.get('BUCKET')}

  SegmentFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn: SegmentLog
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-${EnvironmentName}-segment'
      Description: Segments the target customers
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt PipelineRole.Arn
      MemorySize: 1024
      Timeout: 120
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE: !Ref ProfilesTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import os,boto3
          from boto3.dynamodb.conditions import Attr
          t=boto3.resource('dynamodb').Table(os.environ['TABLE'])
          def lambda_handler(e,c):
           s=e.get('spec') or {};q=s.get('segmentCriteria') or {};k={};a=[]
           if q.get('requiredConsent') is not None: k['FilterExpression']=Attr('consent').eq(bool(q['requiredConsent']))
           while True:
            r=t.scan(**k);a+=r.get('Items',[])
            lk=r.get('LastEvaluatedKey')
            if not lk or len(a)>=5000: break
            k['ExclusiveStartKey']=lk
           return {'campaignId':e.get('campaignId'),'spec':s,'audience':a[:5000],'audienceSize':len(a[:5000])}
  PredictFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn: PredictLog
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-${EnvironmentName}-predict'
      Description: Predicts the best channel per customer
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt PipelineRole.Arn
      MemorySize: 1024
      Timeout: 120
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE: !Ref RateLimitsTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import datetime,os,boto3
          t=boto3.resource('dynamodb').Table(os.environ['TABLE'])
          def lambda_handler(e,c):
           s=e.get('spec') or {};a=e.get('audience') or []
           ch=sorted(s.get('channels') or ['email','push','sms'])
           w=datetime.datetime.utcnow().strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H')
           u={x:0 for x in ch};plan=[]
           for x in a:
            pick=ch[0]
            for y in ch:
             it=t.get_item(Key={'channel':y,'timeWindow':w}).get('Item') or {}
             if int(it.get('usedInWindow',0))+u[y]<int(it.get('maxPerWindow',1000)): pick=y;break
            u[pick]+=1;plan.append({'customerId':x.get('customerId'),'channel':pick})
           return {'campaignId':e.get('campaignId'),'spec':s,'audienceSize':len(a),'deliveryPlan':plan}
  SafetyFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn: SafetyLog
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-${EnvironmentName}-safety'
      Description: Reviews generated content for safety
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt GenerativeRole.Arn
      MemorySize: 1024
      Timeout: 120
      Environment:
        Variables:
          MODEL: !Ref BedrockModelId
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json,os,boto3
          b=boto3.client('bedrock-runtime');M=os.environ['MODEL']
          def lambda_handler(e,c):
           s=e.get('spec') or {}
           p='Review this marketing instruction for unsafe, misleading or discriminatory content. Reply only with JSON {"approved":true|false,"reason":""}.\nInstruction: '+str(s.get('instruction',''))
           r=b.invoke_model(modelId=M,body=json.dumps({'messages':[{'role':'user','content':[{'text':p}]}],'inferenceConfig':{'maxTokens':512,'temperature':0}}),contentType='application/json',accept='application/json')
           x=json.loads(r['body'].read())['output']['message']['content'][0]['text']
           ok=True;why='approved'
           try:
            v=json.loads(x[x.index('{'):x.rindex('}')+1]);ok=bool(v.get('approved',True));why=str(v.get('reason',''))
           except Exception:
            ok='approved' in x.lower();why=x[:200]
           o=dict(e);o['safety']={'approved':ok,'reason':why}
           return o
  AdaptFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn: AdaptLog
    Properties:

          def lambda_handler(e,c):
           s=e.get('spec') or {};plan=e.get('deliveryPlan') or []

           for y in ch:

  DeliverFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn: DeliverLog
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-${EnvironmentName}-deliver'
      Description: Delivers campaign messages
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt MessagingRole.Arn
      MemorySize: 1024
      Timeout: 300
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE: !Ref TrackingTable
          TOPIC: !Ref MessagesTopic
          SENDER_EMAIL: !Ref NotificationEmailAddress
          SENDER_PHONE: !Ref MessagingPhoneNumberIdentifier
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import datetime,json,os,boto3
          sns=boto3.client('sns');d=boto3.resource('dynamodb').Table(os.environ['TABLE'])
          T=os.environ['TOPIC'];SE=os.environ['SENDER_EMAIL'];SP=os.environ['SENDER_PHONE']
          def lambda_handler(e,c):
           cid=e.get('campaignId','campaign');plan=e.get('deliveryPlan') or [];ct=e.get('content') or {};ids=[]
           for i,x in enumerate(plan):
            ch=x.get('channel','email');mid='%s-%06d'%(cid,i)
            body=ct.get(ch) or ct.get('email') or 'Campaign message'
            at={'channel':{'DataType':'String','StringValue':ch},'campaignId':{'DataType':'String','StringValue':cid},'messageId':{'DataType':'String','StringValue':mid}}
            if ch=='email': at['sender']={'DataType':'String','StringValue':SE}
            elif ch=='sms': at['originationNumber']={'DataType':'String','StringValue':SP}
            sns.publish(TopicArn=T,Message=json.dumps({'campaignId':cid,'messageId':mid,'customerId':x.get('customerId'),'channel':ch,'body':body}),MessageAttributes=at)
            d.put_item(Item={'campaignId':cid,'messageId':mid,'customerId':x.get('customerId'),'channel':ch,'status':'SENT','sentAt':datetime.datetime.utcnow().isoformat()})
            ids.append(mid)
           return {'campaignId':cid,'spec':e.get('spec'),'deliveredCount':len(ids),'deliveredMessageIds':ids}

    Properties:

      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt PipelineRole.Arn
      MemorySize: 512
      Timeout: 60
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE: !Ref TrackingTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json,os,boto3
          d=boto3.resource('dynamodb').Table(os.environ['TABLE'])
          def lambda_handler(e,c):
           n=0
           for r in e.get('Records') or []:
            try: p=json.loads((r.get('Sns') or {}).get('Message') or '{}')
            except Exception: continue
            cid=p.get('campaignId');mid=p.get('messageId')

            d.update_item(Key={'campaignId':cid,'messageId':mid},UpdateExpression='SET #s=:s,lastEventAt=:t',ExpressionAttributeNames={'#s':'status'},ExpressionAttributeValues={':s':p.get('status','UNKNOWN'),':t':p.get('timestamp','')})

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: SimpleTodoAPI - AppSync GraphQL API with JavaScript (APPSYNC_JS) resolvers backed by a single DynamoDB table.

Resources:

  ###########################################################################
  # DynamoDB table backing the API
  ###########################################################################
  TodoTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: id
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: owner
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: id
          KeyType: HASH
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - IndexName: owner-index
          KeySchema:
            - AttributeName: owner
              KeyType: HASH
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: ALL
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true

  ###########################################################################
  # IAM role AppSync assumes to read/write the Todo table
  ###########################################################################
  AppSyncDynamoDBRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AppSyncTodoTableAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt TodoTable.Arn
                  - !Sub '${TodoTable.Arn}/index/*'

  ###########################################################################
  # CloudWatch Logs group for AppSync field level logging
  ###########################################################################
  AppSyncLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/appsync/apis/SimpleTodoAPI
      RetentionInDays: 30

  ###########################################################################
  # IAM role AppSync assumes to write field level logs
  ###########################################################################
  AppSyncLoggingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AppSyncCloudWatchLogsAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt AppSyncLogGroup.Arn
                  - !Sub '${AppSyncLogGroup.Arn}:*'

  ###########################################################################
  # AppSync GraphQL API
  ###########################################################################
  GraphQLApi:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLApi
    Properties:
      Name: SimpleTodoAPI
      AuthenticationType: API_KEY
      AdditionalAuthenticationProviders:
        - AuthenticationType: API_KEY
      LogConfig:
        CloudWatchLogsRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncLoggingRole.Arn
        FieldLogLevel: ALL
        ExcludeVerboseContent: false

  ###########################################################################
  # GraphQL schema (inline SDL)
  ###########################################################################
  GraphQLSchema:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Definition: |
        schema {
          query: Query
          mutation: Mutation
        }

        type Todo {
          id: ID!
          owner: String!
          title: String!
          description: String
          completed: Boolean!
          createdAt: AWSDateTime!
          updatedAt: AWSDateTime!
        }

        type TodoConnection {
          items: [Todo]
          nextToken: String
        }

        input CreateTodoInput {
          id: ID
          owner: String!
          title: String!
          description: String
          completed: Boolean
        }

        input UpdateTodoInput {
          id: ID!
          owner: String
          title: String
          description: String
          completed: Boolean
        }

        type Query {
          getTodo(id: ID!): Todo
          listTodos(limit: Int, nextToken: String): TodoConnection
          todosByOwner(owner: String!, limit: Int, nextToken: String): TodoConnection
        }

        type Mutation {
          createTodo(input: CreateTodoInput!): Todo
          updateTodo(input: UpdateTodoInput!): Todo
          deleteTodo(id: ID!): Todo
        }

  ###########################################################################
  # API key generated by CloudFormation (expires 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z)
  ###########################################################################
  ApiKey:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::ApiKey
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Description: API key for SimpleTodoAPI
      Expires: 1767225600

  ###########################################################################
  # Single DynamoDB data source used by all resolvers
  ###########################################################################
  TodoDataSource:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: TodoDataSource
      Description: DynamoDB data source for the Todo table
      Type: AMAZON_DYNAMODB
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncDynamoDBRole.Arn
      DynamoDBConfig:
        TableName: !Ref TodoTable
        AwsRegion: !Ref AWS::Region
        UseCallerCredentials: false

  ###########################################################################
  # Mutation: createTodo
  ###########################################################################
  CreateTodoResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    DependsOn:
      - GraphQLSchema
      - TodoDataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Mutation
      FieldName: createTodo
      DataSourceName: TodoDataSource
      Kind: UNIT
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: '1.0.0'
      Code: |
        import { util } from '@aws-appsync/utils';

        export function request(ctx) {
          const input = ctx.args.input;
          const now = util.time.nowISO8601();
          const item = {
            id: input.id || util.autoId(),
            owner: input.owner,
            title: input.title,
            completed:
              input.completed === undefined || input.completed === null
                ? false
                : input.completed,
            createdAt: now,
            updatedAt: now,
          };
          if (input.description !== undefined && input.description !== null) {
            item.description = input.description;
          }
          return {
            operation: 'PutItem',
            key: util.dynamodb.toMapValues({ id: item.id }),
            attributeValues: util.dynamodb.toMapValues(item),
          };
        }

        export function response(ctx) {
          if (ctx.error) {
            util.error(ctx.error.message, ctx.error.type);
          }
          return ctx.result;
        }

  ###########################################################################
  # Mutation: updateTodo
  ###########################################################################
  UpdateTodoResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    DependsOn:
      - GraphQLSchema
      - TodoDataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Mutation
      FieldName: updateTodo
      DataSourceName: TodoDataSource
      Kind: UNIT
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: '1.0.0'
      Code: |
        import { util } from '@aws-appsync/utils';

        export function request(ctx) {
          const input = ctx.args.input;
          const now = util.time.nowISO8601();

          const expressionNames = { '#updatedAt': 'updatedAt' };
          const expressionValues = { ':updatedAt': now };
          const setExpressions = ['#updatedAt = :updatedAt'];

          const optionalFields = ['owner', 'title', 'description', 'completed'];
          let index = 0;
          for (const field of optionalFields) {
            const value = input[field];
            if (value === undefined || value === null) {
              continue;
            }
            index += 1;
            const nameKey = '#f' + index;
            const valueKey = ':f' + index;
            expressionNames[nameKey] = field;
            expressionValues[valueKey] = value;
            setExpressions.push(nameKey + ' = ' + valueKey);
          }

          return {
            operation: 'UpdateItem',
            key: util.dynamodb.toMapValues({ id: input.id }),
            update: {
              expression: 'SET ' + setExpressions.join(', '),
              expressionNames: expressionNames,
              expressionValues: util.dynamodb.toMapValues(expressionValues),
            },
            condition: {
              expression: 'attribute_exists(id)',
            },
          };
        }

        export function response(ctx) {
          if (ctx.error) {
            util.error(ctx.error.message, ctx.error.type);
          }
          return ctx.result;
        }

  ###########################################################################
  # Mutation: deleteTodo
  ###########################################################################
  DeleteTodoResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    DependsOn:
      - GraphQLSchema
      - TodoDataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Mutation
      FieldName: deleteTodo
      DataSourceName: TodoDataSource
      Kind: UNIT
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: '1.0.0'
      Code: |
        import { util } from '@aws-appsync/utils';

        export function request(ctx) {
          return {
            operation: 'DeleteItem',
            key: util.dynamodb.toMapValues({ id: ctx.args.id }),
          };
        }

        export function response(ctx) {
          if (ctx.error) {
            util.error(ctx.error.message, ctx.error.type);
          }
          return ctx.result;
        }

  ###########################################################################
  # Query: getTodo
